### Yihu, two-way radios or voice group chat: choose by destination

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/voice-workbench-vs-radio-chat/

Yihu, two-way radios or voice group chat: choose by destination An Agent draft is not a person-to-person radio call Yihu is an iOS browser shell for your own HTTPS Agent workbench, with phone transcription, recording notes and PM Radar JSON reads. Two-way radios serve compatible radio systems under the applicable local rules; ordinary voice group chat serves contacts or groups in a particular service. If you need continuous person-to-person field dispatch, do not treat Yihu as a tested replacement for either. This is a boundary comparison, not a benchmark ranking. Three different destinations Speak to people : identify listeners, compatible equipment or service, permissions and a fallback contact method. Radio models and chat applications are not interchangeable. Hand a thought to an Agent : choose the workbench and draft editor before transcribing with a configured local model. Draft insertion is neither message submission nor execution. Keep a record first : recording notes retain local audio and text for review before explicit handoff. Meeting recordings are not automatically verified minutes or assigned team actions. Parameters and selection boundaries Check Current Yihu scope Two-way radio Ordinary voice group chat Destination Your workbench draft or local note, not a group voice channel Listeners in a compatible device/system; check the actual equipment Contacts/groups in the particular service; check the actual product Connectivity Reachable, trusted HTTPS for web work; separately downloaded compatible models for transcription Verify frequency, system, coverage and local operating rules Verify account, permissions, network and service availability Bluetooth/headset Near-field source requests voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP; not arbitrary-headset certification Accessory connector, protocol and microphone behavior depend on the model Routing and call behavior depend on app, system and headset combination Offline/weak network Prepared local models, notes and existing Radar cache have separate limits; no offline web-handoff promise Do not infer independence from repeaters or networks from the category Do not assume offline sending/receiving from the category Send and receipt Never presses Send; Radar replies need separate server authority, phone confirmation and readback Follow device controls and your field readback procedure; not certified here Follow actual send/receive indicators, which do not prove handling Range and latency No radio-range, end-to-end latency or continuous-call benchmark from this work No universal number detached from equipment, environment and system No universal number detached from network and service Lock screen/button-free use No promise of lock-screen wake, continuous button-free intercom or headset-button triggering Check the specific manual and validation Check the app version, system policy and validation Reviewable text Review transcript, destination and explicit handoff; recognition can be wrong Recording/text features depend on the actual model Text, transcription and recording retention depend on the actual product Bluetooth audio checks are not hands-free call certification The near-field configuration in CollieAudioCapturePreferences requests playAndRecord , voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP ; disabling near-field processing uses a different configuration. These are source-level audio-session choices. They do not certify any AirPods model, helmet headset or Bluetooth adapter, nor wind-noise reduction, echo control or battery endurance. In a safe stationary setting, check the actual input, output and microphone permission. Use one synthetic phrase with no real task, then inspect transcription and the destination draft. Recheck after changing headsets, interruptions or an audio-service reset. The recording-note source has input-retargeting and failure paths; these are not proof of lossless interruption recovery. Do not operate the phone while moving or bypass a host refusal for a test. Route offline, meeting and trade needs separately Offline or weak connectivity : an available downloaded model and local audio do not make the web reachable. A visible Radar card may be an old snapshot; stale sources and failures must remain distinguishable. Refresh taps, Bluetooth pairing and finished local recognition are not receipts from a remote destination. AI meeting minutes : Yihu provides recording, segmented transcription and retained originals. Minutes still require review and a separately authorized destination workflow. This page promises neither speaker diarization, automatic action extraction nor accuracy. Confirm participant awareness and applicable recording rules before recording. Foreign-trade Radar : a team can read its own authorized inquiry/follow-up tasks if it exports JSON matching the existing PM Radar contract. This is not a built-in customs database, market-intelligence subscription, customer-list scraper or automated email service. Keep tasks , decisions , source dates, cache status and write authority separate. FAQ Can Yihu directly replace a store or riding-team radio? Not on the evidence here. Its destination is your workbench draft, not an accepted multi-person voice channel. Choose and validate suitable equipment/services for live field contact; Yihu can help organize text while safely stationary. Does a paired Bluetooth headset prove Yihu uses its microphone? No. Pairing, the actual input route and the active audio session are different facts. Check input/output and a synthetic recording on the actual device; source options do not certify a headset model. Can Apple Watch be a standalone intercom or approval terminal? The companion receives existing paired-phone summaries and hands work back to the phone, subject to pairing and system prerequisites. This page promises no independent intercom, ledger refresh or approval. Phone confirmation and server authority remain separate. Is completed offline transcription proof of handoff? No. It only establishes a result for that processing step. Web access, attachment upload or a real reply still needs the destination service and permissions. Retain the original and inspect uncertainty before trying again. Can a foreign-trade team import inquiry tasks? Only through its own authorized JSON export matching the model contract. Make source identity, fields, dates and cache status explicit. This page adds no trade-data feed, customer list, notification backend or automatic follow-up. Where is the App Store download? This is currently a source release, without a published binary link. Use your own signing, models and workbench as described in the build guide. A made-up store link or merged source cannot replace installation and device acceptance. Evidence and next steps README: capabilities, prerequisites and limits Audio-session policy source Recording input-change handling Outdoor/store stationary checks and text handoff · Start · Privacy · Recording notes · Multi-project Radar and Watch

### 户外骑行与餐饮门店：蓝牙语音预检和工作台文字交接

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/outdoor-store-voice-preflight/

户外骑行与餐饮门店：蓝牙语音预检和工作台文字交接 这是一份安全静止时的文字工作流，不是对讲部署教程 一呼可围绕自有 Agent 网页工作台，把手机转写、录音笔记和已有 JSON 台账串成可核对的文字流程。户外骑行应停车并到安全位置再操作；门店应避开热源、车辆和正在服务的区域。蓝牙耳机配对不等于当前录音输入正确，也不等于多人免提对讲可用。即时联络、紧急通知和现场安全调度需要另有经验证的通信方式，不能依赖本指南。 先准备一个不会执行真实任务的样例 自行构建并签名一呼，准备可用的兼容模型、麦克风权限和你有权访问的可信 HTTPS 工作台。选一个空白草稿框，确认输入不会自动提交；不要测试到已有订单、客户沟通、付款或生产指令里。本页和官网演示不会接入麦克风、真实工作台或客户数据。 合成语句 ：“整理一份示例物品检查清单，只留草稿，不发送、不下单、不执行。”这条语句是流程示意，不是已经跑过的真机用例。先明确目标，再选择短语音草稿或录音笔记一条路径；不要把同一段内容同时交接两次。 路由、模型与交接的参数检查表 项目 当前源码/流程依据 检查动作 不满足时 运行环境 iOS 18+、自有签名；语音需另下载兼容模型 确认模型可用、权限与可用空间，再选目标 停在准备步骤，不跳过校验或权限 蓝牙输入 近场策略请求 voiceChat 与 allowBluetoothHFP 静止时检查实际输入/输出，用合成语句核对 更换路由后重新检查；不从“已配对”推断输入 短语音 有守卫的草稿交付，不自动按发送 先聚焦目标输入框；转写后看是否已填入 不再盲目填入；拒绝或不明确时保留原文 录音笔记 本地 audio.caf / note.json，前台可处理时分段转写 核对人名、数字、否定词与分段接缝 中断/失败与完成分开，不承诺任意录音时长 笔记直接填入 当前界面门槛为 3000 个 Swift Character，且需完成与目标检查 3000/3001 ASCII 字符仅作门槛解释 长文走已有 Markdown 暂存；不解释为时长上限 附件交接 先存分享托盘，文字不附带原录音 核对文字和目的地，再单独选择后续操作 暂存不等于上传；未发送不证明未上传 Radar 时效 既有缓存、来源 date_str 与刷新失败状态各有意义 阅读来源时间和错误，区分 tasks 与 decisions 无新读成功证据不标“最新”，不把零结果当空台账 Watch 与回执 手表接续手机已有摘要；真实回复另需手机确认及授权 核对手机可达性、目标、确认界面及服务回读 queued/saved 不当作发送、审批或执行完成 户外骑行：停车后的记录路径 先停稳并选择安全位置 ，不要在行驶、过路口、下坡或需要注意环境时操作手机或隔绝环境声。头盔耳机和 AirPods 没有由本轮验证为一呼兼容设备。 核对音频与模型 。风、头盔遮挡和输入切换都可能影响实际录音；源码设置音频处理不等于实测风噪指标。若环境不适合，改用安全的手动记录或推迟。 区分本地与远端 。模型已就绪时的手机处理、保存音频以及网页可达是三件事。没有网络时不要承诺上传、回复或网页草稿同步；缓存卡片也不是本次成功刷新。 只走合成草稿 。转写完成后核对文字和目标。已有填入只检查不重复；未知编辑器或宿主拒绝不绕过。结果不明先留原文，使用既有通信方式处理真正紧急事项。 餐饮/酒店/零售门店：非紧急记录的交接路径 把演练限定为不含订单和个人信息的内部样例，例如整理下次例会要核对的三个设备问题。录音前确认现场参与者知情、权限和服务规则；不要把顾客对话、餐桌信息或员工私密内容当演示材料。 在静止安全处打开正确工作台，选短转写草稿或录音笔记。短语音可能自动尝试受守卫填入，因此先核对目的地；结束录音笔记则不等于已经交给 Agent。笔记的显式填入/分享暂存先保留一次交接标记，结果不确定也不自动重试或换另一条交接路径。核对目的地已有内容后再决定是否手动复制。 若团队自行把设备检查或询盘跟进事项导出成 Radar JSON，只读筛选不会修改台账。所谓“外贸雷达”在这里仅指自有任务数据的解释与阅读，不是外贸商机抓取、自动采购、自动发信或实时门店调度系统。任何真实回复仍需独立写权限、手机确认与回执，不能由本页走读代替服务验收。 FAQ 能用耳机按键或语音一直免按键调度吗？ 本指南不提供这种承诺。蓝牙会话配置不是耳机按键触发、锁屏唤醒或持续群组对讲的证据。当前候选只是安全静止时的音频预检和文字交接。 voiceChat 模式是否保证骑行风噪被消除？ 不保证。它是源码中的系统音频模式请求，不是特定耳机、风速、头盔或骑行条件下的测试成绩。环境影响识别时应停止并改用适当方法。 弱网下是否可以完全离线完成工作流？ 不能这样概括。已就绪模型、本地笔记和既有快照有本地处理路径，模型下载、网页、附件交接和服务回复分别有网络与权限前提。应明确停在哪一步而不是统称“全部离线”。 录音结束后就生成可信的 AI 会议纪要了吗？ 没有。一呼源码提供分段转写和原文保存；核对、摘要和行动项整理需要另走获准流程。识别文本可能错误，保存本地也不代表备份与后续交接副本都不存在。 换耳机或来电后是否能保证录音无损继续？ 不能。源码包含输入变化处理以及中断/失败提示，但不是所有设备与干扰组合的验收。检查保存状态、音频和转写接缝；不要用恢复路径的存在宣称绝不丢字。 门店紧急调度能把草稿填入当作送达吗？ 不能。草稿、上传、发送、回执和对方处理分别是不同状态。本页不做时延、覆盖距离或生产送达承诺；紧急事项应使用已有经验证的联络与安全流程。 继续阅读与源码 一呼 vs 对讲机/语音群聊选型 · 接入预检 · 隐私 · 录音笔记与一次交接 · 多项目 Radar 与 Watch 依据： README 的功能与限制 、 音频采集策略 、 笔记输入变化处理 。这是源码/静态内容说明，不是真机、工作台写入、会议准确率或生产调度验收。

<td>运行环境</td>

<td>停在准备步骤，不跳过校验或权限</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>蓝牙输入</td>
<td>近场策略请求 voiceChat 与 allowBluetoothHFP</td>
<td>静止时检查实际输入/输出，用合成语句核对</td>
<td>更换路由后重新检查；不从“已配对”推断输入</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>短语音</td>
<td>有守卫的草稿交付，不自动按发送</td>
<td>先聚焦目标输入框；转写后看是否已填入</td>
<td>不再盲目填入；拒绝或不明确时保留原文</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>录音笔记</td>
<td>本地 audio.caf / note.json，前台可处理时分段转写</td>
<td>核对人名、数字、否定词与分段接缝</td>
<td>中断/失败与完成分开，不承诺任意录音时长</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>笔记直接填入</td>
<td>当前界面门槛为 3000 个 Swift Character，且需完成与目标检查</td>
<td>3000/3001 ASCII 字符仅作门槛解释</td>
<td>长文走已有 Markdown 暂存；不解释为时长上限</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>附件交接</td>
<td>先存分享托盘，文字不附带原录音</td>
<td>核对文字和目的地，再单独选择后续操作</td>
<td>暂存不等于上传；未发送不证明未上传</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Radar 时效</td>
<td>既有缓存、来源 date_str 与刷新失败状态各有意义</td>
<td>阅读来源时间和错误，区分 tasks 与 decisions</td>
<td>无新读成功证据不标“最新”，不把零结果当空台账</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Watch 与回执</td>
<td>手表接续手机已有摘要；真实回复另需手机确认及授权</td>
<td>核对手机可达性、目标、确认界面及服务回读</td>
<td>queued/saved 不当作发送、审批或执行完成</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Outdoor riding and stores: Bluetooth checks and workbench text handoff

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/outdoor-store-voice-preflight/

Outdoor riding and stores: Bluetooth checks and workbench text handoff A stationary text workflow, not an intercom deployment guide Yihu can combine phone transcription, recording notes and existing JSON-ledger reads around your own Agent web workbench. Stop riding and reach a safe place before operating it; in stores, move away from heat, vehicles and active service areas. Bluetooth pairing proves neither the active recording input nor multi-person hands-free intercom capability. Use a separately validated contact method for live communications, emergencies and safety dispatch, not this guide. Prepare a sample that cannot execute real work Build and sign the app yourself, prepare compatible models and microphone permission, and use a trusted HTTPS workbench you are authorized to access. Choose an empty draft editor that does not submit input automatically. Do not test against existing orders, customer conversations, payments or production instructions. This page and the website demo do not access your microphone, real workbench or customer data. Synthetic phrase : “Prepare a sample equipment checklist; keep only a draft, without sending, ordering or executing.” This is a process illustration, not a passed device test. Confirm the destination, then choose short dictation or recording notes, rather than handing the same content over twice. Route, model and handoff parameter checklist Item Current source/workflow basis Check Stop boundary Runtime iOS 18+, own signing; speech requires downloaded compatible models Check model availability, permission and free space before choosing the target Stay in setup; never bypass verification or permission Bluetooth input Near-field policy requests voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP Check actual input/output while stationary and review a synthetic phrase Recheck after a route change; paired does not prove the input Short speech Guarded draft handoff, without pressing Send Focus the intended composer first; inspect whether text was already inserted Do not blindly insert again; retain text on refusal or uncertainty Recording notes Local audio.caf/note.json; segmented transcription when foreground processing is available Review names, numbers, negations and segment joins Distinguish interruption/failure from completion; no arbitrary-duration guarantee Direct note insertion Current UI threshold is 3,000 Swift Characters, plus completion and target checks ASCII lengths 3000/3001 only illustrate the boundary Longer text uses existing Markdown staging; not a recording-duration limit Attachment handoff Stage in the share tray first; raw audio is not attached Inspect text and destination before a separate next action Staging is not uploading; unsent does not establish not uploaded Radar freshness Existing cache, source date_str and failed reads are distinct signals Inspect source time/errors and distinguish tasks from decisions Do not label data latest without a successful source read or treat zero matches as an empty ledger Watch/receipts Watch hands off existing phone summaries; replies need separate phone confirmation/authority Check phone reachability, target, confirmation and service readback queued/saved are not proof of sending, approval or execution Outdoor riding: a record after stopping Stop and find a safe location first . Do not operate a phone while riding, crossing, descending or needing environmental awareness. Do not block necessary ambient sound. This work does not certify helmet headsets or AirPods for Yihu. Check audio and models . Wind, a helmet and input changes can affect actual recording. Requesting system audio processing is not a measured wind-noise result. Delay recording or choose an appropriate manual method when conditions are unsuitable. Separate local and remote steps . Prepared-model phone processing, audio retention and web reachability are distinct. Without a network, do not promise uploads, replies or web-draft sync; cached cards are not a successful new refresh. Use only the synthetic draft . Review text and destination. If already inserted, inspect instead of inserting again. Unknown editors and host refusals are not bypassed. Retain originals on uncertainty and use established channels for urgent matters. Restaurant, hotel and retail stores: non-urgent text handoff Keep a trial free of orders and personal information: for example, three equipment questions for a future internal meeting. Before recording, check participant awareness, permissions and service rules. Customer conversations, table details and private employee information are not demo material. In a safe stationary location, open the correct workbench and choose a short-speech draft or a recording note. Short speech may automatically attempt guarded insertion, so choose the destination first. Stopping a note recording is not handing it to an Agent. Explicit insertion or staging reserves one note-handoff marker; uncertain results do not automatically retry or switch to another route. Inspect existing destination content before deciding whether manual copying is appropriate. If your team exports equipment checks or inquiry follow-ups as its own Radar JSON, read-only filtering does not change ledger status. “Foreign-trade Radar” here only describes authorized task-data interpretation and reading, not lead scraping, automatic purchasing, automatic email or real-time store dispatch. Real replies retain separate write permission, phone confirmation and readback; this walkthrough is not service acceptance. FAQ Can headset buttons or speech provide continuous button-free dispatch? This guide makes no such promise. Bluetooth session configuration is not evidence of headset-button triggers, lock-screen wake or continuous group intercom. The candidate covers safely stationary audio checks and text handoff only. Does voiceChat guarantee riding wind noise is removed? No. It requests a system audio mode; it is not a test result for a headset, wind speed, helmet or riding condition. Stop and use an appropriate alternative if the environment prevents reliable recognition. Can the whole workflow run offline in weak coverage? No blanket claim is appropriate. Prepared models, local notes and existing snapshots have local paths. Model downloads, web access, attachment handoff and service replies have separate network/permission prerequisites. Identify the actual stopped step instead of calling everything offline. Does stopping recording produce trustworthy AI meeting minutes? No. The source provides segmented transcription and retained originals. Review, summarization and action extraction need a separate authorized workflow. Recognition can be wrong; local retention does not rule out backup or later handoff copies. Can recording always continue losslessly after a call or headset change? No. Input-change handling and interruption/failure messages exist in source, but are not acceptance of every device/interrupt combination. Check saved status, audio and transcript joins. A recovery path is not a guarantee against lost words. Can a store treat inserted draft text as delivery for an urgent instruction? No. Drafts, uploads, sends, receipts and handling are separate states. This guide promises no latency, range or production delivery. Use established validated communications and safety procedures for urgent work. Reading and source evidence Choose between Yihu, radio and voice chat · Setup checks · Privacy · Recording notes and one handoff · Multi-project Radar and Watch Evidence: README capabilities/limits , audio-capture policy , note input-change handling . This is a source/static-content explanation, not device, workbench-write, meeting-accuracy or production-dispatch acceptance.

### 蓝牙耳机已连接却录不到声音？一呼音频路由分层排障

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/bluetooth-audio-input-troubleshooting/

蓝牙耳机已连接却录不到声音？一呼音频路由分层排障 先找失败的那一层，不从“已配对”推断录音输入 蓝牙配对、当前音频输入、音频写入、端侧识别和网页草稿是五个不同结果。一呼源码的近场采集策略会请求 playAndRecord 、 voiceChat 和 allowBluetoothHFP ，但选项不是特定耳机或麦克风路由的验收。应在安全静止环境，用一条不含真实任务的语句逐层检查；没有文字时不要先改工作台，没有远端草稿时也不要先认定麦克风坏了。 先区分你看到的症状 没有可读文字 ：检查录音入口是否获准、麦克风权限、实际输入和模型状态。录音可开始并不证明音频可用，音频可用也不证明兼容模型已下载并完成校验。 有文字但没有草稿 ：先保留文字，再检查当前工作台、捕获页面、可编辑草稿框与宿主拒绝。不要为了排查音频重复交接同一条笔记。 切换耳机后异常 ：输入路由、格式或系统音频会话可能变化；看实际保存/失败状态。源码有重定向和中断提示，不等于任意切换都无损继续。 参数与证据分层表 层级 可观察证据 应核对的条件 不能由此推出 设备配对 系统显示耳机已连接 当前手机、耳机与使用环境 当前录音一定使用耳机麦克风 权限 系统麦克风授权状态和App提示 用户明确授权；不绕过拒绝 已授权就必然有可用音频 会话策略 近场策略请求 voiceChat / allowBluetoothHFP；关闭近场配置不同 检查实际版本和已选策略，不为测试盲目切换设置 所有HFP设备兼容、风噪/回声指标达标 音频/保存 本地录音状态、可检查的已保存内容、错误提示 空间、来电/音频服务变化、输入切换 无限时长或绝不中断、绝不丢字 转写 可核对的识别文本、等待/失败/完成状态 兼容本地模型、校验与可处理前台时段 完整会议纪要或准确率承诺 目标草稿 文字是否已在正确的未发送输入框 同一工作台/页面、编辑器可用和宿主许可 消息已发送、附件已上传、任务已执行 Watch 手机已有摘要及接续状态 配对/手机可达性和原有资格检查 耳机路由正确、独立对讲或手表直写 一条合成语句的分段定位法 在安全静止位置，确认目标工作台允许保留草稿，不含真实订单或私密信息。使用“整理示例读书清单，只留草稿，不发送”。 在实际系统界面核对输入、输出和权限。记录耳机型号、系统版本、是否刚发生切换这些非敏感条件；不记录设备标识、账号或服务令牌。 观察录音与保存是否出现错误；没有音频证据就停在采集层。不要把开启系统音频处理当作声音已录到。 有音频但无文字时检查模型和转写状态。长笔记可能等待前台处理，等待不是识别失败，也不是后台永远处理的保证。 有文字时检查是否已经填入。短语音可能自动尝试受守卫交付；未知编辑器、忙碌状态或宿主拒绝不能靠改耳机绕过。 若结果不确定，核对目标已有内容并保留原文；每条笔记的一次交接标记不应被清除来强行重试。 这不是现场已完成的真机测试，也不要求为复现问题录入顾客正文。若只能在危险、行驶或不允许录音的环境出现，停止复现并换用合适的记录方法。 什么证据值得交给维护者 可给出：源码/构建版本、系统和耳机型号、失败层级、发生在新录音还是设备切换之后、可公开的错误类别，以及合成语句有没有形成可读文字。不要在截图或日志里暴露真实录音、私有任务、工作台地址参数、账号、设备唯一标识或签名材料。能复述“音频保存失败”通常比笼统说“蓝牙不兼容”更可定位。 FAQ 耳机显示已连接，为什么不能直接认定用了耳机麦克风？ 连接只描述配对状态。系统路由与App音频会话共同影响实际输入，需要在实际设备核对；本页不承诺存在专用路由诊断面板。 近场模式是必须打开的故障修复开关吗？ 不是通用修复开关。源码为开关状态配置不同会话和音频处理路径，应按实际版本和已核设置检查；本页没有要求永久更改配置，也不把处理模式当作性能成绩。 来电后录音停止，能自动继续并保证完整吗？ 不能这样承诺。录音笔记源码分别处理来电中断、媒体服务重置和输入变化，并可能提示保存到中断前。实际保存与文字接缝须检查，不能用恢复代码替代真机证据。 能否推荐一个保证兼容的AirPods型号？ 本轮没有型号级真机矩阵，因此不给保证名单。系统允许蓝牙HFP不代表任意型号、固件或音频场景都已接受验证。 有转写但草稿为空，应重录吗？ 先不要重录或重复填入。检查目标、捕获页面、忙碌与拒绝状态；若交接已经尝试或结果不明，先看目的地内容。音频处理与网页写入问题分开排查。 可以据此保证锁屏录音和持续免按键调度吗？ 不可以。本页仅提供分层排障，未测试锁屏、骑行或长时耳机通话；没有群组语音频道或生产调度送达承诺。 继续定位 静止场景预检 · 离线与弱网交接排障 · 短语音草稿选择 · 录音笔记 · 隐私 · 接入条件 依据： 音频采集策略 、 录音输入变化与中断 、 README范围 。

### Bluetooth connected but no recording? Diagnose Yihu audio by layer

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/bluetooth-audio-input-troubleshooting/

Bluetooth connected but no recording? Diagnose Yihu audio by layer Find the failing layer; paired does not establish the recording input Bluetooth pairing, the active input, saved audio, local recognition and a web draft are five separate results. Yihu’s near-field capture source requests playAndRecord , voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP , but those options do not certify a headset or microphone route. In a safely stationary setting, check each layer using a synthetic phrase. Do not change the workbench first when recognition is absent, or blame the microphone first when only the remote draft is missing. Identify the symptom first No readable text : inspect whether recording is permitted, microphone permission, actual input and model availability. Starting recording does not prove useful audio, and useful audio does not prove a compatible model is downloaded and verified. Text exists but no draft : retain it, then inspect the current workbench, captured page, editable composer and host refusal. Do not hand off the same recording note repeatedly to diagnose audio. Failure after a headset change : the input route, format or system audio session may have changed. Inspect actual saved/failure states. Retargeting and interruption handlers in source are not guarantees of lossless continuation. Parameter and evidence layers Layer Observable evidence Condition to inspect Does not establish Pairing System reports a connected headset The actual phone, headset and environment Recording necessarily uses the headset microphone Permission System microphone authorization and app messages Explicit user permission; no bypass Authorization guarantees usable audio Session policy Near-field requests voiceChat/allowBluetoothHFP; disabled mode differs Actual app version and selected policy; no blind setting changes All HFP accessories work or wind/echo targets are met Audio/storage Recording state, inspectable saved content and error messages Space, calls/audio-service changes and input switches Unlimited duration, no interruption or no lost words Transcription Reviewable text and pending/failed/completed state Compatible verified local models and an eligible foreground period Verified minutes or a promised accuracy level Draft target Text in the intended unsent composer Same workbench/page, editable composer and host permission Sent message, uploaded attachment or executed task Watch Existing phone summary and handoff state Pairing, phone reachability and original eligibility checks Correct headset input, standalone intercom or direct Watch writes Localize with one synthetic phrase In a safe stationary location, choose a workbench that permits drafts and contains no real orders or private content. Use “Prepare a sample reading list; keep a draft without sending.” Inspect input/output and permission through the actual system interface. Note non-sensitive conditions such as headset model, system version and a recent route change, not unique device IDs, accounts or service tokens. Observe recording/storage errors. Stop at capture if there is no usable audio evidence; requesting system processing is not proof sound was captured. With audio but no text, inspect models and transcription state. A longer note can wait for foreground processing. Pending is neither failure nor a guarantee of continuous background work. With text, inspect whether it was already inserted. Short speech may automatically attempt guarded delivery; unknown editors, busy states and host refusal are not solved by changing headsets. On uncertainty, inspect destination content and retain the original. Never clear a note’s one-handoff marker to force another attempt. This is not a completed physical-device test and does not require customer content to reproduce a problem. Stop reproduction if it only occurs while moving, in a dangerous place or where recording is not permitted. Useful evidence for a maintainer Provide the source/build version, system/headset model, failing layer, whether it followed a new recording or input switch, a shareable error category and whether the synthetic phrase became readable text. Do not expose real audio, private tasks, workbench URL parameters, accounts, unique device identifiers or signing material in screenshots/logs. “Audio save failed” is more useful than an unsupported conclusion that Bluetooth is incompatible. FAQ Why does connected not prove the headset microphone is in use? Connection describes pairing. System routing and the app’s session affect actual input, which needs checking on the device. This page does not promise a dedicated app route-diagnostics screen. Is near-field mode a required universal fix? No. The source configures different session/processing paths for its two states. Check the actual version and established configuration; this page does not require permanent changes or treat a processing mode as a benchmark result. Can recording always resume completely after a call? No such guarantee follows. Note source handles interruptions, media-service resets and input changes separately, and may report retention up to interruption. Inspect saved content and joins; recovery code is not device acceptance. Which AirPods model is guaranteed compatible? No model-level device matrix was tested in this work, so there is no guaranteed list. Allowing Bluetooth HFP is not acceptance of every model, firmware or audio scenario. Should I record again when text exists but the draft is empty? First inspect the target, captured page, busy/refusal state and existing destination content. Do not repeat insertion blindly after a handoff attempt or uncertainty. Separate audio diagnosis from web-write diagnosis. Does this certify lock-screen recording and continuous button-free dispatch? No. This is layered troubleshooting, not a lock-screen, riding or long-call test. No group voice channel or production-dispatch delivery is promised. Continue troubleshooting Stationary preflight · Offline/weak-network handoff · Short voice drafts · Recording notes · Privacy · Setup Evidence: audio capture policy , note interruptions/input changes , README scope .

### 离线转写完成却没交付？弱网工作台与Radar缓存排障

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/offline-workbench-handoff-troubleshooting/

离线转写完成却没交付？弱网工作台与Radar缓存排障 离线不是一个全局开关：先指出哪一步有证据 一呼的已就绪本地模型、录音笔记和既有 Radar 快照各自有本地处理路径，但模型下载、HTTPS网页、附件交接与服务回复另有网络和权限前提。转写完成只证明这一段处理有文字结果；既有卡片只证明有可显示快照。排障应记录“本地已完成、远端未知”之类的分层状态，不把整条工作流统称为已离线成功或全部失败。 不做破坏性复现的最小顺序 先核对正在查看的工作台、页面和数据源，保留原文与现有状态。只用没有真实业务含义的合成内容，不主动断开他人的网络、不删除缓存、不重置账号，也不向真实任务发送测试回复。若已有不确定写入，先按原请求身份回读，不能为了“看看能不能发”制造新请求。 网络与状态分层表 所在步骤 现有证据或字段 仍需检查 停止/保留方式 模型准备 已下载、校验通过的兼容模型 是否真的可用、权限与资源；不能只看过去下载过 模型缺失就停，不跳过校验或承诺离线识别 本地录音笔记 本机音频、文字及待处理/失败/完成状态 来电、空间、输入切换及可转写前台时段 保留原文，检查中断位置，不承诺永不丢字 HTTPS网页 当前手机实际访问结果 手机可达、证书信任、服务登录和编辑器兼容 不关闭TLS检查，不公开私有源或放宽权限 草稿填入 预期目标里的未发送文字 捕获页面与当前目标、宿主拒绝/忙碌状态 已填入只检查；不确定不盲目重试 附件暂存 分享托盘的文字/Markdown 后续用户交接是否发生，目标是否先行上传 暂存不是上传，未发送不等于附件未上传 Radar源 date_str、source_refreshing、source_refresh_failed 来源身份与最后成功读取时间 保留旧快照并明示失败/时效，不改写时间为现在 Radar集合 tasks 全任务、decisions 待决策/验收子集 项目/状态/搜索/历史开关交集 零结果不是无任务；先核筛选，不改真实台账 真实回复 已保存 request_id、服务端回执或不确定状态 独立写权限、手机确认、原目标与回读 不生成新ID重发；回执不等于已处理或执行 Radar“有卡片但刚刷新失败”怎么解释 date_str 是来源最后成功读取时间，当前模型按 UTC+08:00 解释；不能用手机请求时间或缓存命中把它改成现在。 source_refreshing 与 source_refresh_failed 用来区分读取进行中和失败。客户端对超过24小时的来源标旧，对超前超过5分钟的时间提示时钟问题；这些是时效信号，不是任务已暂停、阻塞或完成的推断。 可选只读适配器的30秒新鲜/最多五分钟旧值缓存是另一层请求触发的服务器策略，不是所有数据源的固定轮询周期，也不是手机刷新SLA。客户端现有一次 no-cache 跟进不能被描述成永久轮询。本页不新增后台调度器、缓存库或私有台账服务。 三个常见分流例子 例一：录音有字，网页打不开。 把已识别文字与网页连接分开记录，保留本地原文；检查手机的现有授权路径、TLS与服务，不为了交接放宽安全边界。恢复后也先核对目标内容，不能假定此前没写入。 例二：Radar显示旧日期，但筛选后为零。 先看是否提供 tasks 。缺失时旧源会回退待处理子集并提示范围不完整；然后检查项目、状态、优先级、搜索与历史开关。来源旧和集合空是不同问题，不能相互解释。 例三：点过确认后超时。 超时不是“没有写入”。沿原请求身份与既有不确定处理检查，保留待处理信息；不要换源、清标记或新建请求来绕过冻结。服务已记录回复也不等于任务状态改变或有人完成处理。 FAQ 模型曾经下载过，是否足够保证离线转写？ 不是。仍需确认实际版本的兼容模型可用并已校验、权限和资源满足。模型准备、音频采集与文字识别是独立步骤，没有任意设备、语言或性能保证。 手机显示刚刷新，date_str为什么还是旧的？ 手机发起请求不等于源成功读取。当前契约保留来源时间，缓存命中或失败不应更新为当前时刻；应结合刷新/失败状态看待旧卡片。 网页已登录，为什么原生Radar源仍不能读？ 两条会话不同。原生JSON读取不复用网页Cookie、不存源凭据且不跟随重定向；认证源按现有说明走有权取得的文件导出，不把密码或令牌拼进URL。 托盘中已有Markdown，能算服务器已收到吗？ 不能。暂存、用户后续交接、附件上传和消息发送分别核对；文字附件不包含原录音，目标工作台可能在发送前先上传。 回执超时可以换一个request_id再试吗？ 不应这样做。不确定结果保留原请求身份与冻结/回读边界，新ID盲目重试可能重复写入；不存在由本页承诺的端到端绝对一次保证。 手表同步成功能证明源台账已更新吗？ 不能。Watch同步重传手机已有快照；queued或saved只对应各自的传输/保存阶段。源刷新、手机确认和服务回读仍需各自证据。 继续阅读与依据 蓝牙输入排障 · 录音笔记一次交接 · 多项目Radar与Watch · 手机决策与时效 · 字段化纪要与简报 · 隐私 · 开始 源码依据： README 、 Radar模型 、 源读取与缓存 。本页是排障与合成场景说明，不连接真实源或触发写入。

### Transcribed offline but not delivered? Diagnose weak-network handoff and Radar cache

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/offline-workbench-handoff-troubleshooting/

Transcribed offline but not delivered? Diagnose weak-network handoff and Radar cache Offline is not a global switch: identify the step with evidence Prepared local models, recording notes and existing Radar snapshots have local paths, while model downloads, HTTPS pages, attachment handoff and service replies have separate network/permission requirements. Completed transcription only establishes text for that processing step; visible cards only establish a displayable snapshot. Record layered states such as “local complete, remote unknown” rather than calling the entire workflow offline-successful or failed. A minimal non-destructive diagnostic sequence Identify the current workbench, page and data source first; retain originals and existing state. Use only synthetic content without business meaning. Do not disconnect another person’s network, delete cache, reset accounts or send test replies to real tasks. After an uncertain write, use the original request identity for readback rather than creating another request to test sending. Network and state layers Step Existing evidence or field Still check Stop/retention boundary Model preparation Downloaded, verified compatible model Actual availability, permission/resources; downloaded once is insufficient Stop if missing; no verification bypass or offline-recognition promise Local notes Phone audio/text with pending/failed/completed state Calls, storage, input changes and eligible foreground processing Retain originals and inspect joins; no lossless guarantee HTTPS page Actual phone access result Phone reachability, trusted TLS, login and editor compatibility Do not disable TLS checks, expose private sources or weaken permissions Draft insertion Unsent text at the intended destination Captured/current page, host refusal and busy state Inspect existing insertion; no blind retry on uncertainty Attachment staging Text/Markdown in the share tray Whether a later user handoff happened and the host uploads first Staged is not uploaded; unsent is not proof of no upload Radar source date_str, source_refreshing, source_refresh_failed Source identity and last successful read time Retain old data with failure/age indication; do not replace time with now Radar collection tasks ledger versus decisions pending subset Project/status/search/history intersection Zero matches do not prove no tasks; inspect filters, do not edit the ledger Real reply Saved request_id, server receipt or uncertainty Separate write permission, phone confirmation, original target/readback Do not resend with a new ID; receipt is not handling/execution Visible cards after a failed refresh date_str records the last successful source read and is parsed as UTC+08:00 by the current model. A phone request or cache hit cannot replace it with now. source_refreshing and source_refresh_failed distinguish in-flight reading from failure. The client marks sources older than 24 hours stale and warns when the source clock is over five minutes ahead. These freshness signals do not infer that tasks are paused, blocked or complete. The optional read-only adapter’s 30-second fresh/five-minute old cache is a separate request-triggered server policy, not every source’s polling interval or a phone-refresh SLA. The client’s existing single no-cache follow-up is not perpetual polling. This guide adds no scheduler, cache database or private-ledger service. Three practical branches Text exists but the web page does not open. Record recognized text and web connectivity separately. Retain the local original; inspect the phone’s existing authorized network, TLS and service without relaxing security. Once access returns, inspect destination content first rather than assuming the earlier write did not happen. Radar shows an old date and filters return zero. Check whether tasks exists. Legacy sources without it fall back to a pending subset with an incomplete-scope notice. Then check project, status, priority, search and history. An old source and an empty filtered collection are different problems, not explanations for each other. Timeout after confirmation. A timeout is not proof of no write. Preserve pending information and follow the existing request identity/uncertain-result path. Do not change sources, clear markers or create a request to bypass a frozen state. Even a recorded reply is not proof of a changed task status or completed handling. FAQ Does a previously downloaded model guarantee offline transcription? No. Verify the actual version’s compatible model is available and checked, with permission/resources ready. Model preparation, audio capture and recognition remain distinct; there is no arbitrary device/language/performance guarantee. Why is date_str old after I just refreshed? A phone request is not a successful source read. The contract preserves source time; cache hits and failures do not make it current. Inspect refreshing/failure indicators alongside old cards. Why can native Radar fail while the web page is logged in? They are separate sessions. Native JSON does not reuse web cookies, store source credentials or follow redirects. Use the documented authorized file-export path for authenticated feeds; do not put credentials or tokens in URLs. Does staged Markdown prove the server received it? No. Staging, later user handoff, attachment upload and message submission are separate. The text attachment excludes original audio, and a host may upload before sending a message. Can I retry a timed-out receipt with a new request_id? Do not retry blindly that way. Preserve the original identity and frozen/readback boundary. New IDs can create duplicate writes; this guide offers no end-to-end exactly-once guarantee. Does successful Watch sync prove a refreshed ledger? No. Sync republishes the phone’s existing snapshot. queued and saved establish only their transport/persistence stages. Source refresh, phone confirmation and service readback need their own evidence. Reading and evidence Bluetooth input troubleshooting · One recording-note handoff · Radar and Watch · Mobile decisions and age · Meeting/brief fields · Privacy · Start Source: README , Radar model , source reads/cache . These are synthetic diagnostic illustrations, not real source connections or writes.

### 把转写整理成可核对纪要与项目简报：字段、证据和未决项

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/meeting-notes-brief-fields/

把转写整理成可核对纪要与项目简报：字段、证据和未决项 先保留原文，再整理字段；模板不是自动纪要功能 一呼源码提供本地录音笔记、分段转写和用户选择的草稿/附件交接，不保证自动生成准确会议纪要。下表是可手工使用的编辑模板，帮助把来源、核对状态、事实、提案和未决问题分开；它不是App导入格式、API契约或PM Radar JSON模型。转写、摘要、批准与任务执行之间不能直接划等号。 从文字到结论的四层材料 原始转写 保留误识别风险与上下文，尤其人名、数字、否定词和分段接缝；不要为了简短先删掉“不确定”或“尚未批准”。 核对后的引用/事实 注明依据位置与已核范围；无法验证的内容保留为待核，不把流畅表达当成事实。 提案与未决项 列出需要谁以何种已有流程确认；不能把“建议”“可考虑”改写为“已决定”。 交接与后续处理 记录文字去了哪里、当前停在哪一步。存在草稿或附件不代表已经发送、有人已阅读或任务已执行。 人工编辑字段表 编辑字段 写什么 合成示例 验证/缺失处理 source_note 原文或已获准记录的引用位置 示例笔记A，第2段 保留原文；不要公开录音或私密路径 source_time 记录内容的来源时间，注明未知 未提供 不用编辑/发布时间代替来源时间 review_state 尚未核对、部分核对、已核对的范围 仅核对合成片段 不把“已转写”自动标成“已核对” observed_facts 可由来源直接支持的事实 示例清单有三项待核问题 缺证据放入待核，不补写数字或结论 unconfirmed_proposals 尚未批准的建议 建议下次例会先看示例清单 保留建议语气，不触发执行 confirmed_decisions 有独立确认依据的决定 无 没有批准证据就留空，不从语气推断 open_questions 明确需要进一步回答的问题 示例字段由哪个已有流程确认？ 问题不当作已分配任务 next_step 经允许的人工下一步 仅保存供核对，不发送 与自动执行、下单、合并或部署区分 handoff_target 已核对的目的地及内容范围 自有工作台空白草稿 不写账号/令牌；目标不清就不交接 handoff_state 本地保留、已暂存、草稿可见或不确定 本地保留，未交接 不把saved/queued或草稿可见写成已送达 这些键只是本文的编辑标签，可以用纸面、受控本地文档或现有获准工具整理；本页不新增数据库、自动标注、解析器或应用内保存行为。实际可保存在哪里，仍取决于所选工具与账户的同步/备份规则。 一份不会执行任务的简报草稿 主题：示例清单讨论（合成，不是真实会议） source_note：示例笔记A，第2段 source_time：未提供 review_state：仅核对这段合成文字 observed_facts：样例提出三个待核问题；没有真实业务数据 unconfirmed_proposals：建议下次例会先核字段，不安排执行 confirmed_decisions：无独立确认依据，留空 open_questions：已有工作流中由哪个角色确认？ next_step：仅保存供核对，不发送、不执行 handoff_target：尚未选择 handoff_state：本地保留，未交接 即使使用模型帮助摘要，也要逐条对照原文和确认依据；本页没有调用Agent或模型，也不提供生成质量、说话人分离或会议准确率结果。引用和合成示例不能作为真实会议的批准记录。 和PM Radar字段的边界 Radar源使用 date_str 、 tasks 、 decisions 和 active/stale/cold 等模型字段，任务的 project 对应项目记录的 path 。上面的编辑标签不能直接替换这些导入键；把一份纪要命名为JSON文件也不会使其符合模型。 若团队已有获准的任务导出或转换流程，应由该流程验证来源、字段与权限，缺失 tasks 的旧源只回退待处理子集。本文不实现纪要转任务、自动回写或外贸数据采集；简报中的“提案”不自动成为已批准决定，阅读权限也不等于回复写权限。 交接前的减法检查 只交接必要且获准的文本，不把原始录音、私人参与者信息或客户正文作为公开示例。核对工作台/页面和是否已有同一内容。笔记直接填入当前有3000个 Swift Character门槛与资格检查；较长内容沿已有Markdown暂存路径，文字附件不附原录音。长度规则不是会议时长或模型上限。 先明确选择一条交接路径。每条笔记在显式填入/暂存前保留一次标记；失败或结果不明保留原文，不为了补发而清标记或换路由。草稿可见、附件已暂存、消息已发送和对方已处理必须分别记录，不能把表格填完整当作任何一项已完成的证明。 FAQ 这些字段会让一呼自动生成会议纪要吗？ 不会。这是内容编辑指南，不增加App能力、自动摘要服务或后台任务。现有实现提供录音、转写和显式交接；人工核对与获准的后续整理流程仍必要。 摘要写了“决定”，就可以填进confirmed_decisions吗？ 不应只凭摘要这样做。先找独立确认依据并保留来源位置；原文若只是提议或条件语句，应放在未确认提案/问题中，没有证据则留空。 把模板存成JSON能直接导入Radar吗？ 不能。本文字段不是Radar模型或导入API。实际JSON需符合现有契约并经过有权限的来源流程；本页不提供转换器或自动创建任务。 来源时间缺失可以填现在吗？ 不应伪造。保留未知，并把编辑时间另行注明。Radar的 date_str 是来源最后成功读取时间，也不能用手机刷新或缓存命中改成现在。 整理成更短简报后能绕过一次交接限制吗？ 不能。编辑文本不抹去原笔记交接结果的不确定性；先核对目的地已有内容，不能把换一份摘要当成自动重试或去重保证。 删掉本地模板是否等于撤回所有会议资料？ 不是。原笔记、剪贴板、文档账户、工作台和后续附件可能分别保有副本。按实际目的地规则处理，本页不保证删除、备份排除或第三方留存结果。 相关指南与源码 录音笔记与显式交接 · 弱网交接与缓存排障 · Radar JSON与Watch · 语音草稿路径选择 · 隐私 · 开始 现有实现依据： README 、 笔记模型与一次标记 、 Radar模型 。编辑模板本身是本文建议，不冒充源码字段或设备验收。

### From transcript to reviewable minutes and briefs: fields, evidence and open questions

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/meeting-notes-brief-fields/

From transcript to reviewable minutes and briefs: fields, evidence and open questions Retain the original, then organize fields; a template is not automatic minutes Yihu source provides local recording notes, segmented transcription and user-selected draft/attachment handoff, not guaranteed accurate automatic minutes. The following is a manual editorial template separating sources, review state, facts, proposals and unanswered questions. It is not an app import format, API contract or PM Radar JSON model. Transcription, summarization, approval and execution remain different states. Four layers between text and decisions Original transcript retains recognition risk and context, especially names, numbers, negations and segment joins. Do not shorten away “uncertain” or “not approved.” Reviewed quotations/facts identify evidence locations and the reviewed scope. Leave unverifiable material pending; fluent prose is not factual evidence. Proposals/open questions identify what needs confirmation through which existing process. Do not rewrite “suggested” or “could consider” as “decided.” Handoff/handling records where text went and the actual completed step. A draft or attachment does not prove sending, reading or execution. Manual editorial field table Editorial field Content Synthetic example Verification/missing-data rule source_note Location in the original/authorized record Sample note A, paragraph 2 Retain the original; do not publish audio or private paths source_time Source time, explicitly unknown when absent Not provided Do not substitute editing/publication time review_state Unreviewed, partially reviewed or the actual reviewed scope Only the synthetic passage checked Transcribed does not mean reviewed observed_facts Facts directly supported by the source Three open questions in a sample checklist Unverified facts stay pending; no invented numbers/conclusions unconfirmed_proposals Suggestions without approval Suggest reviewing fields at a future meeting Preserve proposal wording; do not execute confirmed_decisions Decisions with separate confirmation evidence None Leave empty without approval evidence; do not infer tone open_questions Questions needing further answers Which existing process confirms the sample field? A question is not an assigned task next_step Authorized manual next action Save for review only; do not send Separate it from automatic execution, ordering, merging or deployment handoff_target Verified destination and content scope Empty draft in own workbench No account/token values; stop if unclear handoff_state Local, staged, visible draft or uncertain Retained locally; not handed off saved/queued or a draft is not delivery These keys are editorial labels for paper, a controlled local document or an already authorized tool. This page adds no database, automatic annotation, parser or app persistence behavior. Storage/sync/backup depend on the chosen tool and account. A brief draft that executes nothing Topic: Sample checklist discussion (synthetic, not a real meeting) source_note: Sample note A, paragraph 2 source_time: Not provided review_state: Only this synthetic passage reviewed observed_facts: Three sample questions; no real business data unconfirmed_proposals: Suggest checking fields at a future meeting; no execution confirmed_decisions: Empty; no independent confirmation open_questions: Which role confirms through the existing workflow? next_step: Save for review only; do not send or execute handoff_target: Not selected handoff_state: Retained locally; not handed off If you use a model to assist summarization, still check every item against the original and confirmation evidence. This page calls no Agent/model and reports no generation-quality, diarization or meeting-accuracy result. A synthetic example is not an approval record from a real meeting. Distinguish editorial fields from PM Radar Radar uses model fields such as date_str , tasks , decisions and active/stale/cold ; a task’s project corresponds to a project record’s path . The editorial labels above cannot replace those import keys. Naming minutes as a JSON file does not make them model-compatible. A team with an existing authorized export/transformation process must validate sources, fields and permissions through that process. Legacy exports missing tasks fall back to a pending subset. This page implements no minutes-to-task conversion, automatic writeback or trade-data collection. A brief’s proposal is not automatically an approved decision, and read permission is not reply-write authority. A subtraction checklist before handoff Only hand off necessary authorized text. Do not use original audio, private participant details or customer content as a public example. Check workbench/page and existing destination text. Direct note insertion currently has a 3,000 Swift Character threshold and eligibility checks; longer content uses existing Markdown staging, which does not attach original audio. The length rule is not a meeting-duration or model limit. Choose one handoff path. Each note reserves one marker before explicit insertion/staging; failure or uncertainty retains originals rather than clearing a marker or switching routes to resend. Keep visible drafts, staged attachments, sent messages and handled work separate. Completing a field table is not proof any of those occurred. FAQ Do these fields make Yihu generate minutes automatically? No. This is editorial guidance, not new app functionality, hosted summarization or background tasks. Existing recording, transcription and explicit handoff still require manual review and a separately authorized next workflow. Can a summary saying decided populate confirmed_decisions? Not merely because the summary says so. Find separate confirmation and retain its location. A suggestion or conditional statement belongs under proposals/questions; leave a decision empty without evidence. Can I save this template as JSON and import it into Radar? No. These fields are not Radar’s model or an import API. Actual JSON must match the existing contract and authorized source process. This page supplies no converter or task-creation automation. Can a missing source time be replaced with now? Do not fabricate it. Preserve unknown and label editing time separately. Radar’s date_str is the last successful source-read time, not a phone-refresh/cache-hit timestamp. Can a shorter brief bypass the one-handoff limit? No. Editing text does not remove uncertainty about an original handoff. Inspect destination content first; a different summary is neither a sanctioned automatic retry nor duplicate prevention. Does deleting a local template withdraw all meeting material? No. Notes, clipboard, document accounts, workbenches and later attachments can retain separate copies. Follow actual destination policies; this guide does not guarantee deletion, backup exclusion or third-party retention outcomes. Guides and source evidence Recording notes and explicit handoff · Weak-network handoff/cache diagnosis · Radar JSON and Watch · Voice-draft path choices · Privacy · Start Existing implementation: README , note model/one marker , Radar model . The editorial template is a suggestion from this article, not a source field schema or device acceptance.

### Agent网页朗读与语音输入切换：输出、麦克风和草稿边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/web-read-aloud-microphone-boundaries/

Agent网页朗读与语音输入切换：输出、麦克风和草稿边界 网页能播放，不代表一呼提供内置朗读或语音通话后端 一呼围绕WebKit访问自有Agent工作台，增加原生转写和草稿交付。网页若提供朗读，其文字、声音、生成服务与播放控制仍由实际网页决定。源码允许内联媒体播放，不等于所有站点的TTS、连续双向语音或锁屏播放已适配。本页专门核对“刚在听网页，现在要说一句话”的切换边界，而不是重复耳机配对排障或认证任意语音Agent。 把输出与输入分开定位 输出链 ：网页是否有已获准的朗读功能、是否真的产生了可播放内容、手机输出到了哪里，是不同问题。一呼不提供通用TTS服务，不应把空白播放或网络失败都归因于耳机。 采集链 ：系统麦克风权限、网页采集请求和原生录音入口分别受各自规则约束。允许网页播放不是允许网页录音；打开页面也不自动授予原生或服务端写权限。 交接链 ：原生转写的文字可以尝试受守卫填入兼容草稿，不代表会发送；网页自己的语音会话则有其服务规则。两条路径不能互相冒充回执或兼容证明。 朗读到输入的交接检查表 核对项 当前依据 应观察什么 不应推断什么 网页朗读 功能若存在由具体网页/服务提供 内容来源、网页控制和播放结果 一呼内置统一TTS或托管语音Agent 内联媒体 WebKit配置允许内联播放 实际站点与系统组合下是否可播放 所有媒体、后台/锁屏播放均已验证 当前输出 系统音频输出及网页音量/暂停状态 声音来自手机还是已选耳机 已连接设备必定是当前输入 网页采集 网页与系统权限边界另行检查 哪个页面请求麦克风、用户是否明确许可 播放权限等于采集或写入授权 原生录音 有独立权限、模型与采集入口 系统是否有正在使用麦克风的状态或中断提示 与网页采集可稳定并发、必然无冲突 转写草稿 目标页面/编辑器和宿主许可检查 是否已有未发送文字、是否明确拒绝 听到声音就代表文字已填入或消息已发出 恢复/退出 各网页、系统与原生流程分别控制 自己开启的播放/录音是否停止，当前目标是否改变 关闭面板就撤回服务已收到的音频或文字 安全的单路径切换走读 只在安全静止环境使用获准的合成内容。不要朗读顾客资料、私有任务或真实会议录音来复现问题。 先辨认自己是否正在使用网页的语音/播放控制；通过它已有的停止或暂停动作结束本次输出，核对状态。不要同时开启网页录音与原生录音来试探并发能力。 再检查系统麦克风、实际音频路由、模型和目标草稿。不要重置别人的会话、权限或系统设置；发生冲突时停止受影响路径，而不是不断点击录音。 用“整理示例清单，只留草稿，不发送”测试原生输入。短语音可能自动尝试安全填入，因此先选目标，再核对文字是否已经出现。 结果不明就保留原文并检查目标已有内容；不通过换页面、换编辑器或清标记绕过拒绝。最后结束自己开启的播放/录音，保留对问题层级的描述。 这是检查顺序建议，不是本轮已完成的浏览器/真机测试；也不提供操作系统级麦克风占用探针、通用冲突检测面板或自动资源仲裁功能。 朗读内容和记录副本 网页TTS是否向服务发送文字、保存音频或同步历史，应看该服务规则，不由端侧ASR推断。原生转写在准备好的模型上本地处理，也不等于后续网页草稿永不离开手机。暂停播放、停止录音与删除服务副本分别是不同动作；不要据停止按钮承诺数据已撤回。 FAQ 一呼是否给所有Agent网页增加统一朗读按钮？ 本页不作这种承诺。当前范围是浏览器壳与原生语音草稿等增强，朗读若存在由实际网页/服务提供；内联媒体配置不是统一TTS功能。 网页和原生麦克风能一直同时使用吗？ 没有本轮并发矩阵可支持这个保证。先按单一路径切换并观察权限、路由和中断；不以反复启动制造冲突或绕过系统提示。 允许内联播放是否等于自动播放和锁屏都必定可用？ 不等于。页面实现、系统策略、音频会话和实际版本仍有影响；源码配置不证明所有站点或后台场景已经验证。 网页能朗读就已获准录音吗？ 不能这样推断。媒体输出、麦克风权限、页面采集及服务端身份/写权限是不同层级，须按实际提示单独确认。 如何确认朗读没有被当作自己的输入？ 先停止本次播放，再用单一合成语句检查实际转写。是否存在回采或回声需要具体设备证据；voiceChat等配置不是零回声或声纹准确保证。 停止网页语音能撤回已经交给服务的数据吗？ 不能据此承诺。停止与撤回、第三方存储和历史同步不同，需按实际服务规则核对；本页不提供统一远端删除功能。 相关排障与源码 蓝牙输入分层排障 · 弱网交接排障 · 语音草稿对照 · 多段笔记汇总 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： WebKit配置源码 、 原生音频策略 、 README边界 。

Parameter/comparison tables (HTML) / 参数对照表：

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>核对项</th>
<th>当前依据</th>
<th>应观察什么</th>
<th>不应推断什么</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>网页朗读</td>
<td>功能若存在由具体网页/服务提供</td>
<td>内容来源、网页控制和播放结果</td>
<td>一呼内置统一TTS或托管语音Agent</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>内联媒体</td>
<td>WebKit配置允许内联播放</td>
<td>实际站点与系统组合下是否可播放</td>
<td>所有媒体、后台/锁屏播放均已验证</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>当前输出</td>
<td>系统音频输出及网页音量/暂停状态</td>
<td>声音来自手机还是已选耳机</td>
<td>已连接设备必定是当前输入</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>网页采集</td>
<td>网页与系统权限边界另行检查</td>
<td>哪个页面请求麦克风、用户是否明确许可</td>
<td>播放权限等于采集或写入授权</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>原生录音</td>
<td>有独立权限、模型与采集入口</td>
<td>系统是否有正在使用麦克风的状态或中断提示</td>
<td>与网页采集可稳定并发、必然无冲突</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>转写草稿</td>
<td>目标页面/编辑器和宿主许可检查</td>
<td>是否已有未发送文字、是否明确拒绝</td>
<td>听到声音就代表文字已填入或消息已发出</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>恢复/退出</td>
<td>各网页、系统与原生流程分别控制</td>
<td>自己开启的播放/录音是否停止，当前目标是否改变</td>
<td>关闭面板就撤回服务已收到的音频或文字</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Agent web read-aloud and voice input: output, microphone and draft boundaries

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/web-read-aloud-microphone-boundaries/

Agent web read-aloud and voice input: output, microphone and draft boundaries Web playback does not establish built-in Yihu TTS or a voice-call backend Yihu wraps WebKit for your own Agent workbench and adds native transcription/draft delivery. When a site offers read-aloud, its text, voice, generation service and playback controls belong to that site’s implementation. Source configuration permits inline media, not universal acceptance of TTS, continuous two-way voice or lock-screen playback. This guide addresses the transition from listening to a web page to dictating a phrase, not another pairing checklist or certification of arbitrary voice Agents. Separate output, capture and handoff Output : whether the authorized site offers read-aloud, produces playable content and routes sound where expected are different questions. Yihu does not supply a general TTS service; silence/network failure is not automatically a headset problem. Capture : system microphone authorization, page capture requests and native recording controls have separate rules. Permission to play is not permission to record, and opening a page is not native or server-write authority. Handoff : native recognized text can attempt guarded insertion into a compatible draft, without sending. A site’s own voice session follows its service rules. Neither path establishes receipts or compatibility for the other. Read-aloud to input checks Check Current basis Observe Do not infer Web read-aloud Provided by the particular site/service if present Content origin, page controls and actual playback Built-in universal Yihu TTS or a hosted voice Agent Inline media WebKit permits inline playback The actual site/system combination Universal media, background or lock-screen acceptance Output route System output and page volume/pause state Phone speaker versus selected headset Connected output proves the active microphone Page capture Separate page/system permission boundary Which page requests the mic and whether the user permits it Playback permission is capture/write permission Native recording Separate permission, models and capture entry point System mic-use state and interruption messages Stable concurrency with web capture or no conflicts Transcript draft Page/editor/host-permission guards Existing unsent text or explicit refusal Audible output proves insertion or a sent message Stop/recovery Site, system and native paths have their own controls Whether your playback/recording stopped and target changed Closing a panel recalls data already received remotely A safe single-path transition Use authorized synthetic material while safely stationary, not customer data, private tasks or real meeting audio. Identify whether you are using the site’s voice/playback controls. End this output through its existing stop/pause action and inspect state. Do not start simultaneous web/native capture to probe concurrency. Check system microphone permission, actual route, model availability and the intended draft. Do not reset another person’s session, permissions or settings. Stop the affected path on conflict rather than repeatedly pressing Record. Use “Prepare a sample checklist; keep a draft without sending.” Short speech may automatically attempt guarded insertion, so select the target first and inspect whether text already appeared. Retain the original and inspect destination content on uncertainty. Do not switch pages/editors or clear markers to bypass refusal. End playback/recording you started and retain the failing-layer description. This is suggested check ordering, not a completed browser/device test. It adds no OS-level microphone occupancy probe, universal conflict panel or automatic resource arbitration. Read-aloud content and retained copies Whether web TTS sends text to a service, stores audio or syncs history depends on that service. Local ASR does not answer those questions. Prepared-model native transcription is local processing, not a guarantee that later web drafts never leave the phone. Pause, recording stop and remote deletion are different operations; a Stop button does not establish recall. FAQ Does Yihu add one read-aloud button to every Agent page? No such feature is promised here. The scope is a browser shell with enhancements such as native drafts; read-aloud, when present, is site-provided. Inline media configuration is not universal TTS functionality. Can the page and native microphone always run concurrently? No concurrency matrix from this work supports that guarantee. Switch one path at a time and observe permission, routing and interruptions. Do not repeatedly start capture to bypass system messages. Does inline playback guarantee autoplay and lock-screen use? No. Page implementation, system policy, audio session and actual versions still matter. Configuration is not acceptance of every site or background scenario. Does page read-aloud establish microphone permission? No. Media output, microphone authorization, page capture and server identity/write authority are separate layers. Check actual prompts independently. How can I check read-aloud was not captured as my speech? Stop this playback first, then inspect recognition of a single synthetic phrase. Loopback/echo needs actual device evidence; voiceChat settings do not guarantee zero echo or speaker-verification accuracy. Does stopping web voice recall data already sent to a service? Not as a general promise. Stop, recall, remote retention and history sync differ. Follow the actual service policy; this page supplies no universal remote-delete function. Guides and evidence Bluetooth input diagnosis · Weak-network handoff · Voice-draft comparison · Multiple-note review · Start · Privacy Evidence: WebKit configuration , native audio policy , README boundaries .

### 多段语音笔记怎样人工汇总？保留来源、冲突与待办确认

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multi-note-review-handoff/

多段语音笔记怎样人工汇总？保留来源、冲突与待办确认 汇总多个记录不等于App已经提供自动合并或去重 一呼现有笔记保留各自的本地音频、转写与交接状态。本文给出手工比较多条笔记的检查顺序：先保留来源，再标出重复、矛盾、缺失和未确认待办，最后决定是否在已有获准工具中整理。它不是一呼自动拼接音频、跨笔记合并、任务提取或去重功能；编辑出的新摘要也不能消除原交接的不确定性。 先分清三个“多段” 一条录音的识别分段 ：当前处理按音频帧切窗口，仍属于同一条笔记，不自动提供说话人或议题结构。 多条独立记录 ：各自可能有不同时间、目标、文字状态与一次交接标记，不能只看标题相似就认为同一次讨论。 编辑后的汇总稿 ：是人工整理材料，必须保留事实、提案与未决项的区别，不是App中的原始音频或已批准任务清单。 多记录核对表 核对维度 为每条来源保留 汇总规则 应停止的情况 来源定位 非敏感的样例记录代号和段落位置 每个结论能找到对应原文 来源无法确认就标待核，不虚构引文 时间/顺序 原文明确提供的时间或未知 区分录音顺序、事件时间与编辑时间 不用文件排列推断事件先后 转写完成度 pending/失败/完成和已核范围 中断接缝、数字与否定词单独检查 不把未完成段落写成完整纪要 重复表达 两处原文及上下文 人工标疑似重复，保留证据位置 不凭相似句自动删除来源 矛盾版本 各版本原句及确认情况 把冲突单列待确认 不把最后出现或语气坚定视为批准 待办候选 建议动作和已有确认依据 未批准项保留“待确认”，不直接执行 缺授权、目标或确认流程就不交付执行 既有交接 每条笔记是否尝试填入/暂存及结果 已有内容先查目的地再整理后续 不清标记、自动重试或换摘要规避限制 副本/目的地 本地、剪贴板、文档或工作台范围 只交接必要且获准内容 不把删汇总稿当作所有副本撤回 两条合成笔记的冲突走读 样例A ：“建议示例清单先核三项；尚未决定负责人。” 样例B ：“示例清单可能改成两项；需下次确认，不执行。” 正确汇总是“条目数存在三项/两项两个未确认版本，负责人未定，下一步仅核对”，不是“已批准两项并安排执行”。这两句不代表真实会议、真实用户或已完成设备测试。本网页不会录音或调用Agent，也不提供合并按钮。 若用现有文档工具整理，应先核对账户、同步和权限；不要把原始录音或私人正文上传到未获准的服务。字段组织可参考人工纪要模板，但该模板同样不是App导入schema。 从汇总稿到待办的检查顺序 找到明确的动作候选及原文，保留条件语气、未知项和冲突。 查是否存在独立确认依据与获准目标；不存在就保持待确认，不凭推测填写负责人或期限。 查看原记录是否已有交接尝试，先核对目的地已有内容，避免汇总造成重复。 只在既有且获准流程中进一步整理；不因文本看起来像待办就创建真实台账或调用回复接口。 记录当前实际状态：本地整理、待核、草稿可见或结果不确定。只有相应证据才能称为已发送、已记录或已处理。 一次交接和长度边界仍保留 单条笔记在显式填入或托盘暂存前保留一次交接标记，写不成就拒绝；失败或不确定时保留原文，不自动尝试另一交接路径。当前直接填入有3000个 Swift Character门槛，较长文字走已有Markdown暂存路径；不能把多条拼成新摘要当作规避标记或发送资格的方法。 手动复制也会产生副本和潜在重复，本文的人工核对不构成自动去重或端到端绝对一次保证。音频分段、笔记汇总、附件暂存、发送与任务执行各有独立边界。 FAQ 一呼现在能一键合并多条笔记吗？ 本页不声明这种能力。现有源码是单条笔记录音、分段转写、保留原文和显式交接；这里的汇总是人工编辑建议，不增加App功能。 多条转写放在一起就是无缝音频拼接吗？ 不是。文字整理不改变原音频，也不证明段落时间连续、说话人相同或接缝无遗漏；每条音频与状态须分别保留。 两个版本冲突，能选最后一条当最终决定吗？ 不应仅据顺序这样做。保留两个版本及来源，等待独立确认；提案、更新和批准不是同一件事。 识别到动作句就可以自动建待办吗？ 本页不提供自动建任务。动作候选仍需原文、目标、授权与已有确认流程；条件句或建议不能当作执行许可。 汇总后改名能重新交接已尝试过的内容吗？ 不能用改名绕过一次交接或不确定停止。先核对目的地，人工复制也可能重复；新的编辑稿不证明旧尝试未发生。 保留汇总后可以保证删原文也不会丢依据吗？ 不能。汇总可能省略上下文与否定词；删除/备份/副本又是独立问题。按实际保留需求和规则处理，不由本文承诺恢复或撤回结果。 继续阅读与依据 人工纪要与简报字段 · 录音笔记显式交接 · 网页朗读与输入切换 · Radar JSON空值检查 · 开始 · 隐私 来源： 笔记模型 、 笔记处理与一次交接 、 README 。

### Review multiple voice notes: sources, conflicts and unconfirmed to-dos

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multi-note-review-handoff/

Review multiple voice notes: sources, conflicts and unconfirmed to-dos An editorial summary is not automatic merging or deduplication Existing Yihu notes retain their own local audio, transcript and handoff state. This guide suggests manually comparing sources, marking repetition/conflicts/gaps and checking unconfirmed to-dos before organizing text in an already authorized tool. It does not implement audio joining, cross-note merging, task extraction or deduplication. A new summary cannot erase uncertainty about an original handoff. Three meanings of multiple segments Recognition segments within one recording : current processing divides audio frames into windows, still within one note. It does not automatically identify speakers or topics. Independent notes : each can have different times, targets, text states and a one-handoff marker. Similar titles do not establish the same discussion. An edited summary : a manual document that must distinguish facts, proposals and open questions; it is neither original app audio nor an approved task list. Multi-record review table Dimension Retain per source Editorial rule Stop condition Source location Non-sensitive sample label and passage location Trace each conclusion back to its original Mark unknown rather than inventing quotations Time/order Explicit source time or unknown Separate recording order, event time and editing time File ordering is not event chronology Transcript completion Pending/failed/completed state and actual reviewed scope Check joins, numbers and negations separately Incomplete passages are not complete minutes Repeated wording Both passages with context Manually flag possible repetition and preserve locations Do not automatically delete a source based on similarity Conflicting versions Each original statement and confirmation status Put conflicts into a separate confirmation queue Last-mentioned or assertive wording is not approval Candidate to-dos Suggested action and existing confirmation evidence Keep unapproved items pending, without execution Stop without authority, destination or a confirmation process Prior handoff Each note’s insertion/staging attempt and result Inspect destination content before further organizing Do not clear markers, retry automatically or evade guards with summaries Copies/destination Local, clipboard, document and workbench scope Hand off only necessary authorized content Deleting a summary does not recall every copy A conflict in two synthetic notes Sample A : “Suggest checking three sample items first; no owner has been decided.” Sample B : “The sample might become two items; confirm next time, do not execute.” A faithful summary is “two unconfirmed counts, three versus two; owner undecided; next step is review only,” not “two items approved and scheduled.” These phrases are not a real meeting, real people or a completed device test. This page does not record, invoke an Agent or supply a merge button. If using an existing document tool, check its account, sync and permissions first. Do not upload originals/private content to an unauthorized service. The manual minutes template can organize fields, but it is not an app import schema either. From a summary to a candidate action Locate the candidate action in its source and retain conditions, unknowns and conflicts. Find separate confirmation and an authorized destination. Without them, keep it pending rather than inferring owners or deadlines. Inspect prior handoff attempts and destination text before creating another copy through summarization. Continue only through an existing authorized workflow. Task-like prose is not permission to create ledger items or call reply endpoints. Record the actual stage: organized locally, awaiting review, visible draft or uncertain. Sent, recorded and handled each need their own evidence. One handoff and length limits still apply Each note reserves one marker before explicit insertion or share-tray staging; failure to reserve refuses handoff. A failed/uncertain attempt retains originals without automatic redirection. Direct insertion currently has a 3,000 Swift Character threshold; longer text uses existing Markdown staging. Combining notes into a summary is not a way to bypass markers or eligibility. Manual copying creates another copy and can duplicate content. Editorial review does not establish automatic deduplication or end-to-end exactly-once delivery. Audio segmentation, editorial summaries, attachment staging, sending and execution remain distinct boundaries. FAQ Can Yihu merge several notes with one button? This page makes no such claim. Existing source covers single-note recording, segmented transcription, retained originals and explicit handoff. The comparison workflow is manual guidance, not new functionality. Does putting transcripts together join audio seamlessly? No. Text editing does not modify original audio or establish continuous timing, the same speaker or lossless joins. Preserve each audio record and its state separately. Can the last conflicting note be treated as the final decision? Not merely because of its order. Preserve both versions and locations until separate confirmation. Proposals, updates and approvals are different facts. Can an action sentence automatically create a to-do? No task-creation automation is supplied here. A candidate still needs source evidence, destination, authority and an existing confirmation process. Conditional suggestions do not authorize execution. Can renaming a summary permit another handoff of attempted content? Do not rename to bypass one-handoff or uncertain-stop guards. Inspect the destination first; manual copying can duplicate. New editorial text does not prove an old attempt never happened. Does a summary guarantee originals can be removed without losing evidence? No. Summaries may omit context/negations, while deletion, backup and copies are separate. Follow actual retention needs and rules; this page guarantees neither recovery nor recall. Reading and evidence Manual minutes/brief fields · Explicit recording-note handoff · Web read-aloud/input transition · Radar JSON/null checks · Start · Privacy Sources: note model , processing/one-handoff reservation , README .

### 外贸简报接入PM Radar前：JSON类型、空值与缺失字段核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-json-null-validation/

外贸简报接入PM Radar前：JSON类型、空值与缺失字段核对 语法正确的JSON不一定能被Radar解码，更不代表业务数据完整 先确认文件来自有权使用的自有台账，再核JSON语法、模型字段类型、解码后的验证和业务含义。一呼使用现有PM Radar模型读取快照，不把任意外贸简报当作任务数据。缺字段、显式 null 、空字符串和空数组不能混为一谈；本文的合成样例只帮助解释契约，不连接真实源、转换纪要或启用回复。 四层检查，不用“JSON有效”代替全部验收 语法 ：括号、引号和数据字面值能解析，只是第一层。 模型类型 ：必需字符串/数组及可选字段要符合Swift Codable声明；字符串数字或空对象不能随意代替原类型。 解码后验证 ：来源日期须能解析、大小不超过2 MiB；非空项目/标题、项目记录、标识与时间戳还有源码校验。 业务范围 ：数据源是否完整、是否旧缓存、筛选是否遮蔽任务、字段有没有权限与来源依据，需要另行核对。解析通过不等于信息真实、可写或最新。 字段、null与空集合对照 字段位置 模型形态 缺失/null/空值的区别 核对建议 date_str 必需String，另需可解析来源时间 缺失或null不满足必需类型；空/无效日期不满足后续验证 使用来源最后成功读取时间，不填手机点刷新时间 decisions 必需Action数组 []是已提供的空子集；缺失/null不是空数组 不把空待处理子集当完整台账无任务 active/stale/cold 三个必需Project数组 []表示该集合为空；不能用projects数组替代三个键 合并projects是模型计算属性，不是导入替代键 tasks 可选Action数组 缺失或null会回退decisions；[]是明确提供的空全任务集合，不触发回退 区分旧源范围不完整与明确的空全量集合 Action.project/title 必需String并验证非空白 null/缺失/数字不符合类型；空白值不满足验证 project应对应来源项目标识，不靠名称猜测 Action.next/url 必需String null/缺失不符合类型；字符串存在不等于动作有授权或链接可安全访问 不把字段可解码当成可执行命令或URL认证 Action.status/id/priority/timestamp等 可选String或可选Double，按字段分别核类型 可选字段可缺失/null；错误类型不等于“未知” 状态缺失保留未知；任务timestamp不是来源date_str Project.name/path/timestamp/message 必需String/String/Double/String 项目名/路径另验证非空，timestamp须在源码有效数值范围 不把null时间替换为当前时刻，message不作写权限 reply_supported/source_refreshing/source_refresh_failed 可选Bool 缺失/null不同于明确true；字符串true不是Bool 可读、正在刷新与可写分别判断，不补默认能力 最小合成样例：可选null与必需数组 { "date_str" : "2026-10-18 09:00" , "decisions" : [], "active" : [], "stale" : [], "cold" : [], "tasks" : [ { "id" : "sample-check-1" , "project" : "sample" , "status" : null , "priority" : null , "timestamp" : null , "title" : "核对合成简报字段，不执行" , "next" : "仅检查来源与类型，不发送回复" , "url" : "https://example.invalid/tasks/sample-check-1" } ], "reply_supported" : false , "source_refreshing" : false , "source_refresh_failed" : false } 固定日期是历史演示数据，不因本文发布而变新。所有链接使用保留的 example.invalid ，没有可连接的服务。 tasks 里有记录不强制本例必须带项目活动记录；项目数组与任务集合表达不同信息。 status: null 表示未提供状态，不把该任务推断为已完成或被阻塞。 reply_supported: false 明确不宣称可写，但即使改成true也不产生服务端授权。 可以对照三个差异： "tasks": null 会回退待处理子集； "tasks": [] 不回退；把 "title" 改成null或数字不是合法的“未知标题”。本页不提供修改真实台账的命令，也不把样例结构检查冒充已跑过Swift真机导入。 空值修复应回来源，不掩盖失败 不要把失败读取产生的空对象补成“全部完成”，也不要为了让页面有卡片而复制旧源改日期。源缺 tasks 时应明确范围不完整；源有 tasks: [] 时仍要确认导出范围、权限与业务含义。额外未知键不替代模型需要的键，JSON语法工具也不会检查读写权限。 处理询盘或跟进数据时，继续使用团队已获准的导出流程。本文没有海关/市场情报接口、抓客户名单、自动发信、纪要转任务或通用JSON转换服务；字段中的文字不能被当作对Agent的执行指令。 FAQ tasks缺失、null和[]为什么不相同？ 可选数组缺失或null解码为未提供，当前模型回退 decisions ；空数组表示明确提供空全任务集合。回退只保证旧格式可读，不证明范围完整。 可选字段可以填任意类型吗？ 不可以。可选只允许未提供/null，并不取消原有String、Double或Bool类型约束；把数字写成字符串也不能据此称为合法未知值。 时间未知可以用现在或0代替吗？ 不要伪造来源时间。任务可选timestamp缺失/null与来源必需date_str不同；必需项目时间和日期应由来源提供，类型可解析仍不代表内容新鲜。 只有projects数组能替代active/stale/cold吗？ 不能。 projects 是模型合并三数组的计算属性，不能让缺少必需导入数组的文件自动变正确。项目path与任务project的语义关联也要核对。 页面样例检查通过代表App接受导入吗？ 不代表。页面和前端测试只核示例/说明，不能替代实际版本的Swift解码、文件边界、真机和来源权限验收。 纪要字段模板能直接当外贸Radar简报导入吗？ 不能。人工编辑字段与现有Radar模型是两份契约；需已有且获准的导出流程，本页不新增转换、数据源或写授权。 相关指南与实现 多项目Radar与Watch · 弱网缓存排障 · 纪要与简报编辑字段 · 多段笔记待办核对 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar模型与decode校验 、 源读取与缓存 、 README源与回复边界 。

### Before a trade brief reaches PM Radar: JSON types, nulls and missing fields

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-json-null-validation/

Before a trade brief reaches PM Radar: JSON types, nulls and missing fields Valid JSON syntax does not establish model decoding or complete business data First verify that a file is an authorized export from your own ledger, then check syntax, model types, post-decode validation and business meaning. Yihu reads the existing PM Radar snapshot contract, not arbitrary trade briefs. Missing fields, explicit null , empty strings and empty arrays are not interchangeable. This synthetic example explains the contract without connecting to a real source, converting minutes or enabling replies. Four checks, not one valid-JSON label Syntax : parsable brackets, quotes and literals are only the first layer. Model types : required strings/arrays and optional fields must match Swift Codable declarations. Stringified numbers and empty objects cannot substitute freely. Post-decode validation : source date must parse and input is bounded to 2 MiB. Nonempty project/title values, project records, identities and timestamps have additional source checks. Business scope : completeness, old cache, filtering, permission and evidence still need review. Parsing does not prove truth, freshness or write authority. Fields, nulls and empty collections Location Model shape Missing/null/empty distinction Review rule date_str Required String, then a parsable source time Missing/null fail required type; empty/invalid date fails later validation Use the last successful source read, not a refresh-tap time decisions Required Action array [] is a supplied empty subset; missing/null are not empty arrays Empty pending scope is not proof of no ledger tasks active/stale/cold Three required Project arrays [] means that collection is empty; projects cannot replace the three keys Combined projects is a computed property, not an alternate import key tasks Optional Action array Missing/null fall back to decisions; [] is an explicitly empty ledger and does not fall back Distinguish incomplete legacy scope from supplied empty full scope Action.project/title Required String, validated as nonblank Missing/null/numbers fail type; whitespace fails validation project belongs to source identity, not guessed display names Action.next/url Required String Missing/null fail type; a string does not establish authority or safe navigation Decodable text is not an executable command or URL certification Action.status/id/priority/timestamp and others Optional String or Double, per field Optional fields can be absent/null; wrong types are not unknown values Keep absent status unknown; task timestamp is not source date_str Project.name/path/timestamp/message Required String/String/Double/String Name/path must be nonblank; timestamp must fit source numeric bounds Do not replace null time with now; message does not grant writes reply_supported/source_refreshing/source_refresh_failed Optional Bool Missing/null do not establish true; string true is not Bool Readability, refreshing and write authority remain distinct Minimal synthetic example: optional nulls and required arrays { "date_str" : "2026-10-18 09:00" , "decisions" : [], "active" : [], "stale" : [], "cold" : [], "tasks" : [ { "id" : "sample-check-1" , "project" : "sample" , "status" : null , "priority" : null , "timestamp" : null , "title" : "Check synthetic brief fields; take no action" , "next" : "Inspect source and types only; send no reply" , "url" : "https://example.invalid/tasks/sample-check-1" } ], "reply_supported" : false , "source_refreshing" : false , "source_refresh_failed" : false } The fixed date is historical demo data, not fresh because this page was published. Links use reserved example.invalid , with no reachable service. A record in tasks does not force this example to include project-activity records; those arrays express different information. status: null means no status supplied, not completed or blocked. reply_supported: false claims no write support; even true would not grant server permission. Compare three variations: "tasks": null falls back to the pending subset; "tasks": [] does not; a null/numeric title is not a valid unknown title. This page supplies no command to modify a real ledger and does not call example checks a completed Swift/device import. Repair at the source, not by hiding a failure Do not turn an empty failed response into “all complete,” or relabel copied old data with a fresh date to produce cards. Missing tasks requires an incomplete-scope interpretation; supplied tasks: [] still needs export-scope, permission and business checks. Extra unknown keys do not replace required keys, and JSON syntax tools do not verify read/write permission. For inquiry/follow-up data, use the team’s existing authorized export workflow. This page adds no customs/market API, lead scraper, automatic email, minutes-to-task conversion or universal JSON service. Text fields are not instructions authorizing an Agent to execute. FAQ Why do missing tasks, null and [] differ? Absent/null optional arrays mean not supplied, so the current model falls back to decisions . An empty array explicitly supplies empty full scope. Legacy readability does not prove completeness. Can optional fields use any type? No. Optional permits absence/null, not replacement of String, Double or Bool constraints. A number encoded as text is not automatically a valid unknown value. Can unknown time be replaced with now or zero? Do not fabricate source time. Optional task timestamps differ from required source date_str ; required project times/dates belong to the source. A parsable value alone does not establish freshness. Can a projects array replace active/stale/cold? No. projects combines those three arrays as a computed model property. It cannot supply missing required import arrays; task-project/project-path meaning still needs review. Do passing page example checks establish app import acceptance? No. Frontend/example checks do not replace actual-version Swift decoding, file limits, device acceptance or source permission verification. Can the editorial minutes template be imported as a trade Radar brief? No. Editorial labels and the Radar model are different contracts. Use an existing authorized export workflow; no converter, data feed or write authority is added here. Guides and implementation Radar and Watch · Weak-network/cache diagnosis · Editorial minutes/brief fields · Multiple-note/to-do review · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar model/decode validation , source reads/cache , README source/reply boundaries .

### 首次试用前的五分钟评估卡：条件、责任人与继续/停止决定

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/first-trial-go-no-go-checklist/

首次试用前的五分钟评估卡：条件、责任人与继续/停止决定 五分钟用于判断条件是否齐备，不承诺五分钟装好或接通 一呼目前是源码发行，需自己的签名配置、兼容模型和自有HTTPS工作台。这张评估卡帮助在投入构建或真实试用前明确“已有、未知、缺失、由谁确认”，不运行录音、不写任务、不创建服务。参考时间盒是五分钟，未确认项可以直接留下并停止；真正配置步骤见接入指南，不用快速评估替代安装或设备验收。 与接入教程不同：先作继续或停止决定 如果只是想立刻加入多人语音频道，当前浏览器壳不应按该目标评估；如果没有自己的Agent工作台，也不能从官网演示推断已有后端。若需求是把可核对文字交给自己的网页草稿，才继续检查条件。页面可浏览、模型可用、麦克风获准和服务写权限须分别记录。 试用责任与条件表 条件 要找的现有依据 由谁确认（角色，不填私人信息） 本次继续/停止边界 目标需求 需要的是Agent网页草稿/笔记，而非已验收对讲频道 使用者 需求不匹配就停止选型，不硬凑适用场景 安装/签名 已有源码构建环境、自有Team/Bundle/App Group安排 设备/构建维护者 未确认不借用签名、不声称有App Store安装包 自有工作台 自己已有且有权访问的可信HTTPS origin 工作台维护者 无服务就停；一呼不托管Agent后端 网页会话 当前手机的访问/登录情况，与原生源会话分开 账号持有人按已有流程 不索要他人凭据，不为试用放宽TLS或权限 模型 实际版本的兼容模型已下载、校验并可用 模型/设备使用者 缺模型不跳过校验，不承诺离线转写 录音条件 用户麦克风权限和允许录音的安全环境 使用者 本评估卡不请求权限、不实际录音 合成草稿 获准空白输入框，已确认不会自动执行/提交 工作台与使用者 不用真实任务、订单或顾客内容试探 目标边界 一条合成语句只到草稿；未兼容时保留文字 使用者 结果未知或宿主拒绝就停，不盲目发送/重试 四种评估结果，不用百分比分数掩盖缺口 可进入原接入流程 ：已有证据、责任清楚且只是获准合成草稿试用；这不等于功能已验收。 等某项确认 ：例如签名或服务由维护者确认，记录角色与待确认事项，不填写推测结果。 条件缺失 ：例如没有自有工作台或兼容模型，先停止相应试用，不在此创建付费服务、账号或公网入口。 目标不匹配 ：例如需要独立手表审批或现场群组对讲，明确停止，不用网页能打开来替代所需能力。 不建议给这些项目简单打“完成率”。一个未获准的目标或缺失的服务，不能被其他几项已准备抵消；静态官网演示也不能被计作设备证据。 一张合成评估记录 评估目标：把一句示例清单留在自有工作台草稿 已有依据：已知目标是未发送草稿，不执行 未知：自有签名与模型状态尚待维护者确认 本次决定：等待确认，不录音、不发送、不改配置 下一步：按接入指南核条件，而非创建新账号/服务 这是人工决策记录，不是App的配置导入格式，也不会自动更改设置。不要把Team标识、个人账号、工作台令牌或真实录音填入公开示例。 FAQ 五分钟内保证能安装和完成首个草稿吗？ 不保证。五分钟只是短评估时间盒，允许带着未知项停止；源码构建、签名、模型下载和服务条件可能需要独立准备。 官网演示能作为自己的设备配置完成证据吗？ 不能。官网播放合成内容且不连接你的工作台或麦克风；实际版本、签名、权限与目标兼容须另外核对。 没有工作台账号可以让一呼自动开通吗？ 本页不提供账号开通或托管服务。一呼不供应Agent后端，应由你现有的获准服务流程处理，不能把示例origin当成可用系统。 为了快速试用可以先关闭证书或验证吗？ 不可以。TLS、模型校验、声纹所需模型、宿主拒绝与写授权不能因时间盒而绕过，缺条件就停止该步骤。 评估通过是否包括Radar真实回复与通知？ 不包括。回复需独立服务端写权限、手机确认和回读；通知、Watch配对等另有前提，草稿条件齐备不能替代这些验收。 等待条件补齐后要从哪里继续？ 先重新核对目标和已有内容，再进入既有接入指南；若已有交接不确定结果，先按原状态处理，不能把新评估当作重试许可。 继续阅读 实际配置与首次草稿流程 · 选型需求对照 · 静止场景预检 · 隐私 依据： README构建、模型与服务边界 。本页仅人工试用决策，不进行安装、授权、录音或服务操作。
