### A five-minute pre-trial decision card: prerequisites, ownership and go/no-go

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/first-trial-go-no-go-checklist/

A five-minute pre-trial decision card: prerequisites, ownership and go/no-go Five minutes is a decision timebox, not a setup or performance promise Yihu is currently a source release requiring your own signing configuration, compatible models and HTTPS workbench. Before building or trying real device paths, use this card to distinguish available, unknown and missing prerequisites and who confirms them. It records no audio, writes no task and provisions no service. You may stop with unresolved items; actual setup remains in the connection guide, and quick evaluation is not installation/device acceptance. Decide first rather than duplicating setup instructions If you need an immediately available group voice channel, do not evaluate this browser shell as that product. Without your own Agent workbench, a website demo does not establish a supplied backend. Continue these checks when the intended outcome is reviewable text in your own draft. Web access, model availability, microphone permission and service-write authority need separate records. Prerequisites and responsible roles Prerequisite Existing evidence to find Who confirms (role, not private identity) Go/no-go boundary Intended outcome Agent web drafts/notes, not an accepted intercom channel User Stop on a mismatch rather than inventing an applicable scenario Build/signing Existing source-build tools and own Team/Bundle/App Group arrangements Device/build maintainer Do not borrow signing or claim an App Store binary Own workbench Existing authorized, trusted HTTPS origin Workbench maintainer Stop without a service; Yihu does not host Agents Web session Actual phone access/login, separate from native feed reads Account owner through existing procedures No requests for others’ credentials or relaxed TLS/permission Model Actual compatible model downloaded, verified and available Device/model user Missing models are not bypassed; no offline-recognition promise Recording setting User microphone permission and a safe permitted environment User This decision card does not request permission or record Synthetic draft Authorized empty composer known not to execute/submit automatically Workbench owner and user No real tasks, orders or customer content for probing Stop point One synthetic phrase ending at a draft; text retained if incompatible User Stop on uncertainty/refusal rather than blindly sending or retrying Four decisions, not a misleading completion score Ready to enter the existing setup flow : evidence and ownership are clear for an authorized synthetic-draft trial. This is not feature acceptance. Waiting for confirmation : signing or service arrangements may need the maintainer. Record the role and question, not an inferred answer. Missing prerequisite : stop the affected trial without a workbench/model; do not create paid services, accounts or public ports here. Wrong product fit : standalone Watch approval or group field intercom needs are not satisfied by opening a web page. A missing authorized destination cannot be offset by several other checked boxes. Do not score the website demo as evidence from your own device. One synthetic decision record Goal: Keep one sample checklist in an own-workbench draft Known: The intended endpoint is unsent text, without execution Unknown: Own signing and model state need maintainer confirmation Decision: Wait; do not record, send or change configuration Next: Follow the existing setup guide, not account/service provisioning This is a manual decision record, not an app configuration/import format. It changes no settings. Do not put Team identifiers, personal accounts, service tokens or real audio into public examples. FAQ Is installation and a first draft guaranteed in five minutes? No. Five minutes is only a short evaluation timebox that can end with unknowns. Builds, signing, downloads and service readiness may require separate preparation. Does the website demo establish my device is configured? No. It plays synthetic material without accessing your microphone/workbench. Actual app version, signing, permissions and destination compatibility need their own checks. Can Yihu provision a workbench account for me? No account or hosted service is offered here. Use your existing authorized service process; an example origin is not a working system supplied by Yihu. Can I disable certificate or verification checks for a quick trial? No. A timebox does not bypass TLS, model verification, required speaker models, host refusal or write authority. Stop when prerequisites are absent. Does a go decision include Radar writes and notifications? No. Replies need separate server authority, phone confirmation/readback. Notifications and Watch pairing have independent prerequisites; draft readiness does not accept them. Where should I resume after missing prerequisites are confirmed? Recheck the target and existing content before entering the connection guide. Resolve prior handoff uncertainty through its existing state; a new evaluation does not authorize resending. Continue reading Actual setup and first-draft flow · Tool-fit comparison · Stationary preflight · Privacy Evidence: README build/model/service boundaries . This is manual trial planning, without installation, authorization, recording or service operations.

### 一条会议录音怎样分段人工复核？标签、数字与否定词核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/recording-segment-review-labels/

一条会议录音怎样分段人工复核？标签、数字与否定词核对 识别窗口不是会议章节，人工标签也不是App原生标注 一呼的录音笔记按16 kHz音频帧处理，当前分段窗口最多28秒，在末8秒范围寻找低能量切点。该策略不是议题划分、说话人分离、逐字时间轴或准确率证明。本文针对同一条记录，建议用“样例段A/B”等人工编辑标签定位待核文字；不修改音频、不新增App标注功能，也不替代原文与实际录音核对。 与多条笔记汇总的分工 多笔记指南比较不同记录的时间、冲突和交接状态；这里先解决一条记录内部哪些字句还未核对。把原文分成便于人工阅读的小块，并不意味着它们恰好等于识别器音频窗口。不能从段落长度倒推出时间，也不能把人工编号写成App生成的章节ID。 单记录语义复核表 检查项 人工记录什么 合成风险例子 正确处理边界 引用定位 样例段代号和保留的原句 段A与段B引用混淆 标签只用于编辑定位，保留原文，不假造秒数 数字与单位 原句中的数量、币种、时间单位 三项/两项、天/周不同 不补猜测值，不把无单位数字当金额 否定词 不、未、无需等原文及已核范围 “不发送”误写成“发送” 未核就保持待确认，不生成执行指令 条件语气 如果、建议、待批准等限定 “可考虑”被摘要成“已批准” 条件与提案单列，不冒确认结论 分段接缝 接缝前后原句与可检查材料 同一语句可能跨窗口 不以拼接流畅证明无遗漏或重复 说话人 明确可核实的来源或未知 根据语气猜某角色发言 不声称自动声纹分离或身份认证 核对范围 哪些片段/字段已核、哪些待核 一段已核被当作全文通过 只记录实际范围，不给未听段落盖章 后续交接 核后文本目的地及既有笔记状态 改完片段就重复填入 原有一次交接/不确定停止边界不变 同一记录的两个合成片段 人工标签：样例段A（不是App时间戳） 原句：建议示例清单保留三项，不发送。 待核：三项的数量；“不发送”的否定词。 人工标签：样例段B（不是说话人标签） 原句：如果下次确认改成两项，再更新示例清单；现在未批准。 待核：条件“如果”、两项与三项的关系、批准状态。 人工复核结论：条目数有条件变化，当前无执行批准；仅保留待核。 不能把A和B缩写成“确认两项并发送”。样例只解释复核方法，不是真实会议证据，也不是这次已经跑过的录音/识别测试。应在获准的安全环境里检查实际音频和文字；无法核实就保留未知，不要求把真实录音交给本站。 从片段复核到纪要草稿 先保留每条原句与标签，再把可支持的事实、未确认提案和问题分开。若某个数字或否定词没有证据，不要为了表格完整而补上。人工标签可放在已有受控文档中，它的保存、同步、备份与访问规则由该工具决定，不会自动同步为一呼字段或Radar任务。 之后可以参考既有人工纪要字段指南，把 review_state 限定为真正核过的范围。即使用其他获准模型辅助整理，也应对照来源；模型输出不是原始音频、独立批准或后续执行回执。 FAQ 一呼会自动给每段音频添加章节标签吗？ 本文不声明这种功能。样例段代号是人工编辑标签，不是App时间戳、导出字段或持久化章节模型。 每个文字段落是否刚好对应28秒音频？ 不是。28秒是当前最大处理窗口，实际切点和最后窗口不同，文字段落也不代表时间轴。不能由此承诺任意录音时长或精确对齐。 用标签写“角色A”能算说话人识别吗？ 不能。未核实的角色必须保持未知；人工标签、声纹便利过滤和身份认证是不同能力，不能互相替代。 拼接后读起来通顺就代表无错字吗？ 不代表。数字、否定、单位和条件可能仍错；源码拼接规则不是语义正确性或接缝无损保证。 复核了一段，可以把整份纪要标为已批准吗？ 不能。片段核对、全文核对与批准各需证据；确认范围不应扩大，更不能把提案当作已经可执行。 改好标签和片段后，可以自动再交接一次吗？ 不可以。原笔记已有的交接尝试仍需核对，不确定时先查目的地，不能用编辑稿绕过一次标记或制造盲目重试。 继续核对与源码 录音笔记实现边界 · 人工纪要字段 · 多条笔记汇总 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 分段与文本拼接实现 、 笔记模型 。本页不提供真机准确率、自动纪要或新标注功能。

<td>明确可核实的来源或未知</td>
<td>根据语气猜某角色发言</td>
<td>不声称自动声纹分离或身份认证</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>核对范围</td>
<td>哪些片段/字段已核、哪些待核</td>
<td>一段已核被当作全文通过</td>
<td>只记录实际范围，不给未听段落盖章</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>后续交接</td>
<td>核后文本目的地及既有笔记状态</td>
<td>改完片段就重复填入</td>
<td>原有一次交接/不确定停止边界不变</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Review one meeting recording: manual labels, numbers and negations

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/recording-segment-review-labels/

Review one meeting recording: manual labels, numbers and negations Recognition windows are not chapters, and editorial labels are not app annotations Yihu notes process 16 kHz audio frames in current windows of up to 28 seconds, searching the last eight seconds for a low-energy cut. This is not topic detection, diarization, word timestamps or accuracy evidence. For one recording, use manual labels such as sample passage A/B to locate review work. This does not modify audio, add native annotations or replace checking the original transcript and recording. A different task from combining independent notes The multi-note guide compares separate records, times, conflicts and handoff states. Here the first task is identifying unchecked wording within one recording. Editorial text chunks need not match recognizer windows. Do not infer seconds from paragraph length or present a manual label as an app-generated chapter ID. Within-record semantic review table Check Editorial record Synthetic risk Boundary Source location Sample label and retained original wording Confusing passage A with B Labels locate text; retain originals without invented seconds Numbers/units Quantity, currency or time unit in the original Three versus two; days versus weeks No inferred value or assumed currency for a unitless number Negations Not, never, not yet and actual reviewed scope Do not send becomes send Keep unreviewed statements pending, not executable Conditions If, suggested, awaiting approval Could consider becomes approved Keep conditions/proposals separate from decisions Segment joins Original text on both sides and available evidence One sentence can span windows Fluent joining does not prove no gaps/duplication Speaker Verified origin or unknown Inferring a role from tone No automatic diarization or identity claim Review scope Passages/fields checked versus pending One reviewed passage treated as complete acceptance Report actual scope, not unchecked sections Handoff Edited destination and original note state Re-inserting after editing One-handoff and uncertain-stop rules remain Two synthetic passages from one record Manual label: Sample passage A (not an app timestamp) Original: Suggest keeping three sample items; do not send. Review: The number three and the negation do not send. Manual label: Sample passage B (not a speaker label) Original: If confirmed next time, change the sample to two items; not approved now. Review: The condition if, two versus three, and approval state. Editorial conclusion: A conditional count change, without execution approval; retain pending review. Do not compress these into “two items confirmed; send.” The phrases illustrate review, not a real meeting or a completed capture/recognition test. Check actual audio/text in a safe authorized environment. Preserve unknowns rather than requesting real recordings be sent to this site. From passage review to draft minutes Retain original wording and labels, then separate supported facts, unconfirmed proposals and questions. Do not fill a number or negation just to complete a table. Labels can live in an existing controlled document; that tool controls storage, sync, backup and access. They do not automatically become Yihu fields or Radar tasks. The manual minutes guide can organize a review_state limited to the genuinely reviewed scope. Even when another authorized model assists, compare against the source. Model prose is neither original audio, independent approval nor execution receipt. FAQ Does Yihu automatically attach chapter labels to audio? No feature of that kind is asserted. Sample labels are editorial references, not native timestamps, export fields or a persisted chapter model. Does each text paragraph represent exactly 28 seconds? No. Twenty-eight seconds is the current maximum processing window; cuts/final windows vary, and paragraphs are not a timeline. It proves neither arbitrary recording duration nor exact alignment. Does labeling a passage role A establish speaker recognition? No. Unverified roles stay unknown. Editorial labels, convenience speaker filtering and identity authentication are separate and cannot substitute for one another. Does fluent joined text prove correct recognition? No. Quantities, negations, units and conditions can still be wrong. Joining rules do not guarantee semantic correctness or lossless boundaries. Can one reviewed passage make the whole minutes approved? No. Passage review, full review and approval each require evidence. Do not extend the reviewed scope or turn a proposal into execution permission. Can edited passages/labels automatically trigger another handoff? No. Prior note attempts still need inspection. Check destination content on uncertainty rather than evading one-handoff markers through editing or blind retries. Reading and source Recording implementation boundaries · Manual minutes fields · Multiple-note review · Start · Privacy Evidence: segmentation and text joining , note model . No device accuracy, automatic minutes or new annotation functionality is supplied here.

### 外贸任务简报两批JSON怎样比？同源、范围与字段变化核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-snapshot-batch-comparison/

外贸任务简报两批JSON怎样比？同源、范围与字段变化核对 先确认两份数据可比，再谈新增、变化或缺失 两份能解码的JSON不一定来自同一来源、权限或导出范围。一呼可读自有Radar快照与既有缓存，但本文不声明App提供历史快照版本库或自动差异功能。这里的人工核对用于已有且获准保存的两个批次：先看同源与范围，再定位标识和字段变化；新批次看不到某条记录，不足以证明删除、完成或已处理。 与JSON类型校验的区别 类型检查回答“这一份是否符合字段形态”；批次比较回答“两份是否可比、可比范围内什么变化有依据”。不能用两份都能解析来跳过来源检查，也不能把页面筛选结果当作完整源差异。若团队处理询盘或跟进任务，这仍是通用台账数据，不是新增外贸情报、客户历史追踪或自动通知服务。 同源比较前提表 维度 先核对什么 典型误读 人工比较结论边界 来源身份 两批属于同一获准工作台/导出流程 文件名一样就当同源 无法确认就不做确定增删结论 权限/范围 账号权限、项目范围、历史项与导出选项是否一致 无权看的记录当被删除 范围变化单列，不能推断业务事件 集合 两批是否有tasks，还是旧源仅decisions 全台账与待处理子集直接相减 先匹配范围，不把子集变化当总量变化 关联标识 来源提供的任务id及project含义 相同标题就当同一任务 缺稳定依据保持未关联，不发明新ID 来源时间 date_str与读取失败/刷新状态 文件保存晚就当源更新晚 来源时间与本地导出/编辑时间分开 字段空值 原值、新值、缺失/null的区别 从P1变null就当不重要或已完成 只报告“新批未提供”，不填推测含义 排序/筛选 优先级、时间、搜索、状态与历史显示 排名变了就当任务变了 顺序变化与源字段变化分别记录 回执/处理 原任务及独立确认记录 字段变化当作回复送达或执行证明 读取差异不产生写权限、批准或执行 两批合成观察记录 下表是 人工比较记录，不是Radar导入格式 ，也不是实际业务或已执行的差异工具。 可比项 较早样例批次 较晚样例批次 只可这样描述 来源范围 自称sample范围，待核 自称sample范围，待核 来源/权限未核前，以下都只是待核观察 date_str 2026-10-18 09:00 2026-10-18 10:00 固定历史示例时间，不因当前文章变新 任务sample-A的priority P1 null 新样例未提供优先级；不能推断降级或完成 任务sample-A的status 进行中 null 新样例状态未知，不从缺失推断结果 任务sample-B 有记录 未出现 可能涉及范围/权限/集合变化，未证明删除 页面排列 sample-B先显示 sample-A先显示 顺序本身不证明源任务修改或优先级变化 如果能取得实际来源证据，再缩小到可比范围逐项核对原始字段；本文没有抓取真实数据、写回字段或发送通知。不要求为了演示保留客户信息或工作台凭据。原文、文件与比较笔记的保存/访问规则仍需团队授权。 推荐的人工差异记录 记录“来源已核/未核、批次范围、关联依据、旧值、新值、未知项、需要谁按已有流程确认”。不要把差异条目直接变为执行任务；同名项目或字段变化不提供服务端授权。若旧源缺 tasks ，明确标出子集范围，不拿它与全台账作完成率比较。 从现有界面看数据时，先核相同筛选条件。源码的优先级/时间/标题排序会改变显示顺序，缺时间字段时有保留来源顺序的规则；这不等于底层记录变了。手表接收手机已有摘要，也不是独立读取历史批次的证明。 FAQ 一呼会自动保存所有历史快照并显示差异吗？ 本文不声明这种能力，也不新增版本库。它仅指导比较你已获准取得的两份导出；现有离线缓存与可选回复历史不能被改称完整快照版本历史。 新批次找不到记录，能标为已删除或完成吗？ 不能仅凭缺失判断。先核来源、权限、集合与过滤范围；未出现不等于某个业务状态，仍需独立来源证据。 没有稳定id，能用相同标题强行关联吗？ 不应把相似标题当作可靠身份。保留未关联，询问既有导出流程是否有稳定来源依据；不要临时生成ID冒充原始身份。 priority或status变null能算已取消吗？ 不可以。可选字段未提供只能保持未知，不能自动映射成取消、完成、低优先级或删除。 文件修改时间晚，是否代表源内容更晚？ 不代表。复制、导出或编辑时间与 date_str 及任务timestamp不同，来源失败/时钟问题也需单独看待。 发现字段变化能自动发简报或回写任务吗？ 本页不提供自动发信、通知或回写。差异阅读与服务写权限、手机确认和回执是独立能力面；人工观察不能替代批准。 继续核对与依据 JSON类型与空值 · 多项目Radar与Watch · 弱网和缓存 · 人工简报字段 · 开始 · 隐私 源码依据： 字段、筛选与排序 、 来源与有界缓存 、 README读取与回复边界 。

### Compare two task-brief JSON batches: source, scope and field changes

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-snapshot-batch-comparison/

Compare two task-brief JSON batches: source, scope and field changes Establish comparability before calling records added, changed or missing Two decodable JSON files can have different sources, permissions or export scopes. Yihu reads your Radar snapshots and bounded cache; this guide does not assert a historical snapshot store or automatic diff interface. For two already authorized exports, first check source/scope, then identities and fields. A record absent from a later batch does not prove deletion, completion or handling. A separate task from JSON type validation Type checks concern one file’s shape; batch comparison asks whether two files are comparable and which differences have evidence within that scope. Parsing both does not waive source checks, and filtered page results are not full source diffs. For inquiry/follow-up teams this remains generic ledger interpretation, not a trade-intelligence feed, customer-history tracker or notification service. Comparison prerequisites Dimension Check first Common misreading Conclusion boundary Source identity Same authorized workbench/export process Same filename implies same source No definite add/remove conclusion without identity evidence Permission/scope Same account scope, projects, history and export options Invisible records were deleted Record scope differences separately, not as business events Collection tasks supplied in both versus legacy decisions-only scope Subtract pending subset from the full ledger Match scope before making total-count claims Identity Source task id and project meaning Same title means same task Keep unlinked without stable evidence; do not invent IDs Source time date_str plus failed/refreshing state Later file save means later source data Separate source read from local export/edit time Null fields Original/new values and absence/null P1 becomes null, so unimportant or complete Report not supplied, not an inferred state Sorting/filtering Priority/time/search/status/history display Changed position means changed task Display order and source-field changes are different Receipt/handling Original item and separate confirmation Field changes prove reply delivery/execution Reading differences grants no writes, approval or execution Two synthetic observation batches This is a manual comparison record, not a Radar import format , real business data or output from an executed diff tool. Item Earlier sample batch Later sample batch Supported wording only Source scope Claims sample scope; unverified Claims sample scope; unverified Observations remain pending until source/permission checks date_str 2026-10-18 09:00 2026-10-18 10:00 Fixed historical illustration, not made fresh by publication sample-A priority P1 null Later example provides no priority; no inferred downgrade/completion sample-A status In progress null Later status is unknown, not an inferred outcome sample-B Present Absent Could be scope/permission/collection difference; deletion unproven Display order sample-B first sample-A first Position alone proves neither modification nor priority change After obtaining actual source evidence, compare raw fields only within the verified common scope. This page fetches no real data, writes no fields and sends no notifications. Do not retain customer content or credentials for a public demo. Source files and comparison notes still need authorized storage/access rules. A useful manual change record Record verified/unverified source, batch scope, matching basis, old value, new value, unknowns and the role that confirms through an existing process. Do not turn differences directly into execution tasks. Same-named projects or field changes do not supply server authority. Label legacy missing- tasks scope as a subset rather than calculating completion against a full ledger. When reading through the existing interface, check identical filters. Source priority/time/title sorting can alter positions, and missing timestamps have source-order fallback rules; this does not establish modified records. A Watch receives existing phone summaries, not proof of independent historical-batch reads. FAQ Does Yihu automatically retain every snapshot and show diffs? No such capability is asserted or added. This is comparison of two exports you already have permission to use. Existing offline cache and optional reply history are not a complete snapshot version history. Can an absent later record be marked deleted or complete? Not from absence alone. Check source, permission, collection and filters first. Missing from a batch is not a business-state receipt; seek independent source evidence. Can matching titles substitute for a stable ID? Do not treat similarity as reliable identity. Leave unmatched and ask the existing export process for stable evidence. A temporary invented ID is not source identity. Can null priority/status mean canceled? No. An unsupplied optional field stays unknown; do not automatically map it to canceled, complete, low priority or deleted. Does later filesystem modification establish newer source contents? No. Copy/export/edit times differ from date_str and task timestamps. Failed reads and clock problems also need separate inspection. Can a detected change automatically email a brief or update a task? No automated email, notification or writeback is supplied. Difference reading, server authority, phone confirmation and receipts are separate capabilities; observations do not replace approval. <td>Later example provides no priority; no inferred downgrade/completion</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>sample-A status</td>
<td>In progress</td>
<td>null</td>
<td>Later status is unknown, not an inferred outcome</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>sample-B</td>
<td>Present</td>
<td>Absent</td>
<td>Could be scope/permission/collection difference; deletion unproven</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Display order</td>
<td>sample-B first</td>
<td>sample-A first</td>
<td>Position alone proves neither modification nor priority change</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### 嘈杂环境转写后怎样改文字？人工修订与草稿副本核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/noisy-transcript-text-correction/

嘈杂环境转写后怎样改文字？人工修订与草稿副本核对 先停在已有文字上，人工修改不能证明音频或所有副本已修复 噪声可能使文字出错，但一呼的音频处理设置不是噪声条件下的准确率保证。这份规程针对已经取得的转写：保留可核对的原文，确认哪里能安全编辑，再比较目的地草稿与修改稿。它不要求反复录音，不新增App纠错、版本同步或降噪功能，也不把一次人工修改当作允许再次交接的理由。 与音频排障、片段核对的分工 如果还没有音频或识别文字，先走蓝牙输入排障；如果要定位一条长录音的数字、否定词与接缝，先走片段复核。这里关注另一件事： 已有转写被人工改动后，哪些文本对象真的变了 。原生保留文字、已有受控文档、剪贴板、网页草稿和附件都可能是不同副本，不能假定一处改字会更新其他位置。 人工修订对象检查表 对象/阶段 先保留什么依据 安全核对动作 不能推断的结果 原始转写 原句与实际已核范围 用获准的原文/音频核字；不能确认就标未知 原始音频因改字而改变 修订稿 修订前后文字及修改理由 在已有获准且确实可编辑的位置修改 App有统一纠错面板或自动保存所有版本 已填入草稿 当前目标及已有未发送内容 先看是否已填入，再决定是否需要目的地人工编辑 可以自动再填一次而不重复 剪贴板 是否复制过旧版本 只在获准位置核内容与必要副本 新稿自动替换此前复制的内容 已暂存附件 托盘里的具体文字/Markdown 看实际附件版本与目标，遵守原交接状态 本地修订撤回已上传附件 模糊词 无法确认的单位、专名或否定 保持待核，询问已有确认流程 流畅或看似合理就代表真实 宿主拒绝 明确拒绝/未知编辑器的状态 保留原文并停止该路径 改几个字就可以绕过宿主守卫 不确定结果 原笔记的一次交接状态与目标已有内容 核目的地，避免新副本再交付 改写后视为全新、自动去重或绝对一次 一句合成转写的修订例子 待核识别文字：发送示例清单两项。 获准原文依据：不发送示例清单；条目数量尚未确认。 人工修订建议：不发送；条目数量待确认。 尚未完成：目的地旧草稿是否已出现，以及那里是否仍为旧句。 错误做法是为了让句子完整而把“两项”保留下来，或看到新稿就认定网页旧稿也已经修复。样例不是实际录音结果；不应使用顾客对话、订单或私人会议材料公开复现。若没有可核实依据，只能注明未知，不能发明正确句子。 修订到交接的单路径步骤 先确认安全静止环境和文字来源，停止不必要的本次播放/录音，不用提高音量或连续重录来追求未测性能。 区分“原文供核对”与“拟采用修订稿”，记录修改理由；本文不规定App内有特定编辑控件。 查当前目的地是否已有旧文字，确认是获准的未发送草稿而不是终端、正在发送界面或未知编辑器。 如需在目的地手工编辑，先核该宿主自己的草稿/同步规则；不强行注入、不自动按发送。 原笔记若已尝试交接或结果不明，继续保持一次标记和不确定停止。文本修订不取消既有状态，手动复制也可能造成重复。 FAQ 改好文字是否证明一呼能在噪声中稳定识别？ 不能。人工修订与模型原始识别成绩不同；本页没有耳机型号、噪声级别、准确率或风噪性能数据。 一呼是否有本文规定的自动纠错或逐句编辑功能？ 本文不声明这种功能。只在实际已有且获准可编辑的工具/草稿中人工处理，不根据指南推断新App界面。 改了本地一份文字，网页和附件会一起更新吗？ 不能这样假定。原文、剪贴板、草稿和附件分别核对，同步/保存取决于各目的地；本文不提供跨副本自动更新。 修订后可以清除标记再填入一次吗？ 不可以用修订绕过一次交接。先核目的地已有内容；不确定结果保持停止，不能把重新复制当作去重保证。 无法确定一个数字或人名怎么办？ 保留待核而不是按上下文猜测。只使用获准依据与确认流程，不把推测写成已经核实或批准的结论。 修订并删除旧本地稿能撤回服务已收到的内容吗？ 不能据此承诺。已上传、同步或发送的副本需按实际服务规则处理；本地删除与远端撤回是不同操作。 继续阅读与依据 蓝牙输入排障 · 单录音片段核对 · 原文与一次交接 · 跨部门认领归档 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 草稿填入与拒绝守卫 、 笔记交接模型 、 README 。

### After noisy dictation: manual text correction and draft-copy checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/noisy-transcript-text-correction/

After noisy dictation: manual text correction and draft-copy checks Work from existing text; editing does not repair audio or every retained copy Noise can produce incorrect words, but Yihu audio settings do not guarantee recognition accuracy in noisy conditions. For an existing transcript, retain reviewable original wording, identify an authorized editing location and compare the corrected version with the destination draft. This workflow does not request repeated recording, add correction/version-sync/noise-reduction features or authorize another handoff merely because text changed. A different task from capture diagnosis and passage review With no audio or recognized text, use input troubleshooting first. For quantities, negations and joins within a longer recording, use passage review. Here the task is which text objects actually changed after manual correction . Retained text, a controlled document, clipboard, web draft and attachment can be separate copies. Updating one does not establish updates elsewhere. Correction objects and copy checks Object/stage Retain first Safe check Not established Original transcript Original wording and genuinely reviewed scope Check authorized audio/text; mark unknown without evidence Editing changes original audio Corrected draft Before/after wording and reason Edit only in an existing authorized editable location A universal app correction screen or automatic version archive Inserted draft Actual destination and existing unsent text Check whether insertion already happened before editing there Another automatic insertion is duplicate-free Clipboard Whether an old version was copied Inspect only necessary content in an authorized location New text replaces prior clipboard copies Staged attachment Actual text/Markdown in the tray Check the specific version/target and original handoff state Local correction recalls an uploaded attachment Unclear wording Unverified unit, name or negation Keep pending through an existing confirmation process Fluent/plausible wording establishes truth Host refusal Explicit refusal/unknown-editor state Retain originals and stop that path Rewording bypasses host guards Uncertain result Original note’s reservation and destination content Inspect before creating another delivered copy Rephrasing is new permission, deduplication or exactly-once delivery One synthetic correction Unreviewed recognition: Send two sample checklist items. Authorized original evidence: Do not send the sample checklist; item count is unconfirmed. Proposed manual correction: Do not send; item count pending confirmation. Still unknown: Whether the destination already contains the old sentence. Do not retain two just to make a sentence complete, or assume an old web draft changed when the local correction exists. This is not an actual recording result. Do not publish customer conversations, orders or private meeting material to reproduce it. Without evidence, mark unknown rather than inventing the correct sentence. One path from correction to possible handoff Confirm a safe stationary environment and text source. End unnecessary playback/capture you started; repeated recording or volume increases do not establish unmeasured performance. Distinguish the original retained for review from proposed replacement wording, with reasons. This page specifies no native editing control. Inspect existing destination text and confirm an authorized unsent draft, not a terminal, sending interface or unknown editor. If manual destination editing is appropriate, check that host’s save/sync rules first. Do not force insertion or press Send automatically. Keep one-handoff and uncertain-stop state for an already attempted note. Correction does not clear it, and manual copying can still duplicate. FAQ Does corrected text prove robust noisy recognition? No. Editorial correction is different from model recognition results. There are no headset/noise-level/accuracy/wind-noise benchmarks here. Does Yihu provide the automatic correction or sentence editor described here? No such feature is asserted. Work manually only in actually available authorized editable tools/drafts, without inferring new app controls. Does a local correction update web drafts and attachments? Do not assume that. Check original, clipboard, draft and attachment separately. Each destination controls save/sync; this page adds no cross-copy updater. Can correction permit clearing a marker and inserting again? No. Do not bypass one-handoff guards through editing. Inspect destination text and retain uncertain-stop state; copying is not a deduplication guarantee. What if a quantity or name cannot be confirmed? Leave it pending rather than guessing from context. Use authorized evidence/confirmation, not an inference labeled verified or approved. Does deleting the old local draft recall data received remotely? Not as a general promise. Uploaded, synced or sent copies follow destination policies. Local deletion and remote recall are different operations. Reading and evidence Input diagnosis · Single-record passage review · Originals and one handoff · Department ownership/archive checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: draft/refusal guards , note handoff model , README .

### 跨部门纪要怎样认领与归档？责任角色、确认依据和副本清单

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/department-minutes-ownership-archive/

跨部门纪要怎样认领与归档？责任角色、确认依据和副本清单 写下责任角色不等于对方认领，保存文档也不等于正式归档 一呼提供语音文字、笔记和工作台交接，不由本文新增跨部门任务认领或归档系统。本清单用于已有人工纪要之后：区分建议由哪个角色负责、该角色是否通过已有流程确认、被批准的范围是什么，以及文档能存在哪里。草稿可见、对方收到、责任认领、批准与执行完成需要不同证据，不能用一个“已保存”概括。 与纪要字段和待办提取的分工 纪要字段指南处理事实/提案/未决项；多笔记指南处理跨记录冲突；这里不再提取新任务，而是检查 已经拟定的交接是否得到对应角色认可，以及副本归档条件是否清楚 。不得为了表格完整而填写真实姓名、推定负责人或自行设置部门权限。 人工认领与归档检查表 检查维度 应有的已有依据 合成记录方式 缺失时怎样处理 建议角色 原文或既有流程提出的负责角色 建议角色A，尚未认领 保留“建议”，不自动分配 认领确认 对应角色在获准流程中的明确确认 确认依据未提供 不把抄送、消息已读或姓名出现当认领 批准范围 已确认的事项、约束及未批准部分 只准核对样例，不准执行 不扩展为采购、发信、变更或发布授权 未决问题 仍需哪个既有流程确认 角色与期限均待核 不补猜测负责人或日期 归档位置 团队已有且获准的文档位置与访问范围 位置未核，不上传 本地/工作台草稿不自动等于正式档案 保留规则 团队实际规则与引用，不编造保留时长 按已有规则，待维护者说明 不承诺永久保留、无备份或绝对删除 副本范围 原笔记、剪贴板、文档和工作台的实际副本 仅核本地样例，其余未知 不把删一份当撤回全部资料 交接阶段 草稿/暂存/已记录/不确定各自证据 草稿供核对，未发送 不把saved/queued当认领或完成 一个不安排真实工作的合成认领卡 事项：示例纪要中的三个待核字段（非真实任务） proposed_role：角色A，建议而非已分配 acknowledgment_evidence：未提供，不能标已认领 approved_scope：仅核样例文字；无执行授权 open_question：应由哪个已有流程确认认领？ archive_location：未核，不上传到新位置 retention_rule_reference：待团队按已有规则确认 handoff_state：本地草稿，未发送 这些字段是人工清单，不是App、Radar导入或签署API。页面不发送邀请、不更改权限、不创建共享文档，也不收集姓名/联系方式。正式确认应沿团队原有获准渠道处理，而不是把合成卡复制到真实台账来测试。 归档前的先后关系 先核原文与纪要版本，避免把尚未修订的识别错误交给别人确认。 区分“提议角色”和“已有认领确认”，只记录实际得到的依据，不推断未回应者同意。 核被确认的内容范围与权限。角色认领核对文字不等于授权自动执行任务。 再核已有归档位置、访问和保留规则；没有依据就停在获准本地草稿，不自行建账号、共享链接或公开附件。 列出必要副本和不确定交接结果。已尝试过的笔记仍按原一次标记处理，归档流程不能被用来绕过重复交接。 如果需要Radar回复，仍须符合原事项资格、服务端写授权、手机确认和回执回读。服务记录了回复也不代表负责人已经完成事项，回复历史也不是通用文档档案库。 FAQ 在纪要写上角色A就算已经认领吗？ 不算。那只是一段文字或提议，需要对应角色通过已有获准流程明确确认；不能用抄送或未回应代替。 一呼是否提供部门任务分配或电子签署？ 本页不声明或新增这些能力。清单用于人工核对，现有语音草稿和笔记交接不自动建立组织审批系统。 保存到工作台草稿就完成正式归档了吗？ 不一定。正式位置、版本、访问范围与保留规则由团队已有流程定义，草稿保存本身不足以证明满足要求。 有人认领了核对动作，就可以执行全部提案吗？ 不能。确认范围必须明确，核对、批准和执行授权是不同事实，未获准部分仍保持未决。 本文能给出统一删除或保留期限吗？ 不能。各目的地、账户、备份和团队规则不同，应引用实际规则，不编造时长或删除保证。 Radar回复历史可以当完整跨部门档案库吗？ 不可以据此推断。它是有独立权限和实现边界的原事项回复/反馈读取；不是任意文档、版本、签署或认领数据库。 相关指南与依据 人工纪要字段 · 多笔记待办核对 · 噪声后人工修订 · 手机决策与回执 · 开始 · 隐私 实现边界依据： README回复与历史说明 、 笔记一次交接模型 。认领卡和归档清单是本文人工建议，不冒充代码功能或合规认证。

Parameter/comparison tables (HTML) / 参数对照表：

<table>
<thead>

<th>应有的已有依据</th>
<th>合成记录方式</th>
<th>缺失时怎样处理</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>建议角色</td>
<td>原文或既有流程提出的负责角色</td>

<td>保留“建议”，不自动分配</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>对应角色在获准流程中的明确确认</td>
<td>确认依据未提供</td>
<td>不把抄送、消息已读或姓名出现当认领</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>已确认的事项、约束及未批准部分</td>
<td>只准核对样例，不准执行</td>
<td>不扩展为采购、发信、变更或发布授权</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>未决问题</td>
<td>仍需哪个既有流程确认</td>
<td>角色与期限均待核</td>
<td>不补猜测负责人或日期</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>归档位置</td>
<td>团队已有且获准的文档位置与访问范围</td>
<td>位置未核，不上传</td>
<td>本地/工作台草稿不自动等于正式档案</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>保留规则</td>
<td>团队实际规则与引用，不编造保留时长</td>
<td>按已有规则，待维护者说明</td>
<td>不承诺永久保留、无备份或绝对删除</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>副本范围</td>
<td>原笔记、剪贴板、文档和工作台的实际副本</td>
<td>仅核本地样例，其余未知</td>
<td>不把删一份当撤回全部资料</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>交接阶段</td>
<td>草稿/暂存/已记录/不确定各自证据</td>
<td>草稿供核对，未发送</td>
<td>不把saved/queued当认领或完成</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Cross-department minutes: ownership acknowledgment and archive checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/department-minutes-ownership-archive/

Cross-department minutes: ownership acknowledgment and archive checks Naming a role is not acknowledgment, and saving a document is not formal archiving Yihu provides voice text, notes and workbench handoff; this article adds no cross-department assignment/archive system. After drafting minutes manually, distinguish a proposed responsible role, its explicit acknowledgment through an existing process, the approved scope and an authorized document location. Visible drafts, receipt, ownership acknowledgment, approval and completed work need separate evidence; saved does not cover them all. A different task from fields and to-do extraction The minutes-fields guide separates facts/proposals/questions; multi-note review handles conflicts across records. Here no new tasks are extracted. Check whether an already proposed handoff was acknowledged by the relevant role and whether archiving conditions are known . Do not fill real names, infer owners or alter departmental permissions just to complete a table. Manual ownership and archive checklist Dimension Existing evidence needed Synthetic record Missing-evidence action Proposed role Role proposed in original text or existing process Role A suggested, not acknowledged Keep it proposed; do not assign automatically Acknowledgment Explicit response through an authorized workflow No acknowledgment evidence supplied CC, read status or a named person is not ownership Approved scope Confirmed content, constraints and unapproved parts Review sample only; do not execute No inferred purchasing, email, change or release authority Open questions Existing process that must confirm next Owner and deadline pending No guessed person/date Archive location Existing authorized storage and access scope Location unverified; no upload A local/workbench draft is not automatically an official archive Retention rule Actual team policy/reference, not invented duration Existing rule needs maintainer clarification No permanent-retention, backup-free or deletion guarantee Copies Actual note, clipboard, document and workbench copies Local sample checked; others unknown One deletion does not recall all material Handoff stage Separate draft/staged/recorded/uncertain evidence Draft for review; not sent saved/queued are not ownership or completion A synthetic acknowledgment card that assigns no real work Item: Three sample editorial fields (not a real task) proposed_role: Role A suggested, not assigned acknowledgment_evidence: Not provided; do not mark acknowledged approved_scope: Review sample wording only; no execution authority open_question: Which existing process confirms ownership? archive_location: Unverified; do not upload to a new destination retention_rule_reference: Pending existing team policy handoff_state: Local draft, not sent These are manual checklist labels, not app/Radar imports or a signing API. This page sends no invitation, changes no permission, creates no shared document and collects no names/contact information. Confirm through the team’s existing authorized channel, not by copying the synthetic card to a live ledger as a test. Ordering before archiving Check the original and edited version before asking another role to confirm recognition errors. Separate proposed responsibility from actual acknowledgment evidence. Silence is not consent. Verify confirmed content/permission scope. Agreeing to review wording does not authorize task execution. Check existing archive location, access and retention rules. Without evidence, stop in an authorized local draft instead of provisioning accounts, share links or public attachments. List necessary copies and uncertain handoffs. Previously attempted notes retain original one-handoff state; archiving is not a bypass for repeated delivery. Radar replies, if needed, retain original eligibility, server authority, phone confirmation and receipt readback. A recorded reply is not completed ownership work, and reply history is not a general document archive. FAQ Does writing role A in minutes establish ownership? No. It is proposed text until the relevant role explicitly confirms through an existing authorized process. CC or silence cannot replace that evidence. Does Yihu provide departmental assignment or e-signatures? No such capability is asserted or added. This is manual review guidance; voice drafts and note handoff do not create an organizational approval system. Is saving a workbench draft formal archiving? Not necessarily. The existing team process defines location, version, access and retention. Saving a draft alone does not establish those requirements. Does acknowledging a review action authorize all proposals? No. Scope must be explicit. Review, approval and execution authority are distinct, and unapproved content stays open. Can this guide prescribe one retention/deletion period? No. Destinations, accounts, backups and team policies differ. Refer to actual rules without inventing periods or deletion guarantees. Can Radar reply history be a complete department archive? Not as an inference. It reads original-item replies/feedback within its permission/implementation limits, not arbitrary documents, versions, signatures or ownership records. Guides and evidence Manual minutes fields · Multiple-note/to-do review · Manual noisy-transcript correction · Phone decisions/receipts · Start · Privacy Implementation boundaries: README replies/history , note one-handoff model . Cards and archive checks are editorial suggestions, not source functionality or compliance certification.

### 外贸任务异常提示怎样二次核实？证据链接、来源缺口与停步清单

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-evidence-second-check/

外贸任务异常提示怎样二次核实？证据链接、来源缺口与停步清单 卡片上的异常描述是待核数据，不是已验证警报或执行授权 一呼读取你提供的PM Radar任务JSON，显示来源字段与证据。标题写着“紧急”、优先级是P0或提供HTTPS链接，都不证明事件真实、需要立即执行或已被App独立检测。这里的二次核实是人工清单：沿已有授权渠道核原始依据、对象、时间与操作范围；证据不足就停，不新增风险引擎、外贸情报服务或自动处置功能。 与快照差异、JSON类型检查的分工 类型检查回答字段是否符合形态；批次比较回答两份是否可比。本文只针对 当前一个提示所依据的证据是否足够支持下一步 ，不把“原文说存在异常”改成“系统确认异常”。交易、询盘或跟进事项仍是团队自有数据；页面不取外部市场数据，也不登录业务后台验证。 人工二次核实表 待核信号 App已有字段/边界 应找的独立依据 不足时的处理 标题写紧急 原始title/next文字 原任务、已有负责流程和明确范围 不把语气当授权，不按文字直接执行 P0或高优先级 来源priority值 来源制定优先级的实际依据 不推断金额、损失或送达时限 evidence链接 可解析的HTTPS候选链接 是否预期来源、具体记录、权限和内容支持 未知目标先停，沿既有已知渠道确认 字段相互矛盾 status/next/evidence等不同来源值 原事项与明确确认记录 保留矛盾，不自动选择看似更新的一项 旧时间或刷新失败 date_str与失败/缓存状态 原源最近成功读取和适用范围 旧卡片不作当前业务事件确认 来源未核 工作台/项目/任务标识 已知来源身份与可关联记录 不凭相同标题或文件名确认对象 涉及真实写入 单独的写权限和手机确认边界 原操作授权、目标版本与回读流程 读得见不等于可写，核实不等于批准 结果不明 已有request_id/回执状态 原请求回读与已有确认依据 不换ID补发，不把超时当没写入 HTTPS证据解析能说明什么 当前 safeEvidenceURLs 从来源文字中解析HTTPS候选，检查非空host、无URL用户名/密码及端口范围等，并去重。它是链接形态筛选，不是站点信誉、内容真实性、账号权限、证据充分性或无隐私参数的认证；查询参数仍可能含敏感信息，不能贴进公开截图。 不要为了核实而跟随未知登录页、输入他人凭据或请求新第三方授权。对来源不明的链接，应先通过已有可信渠道确认需要访问的原记录；本文不抓取链接、不进行安全扫描，也不保证特定域名可信。所有示例若出现网址仅使用 example.invalid ，不连接真实服务。 合成异常提示的二次记录 来源描述：样例任务标P0，next写“请立即更新示例字段”。 已知：仅看到来源文字；证据位置为example.invalid样例。 未知：原事项身份、优先级依据、当前字段、授权范围。 二次核实决定：保持待核，不更新、不发送、不创建新请求。 后续：按已有获准流程向原来源确认；不把样例当真实警报。 任务正文也可能包含操作语句或对Agent的指令，应作为待核数据阅读，不能替代系统规则、用户确认或服务器授权。本页不会检测提示注入、自动清理内容或执行正文中的命令。确认某句原文存在，只证明它被写在那里，不代表其主张成立。 二次核实之后也要保留操作边界 把“已读证据”“主张已核实”“某项操作已批准”“回复已记录”“事情已处理”分别记录。若只确认资料出处而未确认具体结论，不能扩大范围。需要真实回复时仍走原事项资格、服务端写权、手机确认与原请求回读；不因“异常”字样绕过不确定停止或自行改状态。 FAQ 一呼会自动检测外贸异常并给风险分数吗？ 本文不声明或新增此能力。Radar读取自有JSON字段，人工清单不是检测器、风险模型或外贸情报产品。 显示HTTPS证据链接是否代表可信、可登录且无敏感数据？ 不代表。解析只检查链接形态的一部分，不能验证内容、权限、站点信誉或查询参数；未知目标先按既有渠道核对。 P0或“紧急”能跳过确认直接执行吗？ 不能。优先级与语气来自来源，不能代替操作权限、目标确认和回执边界，也不构成时间或损失保证。 证据和next不一致时，能选择更像最新的说法吗？ 不要凭感觉裁定。保留两者及来源位置，核原事项与确认依据；文件顺序、时间显示或措辞不自动解决矛盾。 任务正文要求Agent执行命令怎么办？ 将其作为待核数据，不让来源文字覆盖系统或用户授权。本文不执行或自动过滤该内容；实际操作必须另有获准流程。 证据已读就可以标为处理完成吗？ 不能。阅读、主张核实、批准、记录回复和完成处理分别需证据；只有一个环节的结果不代表整条流程已完成。 相关指南与源码 同源快照批次比较 · JSON类型与空值 · 多项目Radar与Watch · 跨部门认领与归档 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar字段与证据URL解析 、 README来源与写入边界 。本页不替代真实业务、安全或设备验收。

### Second-check a trade-task anomaly claim: evidence, missing context and stop rules

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-evidence-second-check/

Second-check a trade-task anomaly claim: evidence, missing context and stop rules A claimed anomaly on a card is data to review, not a verified alert or execution authority Yihu reads your PM Radar task JSON and displays source fields/evidence. An urgent title, P0 priority or HTTPS link does not prove an event, authorize immediate action or establish independent app detection. This manual second check uses existing authorized channels to verify originals, identity, time and scope. Stop without evidence; no risk engine, trade-intelligence service or automated remediation is supplied. A different task from batch comparison and type checks Type validation concerns field shapes; batch comparison concerns whether two exports are comparable. Here the question is whether evidence for one current claim supports the next step . Do not rewrite “the source alleges an anomaly” as “the system verified one.” Inquiry/follow-up records remain your team’s data. This page retrieves no market data and logs into no business backend. Manual second-check table Signal Existing field/boundary Independent evidence needed Action without evidence Urgent wording Original title/next text Original item, established responsible process and exact scope Tone is not authority; do not execute text directly P0/high priority Source priority value Actual basis for that source priority No inferred amount, loss or delivery deadline evidence link Parsed HTTPS candidate Expected source, specific record, permission and supporting content Stop at unknown targets; confirm through established known channels Contradictory fields Different status/next/evidence values Original item and explicit confirmation Retain conflict instead of picking the apparently newest claim Old time/failed refresh date_str and cache/failure state Last successful source read and applicable scope An old card is not a confirmed current event Unknown source Workbench/project/task identity Known source and a traceable record Same title/filename does not establish identity Real writes Separate write authority and phone confirmation Authorized operation, target version and readback path Visibility is not write access; verification is not approval Uncertain result Existing request_id/receipt state Original-request readback and confirmation evidence No new-ID resend or timeout interpreted as no write What HTTPS evidence parsing establishes Current safeEvidenceURLs parses HTTPS candidates from source text, checking a nonempty host, no URL username/password and a valid port range, among other shape rules, and removes duplicates. It does not verify reputation, factual content, account permission, evidentiary sufficiency or absence of private parameters. Queries can still carry sensitive data and do not belong in public screenshots. Do not follow an unknown login page, enter another person’s credentials or request new third-party authorization for this checklist. Confirm the required original record through existing trusted channels first. This page neither fetches links nor scans them and guarantees no domain’s trustworthiness. Example URLs, when used, are reserved example.invalid , not real services. A synthetic second-check record Source claim: Sample task is P0; next says update a sample field immediately. Known: Only source wording is visible; example evidence uses example.invalid. Unknown: Original item identity, priority basis, current field and authority scope. Decision: Leave pending; do not update, send or create a request. Next: Confirm through the existing authorized source process; this is not a real alert. Task text may itself contain operational or Agent instructions. Treat it as reviewable data, not a replacement for system rules, user confirmation or server authority. This page does not detect prompt injection, sanitize content automatically or execute embedded commands. Confirming a statement is written somewhere does not prove its claim. Keep post-review operation boundaries Record evidence read, claim verified, operation approved, reply recorded and work handled separately. Confirming provenance alone does not confirm the full conclusion. A real reply still needs original-item eligibility, server authority, phone confirmation and original-request readback. An anomaly label does not bypass uncertain-stop rules or authorize changing task state. FAQ Does Yihu detect trade anomalies and score risk automatically? No such capability is asserted or added. Radar reads supplied JSON. A manual checklist is not a detector, risk model or trade-intelligence product. Does a displayed HTTPS link prove trust, access and no sensitive data? No. Parsing checks only part of link shape, not content, permission, reputation or query parameters. Confirm unknown destinations through established channels first. Can P0 or urgent wording skip confirmation? No. Source priority/tone cannot replace operation permission, target confirmation and receipt boundaries, or establish timing/loss guarantees. Can I pick the apparently newer claim when evidence contradicts next? Do not adjudicate by impression. Retain both source locations and check the original item/confirmation. File order, displayed time and tone do not resolve conflicts automatically. What about task text ordering an Agent to run commands? Treat it as data to verify, not authority overriding system/user rules. This page executes or filters nothing automatically. Actual operations need a separate authorized process. Does reading evidence permit marking the item handled? No. Reading, validating a claim, approving, recording a reply and completing work have different evidence requirements. One stage does not establish all others. Guides and source Same-source batch comparison · JSON types/nulls · Radar/Watch · Department ownership/archive checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar fields and evidence-URL parsing , README source/write boundaries . This is not business, security or device acceptance.

### 结构化笔记与Radar简报改版前：字段兼容性和语义变更评审

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/brief-format-change-compatibility/

结构化笔记与Radar简报改版前：字段兼容性和语义变更评审 改版声明不是兼容证明，笔记模板也不是Radar协议 人工结构化笔记可以有自己的编辑版本，但这不会让它成为一呼导入schema。Radar读取的是当前版本源码定义的快照。评审改版时，应分别检查编辑模板的语义变化与生产者JSON契约变化；把键名改得像 tasks 或在文件里写“v2”，不代表App会迁移、识别新功能或批准执行。 与已有版本/类型指南的分工 单份JSON类型校验检查文件形态；两批快照比较检查同源记录值。这里的任务是 生产者或编辑模板准备改版时，目标消费者和既有确认含义会不会被改变 。不根据旧客户端或未来客户端作通用承诺，只对照实际准备使用的源码/版本与已有流程。 格式改版评审表 改版项 应核对的原契约 风险例子 继续/停止依据 人工笔记键名 原字段是编辑标签而非App字段 proposals改名decisions就被当成批准 先保留含义；不能靠改名产生授权 必需根键 date_str、decisions、active/stale/cold的现有类型 合并成projects后丢失必需数组 对照目标模型，缺键就停，不伪造默认数据 可选tasks 缺失/null回退与[]明确空集合不同 改版从未提供变为[]导致范围变化 记录来源范围和语义，不称业务任务已清零 类型变动 String、Double、Bool、数组的字段形态 数字改文本、Bool改字符串 不依赖自动强转；需实际消费者验证 新增字段 目标版本实际认识和验证的字段 新增键被误认为已有UI/能力 不从键存在推断支持；核目标实现 时间口径 来源读取时间、任务时间与编辑时间 新版本把date_str改成导出时间 来源语义必须明确，不能伪造“最新” 身份/范围 project/path/id与权限范围 改名/换源被当作同一批任务 不自动关联，保留未确认与原始来源 回复含义 可读、reply_supported和写授权分开 新版标true就自动发起真实回复 原资格、手机确认与回执门不能变 一个合成的编辑版本变化 旧人工模板：unconfirmed_proposals = 建议核对示例清单。 拟改模板：confirmed_decisions = 建议核对示例清单。 风险：只换了键名，却把未批准提案误标成已确认。 评审决定：不采用该语义变更，保留未确认提案；不创建任务。 这些是人工编辑标签，不是可导入JSON或已经运行的迁移测试。若团队另有获准导出器，应由该流程维护实际契约；本文不把上述模板转换为Radar记录，也不提供更改真实源的脚本。 固定消费者版本再评估 先记录目标App源码/构建版本，再对照已有快照字段；不要只说“新格式兼容”。保留不含私密数据的旧/新合成样例，逐项标出必需键、类型、缺失值与语义差异。能解析不等于通过后续大小、日期、标识和时间戳验证，更不等于真机/权限/生产验收。 如果发现差异，不为消除错误而填当前时间、复制旧任务或把未知状态写成完成。先停止新格式采用，向既有生产者维护流程反馈；不自行修改来源权限或让客户端绕过验证。本页也不新增schema版本协商、自动降级或历史迁移数据库。 FAQ 人工纪要模板改版会自动更新一呼字段吗？ 不会。编辑标签和App模型是不同契约，模板版本不自动创建App界面、导入字段或服务能力。 JSON写了v2是否就有版本协商？ 不能这样推断。应核目标源码实际实现，文件里的声明不是客户端已支持新格式的证明，本页不新增协商机制。 把提案字段改名为决定字段可以保持内容不变吗？ 键名可能改变读者理解，必须核语义；没有独立批准就不能把未确认提案归为确认结论，不能靠重命名授权执行。 生产者新增键就能认为所有客户端都兼容吗？ 不能。是否识别、忽略或校验取决于目标版本；新增键也不意味着已有UI或原生增强，需实际版本证据。 把缺失tasks补成空数组只是格式整理吗？ 不是无语义变化。缺失/null会走旧源回退，[]是明确空全量集合，范围含义可能变化，应由来源确认。 这里的检查表能替代Swift解码与真机验收吗？ 不能。它是人工改版评审，既不运行App解码，也不验证服务权限或生产数据；测试必须绑定实际消费者版本与范围。 继续阅读与依据 单份JSON类型与空值 · 同源两批比较 · 人工纪要字段 · 降级交接前检 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar字段与decode 、 README来源与写权限边界 。

### Before changing a structured-note or Radar brief format: compatibility and meaning

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/brief-format-change-compatibility/

Before changing a structured-note or Radar brief format: compatibility and meaning A revision label is not compatibility evidence, and a note template is not the Radar protocol An editorial structured note can have its own revision, but that does not make it an app import schema. Radar reads the contract in the actual source version. Review editorial meaning and producer JSON changes separately. Renaming keys to resemble tasks , or writing v2 in a file, does not establish migration, feature support or execution approval. A separate task from types and batch values Single-file checks inspect shape; batch comparison inspects source-record differences. Here the question is whether changing a producer/template would change consumer compatibility or confirmation meaning . Do not make universal promises for old/future clients; compare the actual intended source/build and existing workflow. Format-change review table Change Existing contract to inspect Risk example Go/stop evidence Editorial key name An editorial label, not an app field proposals renamed decisions implies approval Preserve meaning; renaming grants no authority Required root keys Existing date_str, decisions, active/stale/cold types Replacing arrays with projects loses required fields Stop on missing keys; no invented defaults Optional tasks Missing/null fallback versus explicitly empty [] Adding [] changes interpreted scope Record scope/meaning rather than claiming all tasks vanished Field type Actual String/Double/Bool/array declarations Number becomes text; Bool becomes string No assumed coercion; validate the actual consumer Added fields Fields recognized/validated by the intended version New key assumed to provide UI/capability Key presence is not support; inspect implementation Time meaning Source read, task update and editorial time date_str becomes export time Keep source meaning explicit, not artificially fresh Identity/scope project/path/id and permissions Renaming/changing sources treated as the same tasks Do not match automatically; retain unknown provenance Reply meaning Read access, reply_supported and write authority differ New true flag triggers real replies Original eligibility, phone confirmation and receipt gates remain One synthetic editorial revision Old editorial label: unconfirmed_proposals = Suggest reviewing a sample checklist. Proposed label: confirmed_decisions = Suggest reviewing a sample checklist. Risk: Renaming falsely turns an unapproved proposal into a decision. Review decision: Reject this meaning change; retain an unconfirmed proposal. Create no task. These labels are not importable JSON or an executed migration test. A team with an authorized exporter must maintain its actual contract through that process. This page neither converts templates into Radar records nor supplies scripts to modify a live source. Fix the consumer version first Record the intended source/build, then compare its snapshot fields instead of declaring the new format compatible. Keep non-sensitive synthetic before/after fixtures identifying required keys, types, absence and meaning. Parsing is not post-decode size/date/identity/timestamp acceptance, much less device, permission or production acceptance. On a mismatch, do not fill now, copied tasks or completed status merely to hide an error. Stop adoption and report through the existing producer-maintenance workflow. Do not alter source permissions or bypass validation. No schema negotiation, automatic downgrade or migration database is added. FAQ Does changing the minutes template update Yihu fields? No. Editorial labels and app models are different contracts. A template revision creates no interface, import field or service capability. Does a v2 label establish version negotiation? No. Inspect actual source support; a file declaration does not certify the consumer supports a new contract. This guide implements no negotiation. Can proposals simply be renamed decisions without changing content? Names can change interpretation. Without separate approval, unconfirmed suggestions cannot become decisions or execution authority by renaming. Does an added producer key work with every client? No blanket claim follows. Recognition, ignoring and validation depend on the actual version. A new key also supplies no UI/native enhancement without implementation evidence. Is adding empty tasks only formatting? No. Missing/null trigger legacy fallback, while [] explicitly supplies an empty ledger. Scope meaning can change and needs source confirmation. Does this replace Swift decoding and device acceptance? No. It is manual revision review, not execution of app decoding or checks of real permissions/data. Tests must bind to an actual consumer version and scope. Reading and evidence Single-file types/nulls · Same-source batch values · Editorial minutes fields · Degraded-handoff decision · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar fields/decode , README source/write boundaries .

### 弱网时改用复制或附件前：降级交接许可与重复风险核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/degraded-handoff-go-no-go/

弱网时改用复制或附件前：降级交接许可与重复风险核对 网络不好不是换路径的许可，先核原结果和目标权限 当本地文字已保留、网页或服务不可达时，可以先停止在本地；不能因此把同一内容自动改走剪贴板、附件或另一个来源。本文在弱网故障定位之后，检查是否允许改变交接方式，以及旧尝试是否可能已产生副本。它不新增自动降级、重试或可靠送达队列，也不能用人工路径绕过宿主拒绝和一次交接边界。 与弱网排障的分工 弱网指南定位模型、网页、缓存和真实回复各层故障；这里假定已知道受影响层，专门作 继续保留还是采用另一个已获准人工动作 的决定。最安全的结果可能是“不再交接，待核”，而不是必须找一条能发出去的路线。 改交接方式前的决定表 当前情形 先核证据 可保留的安全状态 不允许借此做什么 本地有字，尚未交接 原文、拟用目标、是否确实未尝试 原文留本地待用户选择 自动上传或选定新来源 目标明确拒绝 宿主拒绝/未知响应 保留文字并停止该路径 换编辑器强塞或用另一附件路径绕过 笔记已有尝试 一次交接标记、目标已有内容 不确定停止，保留原文 清标记、改名或复制后自动再交付 附件已暂存 实际版本及是否有后续上传 核托盘与目标阶段 把未发送解释为没有上传 想手动复制 获准目的地、已有内容与其处理规则 用户明确选择且已核范围的人工动作 声称复制绝不重复或所有内容仍本地 想换数据源 来源身份、缓存清理与未决回复 按既有换源条件检查，失败就停 为规避冻结或权限失败切源 真实回复超时 原request_id、待处理与回读状态 沿原身份核结果 生成新ID补发或把超时当没写入 必须立即联络 团队既有经验证的通信流程 退出本试用，按已有安全流程处理 把草稿、暂存或queued当紧急送达 一个合成的“保留而不转送”决定 已知：样例文字在本地；网页交接结果不确定。 未知：目标是否已经出现同一段文字。 拟改方式：复制到另一个草稿。 决定：先不复制/转送，保留原文并核目标已有内容。 原因：新副本不能证明旧尝试未发生，也没有去重保证。 这不是强制所有情况下都禁用人工复制；它要求复制前先核授权、已有内容与不确定性。不存在由本页提供的跨目标统一去重或自动撤回机制，也不要求为测试断网、清缓存或重置任务。 降级前先问四个问题 改变的是什么？ 本地保留、复制、托盘暂存、附件上传和真正发送不是同一步，不把它们都叫“降级发送”。 旧结果是否明确？ 先看原笔记或真实请求状态及目的地，不能从没有回执推断未写入。 新目标是否独立获准？ 读取网页、下载模型或蓝牙连接都不等于可向任意服务交接资料。 哪些副本会留下？ 剪贴板、文档同步、工作台附件可能扩大处理范围；如果无法确认，就继续保留而不交付。 恢复网络后也不应自动把待核材料全部重发。原目标、来源身份、权限与当前内容可能已变化，应继续原守卫与确认流程。本页没有新增离线待发箱、后台补偿或跨源迁移。 FAQ 一呼会在弱网时自动把笔记改走附件吗？ 本页不声明这种能力。现有显式交接与一次标记保留，弱网不自动授予换路由重试或上传权限。 目标拒绝文字，能用文件上传达到同一目标吗？ 不能把附件路径当绕过拒绝的方法。先保留原文并停止受影响路径，按实际宿主许可处理，而不是寻找能强行进入的编辑器。 手动复制是否一定安全且不会重复？ 不一定。复制会产生副本，目的地可能同步、保存或已有同样内容。需用户明确选择并先核范围，本文不给绝不重复保证。 旧请求不确定时可以换工作台重发吗？ 不应为绕过不确定状态而切源或重发。保留原请求身份和待处理状态，按既有回读/确认边界处理。 网络恢复后是否应自动发出全部本地记录？ 不是。网络恢复不等于权限、目标与内容仍适用，必须重新核对相关状态；本文不实现自动待发队列。 只保留本地算工作流失败吗？ 不应混为一谈。本地保留可以是明确的安全停止结果；它既不是远端交付成功，也不抹去已完成的本地处理。 继续阅读与依据 弱网分层排障 · 一次交接与附件边界 · 人工修订副本 · 交接证据审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 笔记一次交接模型 、 来源读取与变更条件 、 README不确定回复 。

<td>原request_id、待处理与回读状态</td>
<td>沿原身份核结果</td>
<td>生成新ID补发或把超时当没写入</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>必须立即联络</td>
<td>团队既有经验证的通信流程</td>
<td>退出本试用，按已有安全流程处理</td>
<td>把草稿、暂存或queued当紧急送达</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Before copying or staging under weak coverage: degraded-handoff permission checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/degraded-handoff-go-no-go/

Before copying or staging under weak coverage: degraded-handoff permission checks Weak coverage is not permission to change paths; inspect the original result and authority With local text retained and a page/service unreachable, stopping locally is an option. Do not automatically move the same content to clipboard, attachments or another source. After diagnosis, this checklist evaluates permission to change the handoff and whether a prior attempt already created a copy. It adds no automatic fallback, retry or reliable-delivery queue, and manual actions do not bypass host refusal or one-handoff guards. A decision after, not another weak-network diagnosis The troubleshooting guide locates model, web, cache and real-reply failures. Here the affected layer is known; decide whether to keep waiting or perform a separately authorized manual action . A valid outcome may be retain pending review, not a requirement to find any path that sends. Go/no-go before changing handoff Situation Evidence first Safe retained state Not authorized by it Text local, no handoff yet Original, intended target and actual absence of an attempt Retain pending user choice Automatic upload or a newly selected source Explicit host refusal Refusal/unknown response Retain text and stop the path Force another editor or bypass through attachments Note already attempted One-handoff marker and destination content Uncertain-stop with originals Clear markers, rename or copy then redeliver automatically Attachment staged Actual version and any later upload Inspect tray and destination stage Unsent interpreted as not uploaded Manual copying proposed Authorized destination, existing text and handling rules Explicit user choice within reviewed scope Duplicate-free copying or local-only retention claims Source change proposed Identity, cache-clear conditions and unresolved replies Follow existing conditions; stop on failure Bypass a frozen/unauthorized result by changing sources Real reply timeout Original request_id, pending state and readback Inspect through original identity New-ID resend or timeout treated as no write Urgent contact needed Existing validated communication/safety process Leave this trial for that process Treat draft, staging or queued as urgent delivery A synthetic retain-without-forwarding decision Known: Sample text is local; web handoff result is uncertain. Unknown: Whether the destination already contains it. Proposed alternative: Copy to a different draft. Decision: Do not copy/forward yet; retain originals and inspect destination content. Reason: A new copy cannot prove the earlier attempt did not happen or prevent duplicates. This does not ban all manual copying. It requires permission, destination-content and uncertainty checks first. No cross-target deduplication/recall is supplied, and no network disconnection, cache deletion or task reset is required for a test. Four questions before fallback What changes? Local retention, copying, staging, attachment upload and sending are different actions, not one fallback-send operation. Is the old result known? Inspect original note/request state and destination content. An absent receipt is not proof of no write. Is the new destination independently authorized? Web read access, model download and Bluetooth pairing do not authorize sharing data to any service. Which copies remain? Clipboard, document sync and workbench attachments can expand processing. Retain without handoff if the scope is unclear. Connectivity returning does not authorize automatically resending everything pending. Target, source identity, permission and content may have changed. Keep existing guards/confirmation; no offline outbox, background compensation or cross-source migration is added. FAQ Does Yihu automatically turn notes into attachments on weak coverage? No such capability is asserted here. Explicit handoff and reservation remain; weak coverage grants no path-switch, retry or upload authority. Can a file upload bypass a refused text target? Do not use attachments to bypass refusal. Retain originals and stop the affected path, following actual host permission rather than searching for a permissive editor. Is manual copying always safe and duplicate-free? No. It creates a copy and the destination can sync, save or already contain the same text. Explicit user choice and scope checks are needed, without a duplicate-free guarantee. Can I switch workbenches and resend an uncertain request? Do not change sources to bypass uncertainty. Preserve the original identity/pending state and existing readback/confirmation boundary. Should all local notes send automatically when connectivity returns? No. Connectivity does not establish unchanged permission, destination or relevance. Recheck state; this page implements no automatic outbox. Is retaining locally simply a failed workflow? Not as a blanket label. It can be an explicit safe-stop result. It is not remote delivery and does not negate completed local processing. Reading and evidence Layered weak-network diagnosis · One-handoff/attachment boundaries · Correction and copies · Handoff evidence review · Start · Privacy Evidence: one-handoff model , source-read/change conditions , README uncertain replies .

### 团队交接真的完成了吗？最小证据包与完成主张人工审计

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/handoff-evidence-audit-checklist/

团队交接真的完成了吗？最小证据包与完成主张人工审计 审计先判断证据能支持什么，不为了补证重做一次操作 一呼的本地文字、草稿交付、附件暂存、Radar回复记录与后续处理有不同结果。团队复核时应比较“声称完成了什么”和“实际已有哪一层证据”，不能为了拿到回执而重新发送、换请求ID或执行真实任务。本页是最小人工证据检查表，不是App新增审计日志、跨账号追踪器、不可篡改存证或合规认证。 与责任认领、归档清单的分工 责任清单确定谁按已有流程认领、资料存哪里；这里由另一个获准复核角色，对 已经声称完成的一次交接 作证据范围判断。不分配新任务、不更改档案规则，也不要求收集原始录音、个人信息或顾客正文。 最小人工证据包 检查项 可接受的既有依据 能支持的有限结论 不能扩大为 来源/版本 已知版本、原记录引用与已核范围 复核针对哪一份材料 任意设备或未来版本都有效 目标绑定 原工作台/页面/任务的可核身份 已核的交接对象 任意相似标题或另一个来源 内容范围 获准的必要文字与人工核对记录 这些字段/片段已核 全文或全部副本已核 本地状态 原文、完成/失败及交接尝试状态 本地处理或尝试的相应阶段 远端未收到或必然已收到 草稿/附件 目标未发送草稿或托盘版本 草稿可见或内容已暂存 已发送、已上传或对方已处理 原请求/回执 既有请求身份与服务记录证据 原服务确认记录了相应回复 任务自动完成、状态改变或执行成功 后续处理 原来源独立确认/反馈及其范围 该项已证实的处理步骤 所有动作与下游系统都完成 缺口/未知 缺失的依据、权限或不确定状态 保持待核或不确定 用新请求补发、编写新日志或推测结论 一份合成的主张—证据记录 被复核主张：样例事项“已发送并处理”。 已有依据：仅能看到目的地未发送草稿；没有服务回执。 支持结论：草稿可见；发送和处理未获证实。 保留缺口：原请求/回执未提供，不能推断没有写入。 复核决定：保持待核；不重发、不生成ID、不执行。 这些是人工编辑字段，不是App导入或审计API。不能为了让证据包完整而制造新事件，或把事后写下的说明当作操作时的原始记录。若需引用私有依据，应在原有获准范围中复核，而不是复制到公开评论或未授权文档。 复核顺序与最小披露 明确被复核的主张：是转写完成、草稿可见、回复已记录，还是人已处理？先拆分，避免一个“完成”混合多层。 核来源与目标，确认复核者有权限读取对应材料。网页可读、历史可读与写权限不同，不为审计索要他人凭据。 对照已有证据，只记录可公开或已获准的引用位置、字段和缺口。不要上传真实录音、客户正文、工作台参数或设备标识。 有超时或回执未知时，保留原请求身份和既有不确定边界，不能用新动作来补做“原操作”的证明。 报告最窄结论，说明哪些层未核；复核结果本身不授权合并、发布、下单或发信。 不能由这个清单认证的事 本页不证明第三方日志保留、时间戳可信度、端到端绝对一次、数据删除或法律合规。源码、静态网页、样例和服务回执分别有范围；即使服务记录了回复，也不等于被提及的Agent执行了动作。读取回复历史也不建立任意资料的完整追踪链。 FAQ 一呼是否自带完整不可篡改审计日志？ 本文不作此声明或新增日志功能。只比较已获准的现有证据；缺失就保留缺口，不把人工清单当原生存证系统。 有草稿截图就能说明消息已发出吗？ 不能。草稿截图最多支持相应可见状态，也可能缺版本和目标上下文；发送、服务记录和处理另需证据。 服务回执能证明Agent已经执行吗？ 不能一概而论。现有回复回执证明相应服务记录边界，不自动改任务状态或提供下游执行结果。 为补审计证据可以重新发送一次吗？ 不应这样补证。新操作不能证明旧操作，且可能重复；不确定结果应沿原请求与回读边界处理。 没有权限读某份依据，能让别人导出全部材料吗？ 不以审计名义放宽权限或收集不必要数据。按已有授权流程核最小范围，无法取得的部分明确未核。 清单填满就算满足合规或绝对一次认证吗？ 不算。人工复核不提供法律认证、不可篡改证据链或端到端送达保证，必须保留范围和未知项。 继续复核与依据 责任认领与归档 · 手机回复与回执 · 降级前许可 · 证据主张二次核实 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： README交接、回复与历史边界 、 笔记一次标记 。

### Was a team handoff complete? Minimal evidence and manual claim review

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/handoff-evidence-audit-checklist/

Was a team handoff complete? Minimal evidence and manual claim review Review what evidence supports; do not repeat an operation to create proof Local text, draft delivery, attachment staging, a recorded Radar reply and later handling have different outcomes. Compare the completion claim against the actual evidence stage. Do not resend, change request IDs or execute work merely to obtain a receipt. This is a minimal manual review checklist, not a new app audit log, cross-account tracker, tamper-proof record or compliance certification. Different from responsibility and archive planning The ownership guide checks who acknowledges work and where material belongs. Here another authorized reviewer evaluates evidence for a handoff already claimed complete . It assigns no new task, changes no retention rule and requires no collection of original audio, personal information or customer text. Minimal manual evidence package Check Existing evidence Limited conclusion supported Not established Source/version Known version, original reference and reviewed scope Which material was reviewed Every device or future version works Target identity Verifiable workbench/page/item identity The checked destination Similar title or another source is equivalent Content scope Necessary authorized text and review record These fields/passages were checked Full text and every copy checked Local state Original, complete/failed and handoff-attempt state The corresponding local/attempt stage Remote receipt or absence of receipt Draft/attachment Actual unsent destination draft or tray version Visible draft or staged content Sent/uploaded/handled status Original request/receipt Existing request identity and service record The service recorded that reply Automatic task completion, state change or execution Later handling Independent source confirmation/feedback with scope The evidenced handling step Every action/downstream system completed Gaps/unknowns Missing evidence, permission or uncertain state Pending or uncertain remains New-ID resend, invented logs or guessed conclusions A synthetic claim-evidence record Claim under review: Sample item was sent and handled. Available evidence: Only an unsent destination draft is visible; no service receipt. Supported conclusion: Draft visible; sending/handling unverified. Gap: Original request/receipt not supplied; do not infer no write. Decision: Keep pending; do not resend, create an ID or execute. These are editorial labels, not app imports or an audit API. Do not manufacture new events to complete a package, or represent a retrospective note as an original operation-time record. Review private references in their existing authorized scope, not copied to public comments or unapproved documents. Review order and minimal disclosure Split the claim: transcription complete, draft visible, reply recorded or person handled? One done label should not conflate stages. Check provenance/target and the reviewer’s read permission. Web/history readability is not write authority; do not request another person’s credentials. Record only necessary authorized references, fields and gaps. No real audio, customer text, workbench parameters or device identifiers in public artifacts. Preserve original request identity and uncertain-stop state after timeouts/missing receipts. A new action cannot supply proof of the old action. Report the narrowest conclusion and unreviewed stages. A review finding does not authorize merging, deployment, purchasing or email. What this checklist cannot certify It does not establish third-party log retention, trustworthy timestamps, end-to-end exactly-once behavior, deletion or legal compliance. Source code, static pages, examples and service receipts each have scope. Recording a reply does not establish execution by the named Agent. Reading reply history is not complete tracing of arbitrary material. FAQ Does Yihu provide a complete tamper-proof audit log? No such feature is asserted or added. Compare authorized existing evidence; retain missing-evidence gaps rather than treating this checklist as native recordkeeping. Does a draft screenshot establish sending? No. It supports at most the visible stage and may lack target/version context. Sending, service recording and handling need separate evidence. Does a service receipt establish Agent execution? Not as a blanket claim. Existing reply receipts establish the relevant service-record boundary, not automatic task-state changes or downstream outcomes. Can I send again to obtain audit proof? Do not manufacture evidence that way. New operations do not prove old ones and can duplicate. Use original-request/readback boundaries on uncertainty. Can I request a complete export when lacking access to evidence? Do not expand access or collect unnecessary data under an audit label. Use existing authorization and minimal scope, marking inaccessible material unreviewed. Does a completed checklist certify compliance or exactly-once delivery? No. Manual review supplies neither legal certification, a tamper-proof chain nor end-to-end delivery guarantees. Preserve scope and unknowns. Reading and evidence Ownership/archive checks · Phone replies/receipts · Fallback permission · Second-check evidence claims · Start · Privacy Evidence: README handoff/reply/history limits , one-handoff reservation .

### 手机、Watch、网页与附件为何字段不同？跨端简报呈现核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/cross-device-field-presentation/

手机、Watch、网页与附件为何字段不同？跨端简报呈现核对 不同载体不是同一份全量副本，字段少不等于数据丢失或任务完成 一呼的手机Radar、配对Watch摘要、网页草稿和分享附件有不同的数据与权限边界。Watch拿到的是手机已有待决策/验收摘要，并可裁剪；网页和附件则是用户选择交接的文字，不是手机台账镜像。跨端核对应先确认载体、来源身份和集合，再检查时间与字段，不从外观相似推断全字段同步或独立刷新。 与批次比较、模板改版的分工 批次比较面对同源两次导出，格式兼容面对生产者契约变化；这里比较 同一工作流程里不同载体本来就不同的呈现 。缺字段可能来自子集选择、裁剪、未提供数据或尚未交接，不能直接称作同步故障，更不能填造数据让各端看起来一样。 跨端字段与范围表 载体/字段 当前实现范围 核对方法 不可推断 手机tasks/decisions 全任务与待决策/验收子集，旧源可回退 先看来源有无tasks、界面筛选范围 子集少就代表台账没任务 Watch事项集合 配对手机提供的待处理摘要 看源时间、读取失败、手机可达性和裁剪提示 手表拥有完整台账或独立刷新源 Watch title/project/next 桥接时分别取最多160/80/600个字符前缀 回手机看完整来源，不从截断句作最终判断 每个字段都完整或字节与字符相同 Watch载荷 decode大小最多50000字节、事项最多200个，桥接可继续裁剪 结合truncated与“回手机”提示 200项保证全传、截断表示业务删除 来源/采集时间 sourceDate与capturedAt含义不同 用来源时间判断数据时效，不用封包时间替换 新封包意味着刚读源成功 目标身份 workbench/task及受保护来源/事项标记 由既有手机校验原事项，不自行构造标记 标记等同账号认证或手表直写授权 网页草稿 已选择目标里的未发送文字 核工作台/页面和具体草稿内容 自动成为Radar字段或已发送回复 文字附件 托盘暂存文字/Markdown，不附原录音 核版本和后续交接/上传阶段 全量台账镜像、原音频或自动跨端更新 这些数字是固定源码的载荷/前缀边界，不是网络吞吐、响应时间或所有设备配对成功率。前缀按Swift字符串处理，不能直接等同UTF-8字节。载荷受总大小限制，可能在200项之前就裁剪。 一个合成的字段缺口走读 手机：样例tasks有三项，其中一项等待决策。 Watch：只见这一项摘要，next文字被截短。 网页：尚未选择交接，所以没有该文字草稿。 正确解释：载体范围不同；回手机核完整来源。 不能解释：其余任务已完成、手表丢数据或网页同步失败。 样例不是本轮真机传输记录，不调用Watch、工作台或服务器。核对时保留未知与来源，只使用有权读取的最少必要信息；不要公开任务正文、源地址或内部身份标记。 核对顺序 先确认是不是同一来源/事项，再看每个载体承诺的集合与权限。随后核 sourceDate 、失败和裁剪状态；不要仅比较屏幕上显示几行。若要继续到手机或真实回复，仍走已有目标校验、忙碌守卫、手机确认及服务端授权，不能因为Watch能显示就跳过。 修改网页草稿或本地整理稿不会自动改手机源JSON，也不会保证已暂存附件更新。跨端校验只描述证据差异，不提供修复同步、字段转换或跨设备写入工具。 FAQ Watch是否应该显示手机所有tasks字段？ 不是。当前伴侣传递待处理摘要而非完整源台账，字段和数量可能裁剪，应回手机看完整来源。 next变短是否证明源文本被删了？ 不能。桥接有前缀和总载荷边界；显示裁剪不等于源被删除或更改。 capturedAt较新是否代表台账已刷新？ 不代表。封包时间与来源时间不同，手表同步可重发手机已有快照，不是独立源读取。 来源/事项标记是否授予手表直接审批？ 不能。它们用于既有目标保护检查，不取代账号/服务写权限与手机确认，本页不提供构造或绕过办法。 Markdown附件是否包含原录音和全任务？ 不能这样概括。当前笔记分享是文字或Markdown，不附原录音，也不自动成为全量台账快照。 在网页修订文字会同步改回Radar源吗？ 本页不声明这种同步。网页文字、手机源JSON和附件分别核对；没有新增双向字段同步或回写功能。 相关指南与源码 多项目Radar与Watch · 格式改版兼容 · 原文与显式交接 · 跟进证据最小化 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Watch载荷模型 、 手机桥接与裁剪 、 README 。

### Why fields differ across phone, Watch, web and attachments

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/cross-device-field-presentation/

Why fields differ across phone, Watch, web and attachments Different carriers are not full replicas; fewer fields do not prove loss or completion Phone Radar, paired Watch summaries, web drafts and share attachments have different data/permission boundaries. Watch receives the phone’s existing pending decision/acceptance summaries and may truncate them. Web drafts/attachments contain selected text, not a phone-ledger mirror. Start with carrier, source identity and collection, then compare time/fields. Similar appearance is not full synchronization or independent refresh. Separate from batches and format revisions Batch comparison inspects two exports from a source; compatibility review inspects producer changes. Here different carriers in one workflow intentionally present different scopes . Missing fields may reflect selection, truncation, absent data or no handoff, rather than sync failure. Do not fabricate values to make screens agree. Cross-device field and scope matrix Carrier/field Current scope Check Do not infer Phone tasks/decisions Ledger versus pending subset; legacy fallback Whether tasks exists and current view/filter scope Few pending items means few ledger tasks Watch items Paired-phone pending summaries Source time, read failures, reachability and truncation Full ledger or independent source refresh Watch title/project/next Bridge prefixes up to 160/80/600 characters Return to phone for full text before deciding Every field complete or characters equal bytes Watch payload Decode limit 50000 bytes and 200 items; bridge can trim further Inspect truncated/more-on-phone signals Guaranteed delivery of 200 items or deletion implied by trimming Source/capture time sourceDate differs from capturedAt Judge freshness using source time Fresh packaging proves a new successful source read Target identity workbench/task and protected source/item markers Existing phone checks resolve originals Markers are account authentication or direct Watch-write authority Web draft Selected text in an unsent destination Actual workbench/page/draft contents Automatic Radar field update or a sent reply Text attachment Tray text/Markdown, without original audio Actual version and later handoff/upload stage Full ledger/audio replica or automatic cross-device updating These are source-level payload/prefix limits, not bandwidth, latency or universal pairing-success results. Swift string prefixes are not UTF-8 byte counts. Total payload size can require trimming before 200 items. A synthetic missing-field comparison Phone: Three sample tasks; one awaits a decision. Watch: Only that pending summary appears, with shortened next text. Web: No handoff selected, so no matching draft exists. Interpretation: Carrier scopes differ; check complete source on the phone. Not established: Other tasks completed, Watch lost data or web synchronization failed. This is not an actual paired-device trace. It calls no Watch, workbench or server. Preserve unknowns/provenance and minimize private material; do not publish task text, feed addresses or protected identity markers. Review order Establish the same source/item first, then each carrier’s collection and permission scope. Inspect sourceDate , failure and truncation rather than counting display rows. Continuing on the phone or replying still requires target/busy checks, phone confirmation and server authority; Watch visibility cannot bypass them. Editing a web/local draft does not automatically update source JSON or staged attachments. This comparison adds no sync repair, field converter or cross-device write tool. FAQ Should Watch display every phone tasks field? No. It carries pending summaries rather than the full source ledger, with possible field/count truncation. Return to the phone for full context. Does shortened next prove deleted source text? No. Prefix and total-size limits can shorten presentation without deleting or changing the original. Does a recent capturedAt establish a refreshed ledger? No. Packaging and source time differ. Sync can republish an existing phone snapshot without an independent source read. Do source/item markers permit standalone Watch approval? No. They protect target checks, not account/server write authority or phone confirmation. This page offers no marker construction/bypass method. Does Markdown contain original audio and all tasks? Not as a general statement. Current note sharing is text/Markdown without original audio, not automatically a ledger snapshot. Does editing a web draft write back to Radar? No such sync is asserted. Check web text, phone source JSON and attachments separately. No bidirectional field sync/writeback is added. Guides and source Radar/Watch · Format compatibility · Originals and handoff · Follow-up evidence minimization · Start · Privacy Evidence: Watch payload model , phone bridge/trimming , README .

### 蓝牙音频切换后会恢复还是停止？短语音与录音笔记源码矩阵

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/audio-route-recovery-matrix/

蓝牙音频切换后会恢复还是停止？短语音与录音笔记源码矩阵 先确认正在走哪条录音路径，再解释对应事件 一呼短语音采集和长录音笔记使用不同处理路径。短语音在音频引擎配置变化时可能尝试保留转换器和已采PCM，但要求输入格式不变；笔记的输入变化路径会尝试重定向写入格式。恢复失败、来电或某些路由事件仍可能停止/提示中断。本页解释固定源码分支，不是所有蓝牙设备切换的无损恢复承诺，也不新增恢复按钮或故障探针。 与输入排障、网页切换的区别 输入排障先问为什么没有声音/文字，网页切换指南检查输出和采集的互斥；这里面对 录音已经开始之后，某种系统事件会走哪条代码分支 。不能把短语音的条件套到笔记，也不能把笔记有重定向逻辑解读成网页通话必然继续。 路径与事件恢复矩阵 录音路径/事件 当前源码分支 继续所需条件 仍须核对的结果 短语音：引擎配置变化 重建输入tap/图并尝试重启 活跃记录身份匹配、仍录音、原引擎/管线可用且输入格式相同 是否有失败/中断、文字是否完整；不是自动送达 短语音：输入格式变化 转换器不能安全复用则失败停止 不以强转格式绕过检查 保留可用结果与错误，不声称继续无损 短语音：重启失败 标记中断并停止引擎 无继续成功推断 看实际状态，不连续点击重录制造重复 短语音：重复配置通知 条件满足时去抖，不重复触发恢复 同一记录身份、引擎运行、格式/路由不变且在宽限内 去抖不是忽略真正的新设备变化 短语音：来电开始/媒体服务丢失或重置 对应监听分支使采集失败并停止 按实际事件和当前录音状态处理 没有“来电后一定自动接着录”的保证 短语音：被处理的路由通知 oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory进入中断分支 其他原因有过滤，仍可能另有引擎配置事件 不从通知被过滤推断输入可用或录音未受影响 录音笔记：引擎配置变化 停旧tap、尝试writer重定向、重装tap并启动 仍是当前记录/引擎且重定向与启动成功 失败会提示保存到此前，需查音频和接缝 录音笔记：来电/音频服务重置 对应中断提示路径 按实际保存状态核对 不承诺后台持续、任意时长或绝不丢字 短语音当前格式相等检查包括采样率、通道数、公共格式和交错状态。去抖源码默认宽限为2秒，但它是内部事件条件，不是重连耗时、UI等待时长或恢复SLA。不能通过手动等待两秒就证明某款耳机已经恢复。 遇到变化后的人工检查顺序 先在安全静止环境停下业务操作，辨认短语音还是录音笔记。记录不含私人信息的事件类别（例如来电或更换耳机）、前后可见状态以及是否已有文字；不要收集设备唯一标识、真实录音或客户正文来公开复现。 再看当前保存/转写/错误状态，不从“耳机重新连接”跳到“原录音完整”。需要检查的内容包括断点附近的数字、否定和语句接缝；未核就保持未知。若文字已尝试交接，继续原目标与一次标记边界，音频恢复不是重发许可。 本文不要求关闭系统保护、改采样率、清记录或强制重启服务；也不提供让用户人为制造中断的自动脚本。无法安全复现就保留最小错误描述给已有维护流程。 FAQ 短语音和录音笔记能用同一恢复结论吗？ 不能。它们的管线、格式处理和错误路径不同，必须先识别记录入口与实际版本，再对照分支。 短语音格式变化后能强行复用旧转换器吗？ 源码选择失败停止而非不安全复用。本文不提供绕过办法，也不把失败停止解释成无损继续。 等两秒就能确保蓝牙恢复吗？ 不能。两秒是去抖宽限的代码常量，依赖记录身份、引擎、格式和路由条件，不是蓝牙性能指标。 笔记writer支持重定向是否说明任何耳机都能无缝切换？ 不说明。重定向和重启仍可能失败，实际保存及接缝要核；没有本轮型号/固件/场景的真机恢复矩阵。 音频恢复成功可以自动补发刚才的草稿吗？ 不能。音频采集与交接结果是不同状态，已有填入、拒绝或不确定结果仍按原守卫和标记处理。 提交问题需要完整路由UID或真实录音吗？ 不应为公开反馈收集这些资料。先提供版本、设备型号、事件类别和合成内容的可见结果，私有数据仅沿已有获准流程处理。 相关指南与源码 输入分层排障 · 网页输出/采集切换 · 片段复核 · 降级前许可 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 短语音事件、格式检查与去抖 、 笔记输入重定向与中断 。这是源码矩阵，不冒浏览器视觉或真机音频验收。

Parameter/comparison tables (HTML) / 参数对照表：

<th>仍须核对的结果</th>
</tr>

<tr>
<td>短语音：引擎配置变化</td>

<td>短语音：输入格式变化</td>
<td>转换器不能安全复用则失败停止</td>

<td>保留可用结果与错误，不声称继续无损</td>

<td>看实际状态，不连续点击重录制造重复</td>
</tr>
<tr>
