<td>条件满足时去抖，不重复触发恢复</td>
<td>同一记录身份、引擎运行、格式/路由不变且在宽限内</td>
<td>去抖不是忽略真正的新设备变化</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>短语音：来电开始/媒体服务丢失或重置</td>
<td>对应监听分支使采集失败并停止</td>
<td>按实际事件和当前录音状态处理</td>
<td>没有“来电后一定自动接着录”的保证</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>短语音：被处理的路由通知</td>
<td>oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory进入中断分支</td>
<td>其他原因有过滤，仍可能另有引擎配置事件</td>
<td>不从通知被过滤推断输入可用或录音未受影响</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>录音笔记：引擎配置变化</td>
<td>停旧tap、尝试writer重定向、重装tap并启动</td>
<td>仍是当前记录/引擎且重定向与启动成功</td>
<td>失败会提示保存到此前，需查音频和接缝</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>录音笔记：来电/音频服务重置</td>
<td>对应中断提示路径</td>
<td>按实际保存状态核对</td>
<td>不承诺后台持续、任意时长或绝不丢字</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Recover or stop after an audio switch? Short speech versus recording-note source matrix

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/audio-route-recovery-matrix/

Recover or stop after an audio switch? Short speech versus recording-note source matrix Identify the capture path before interpreting the event Short-speech capture and recording notes use different paths. Short speech can attempt to retain its converter/captured PCM after engine configuration changes only with an unchanged input format. Notes try writer retargeting after an input change. Restart failures, calls and some route events can still stop capture or report interruption. This explains fixed source branches, not lossless Bluetooth-switch acceptance or a new recovery button/probe. Different from input diagnosis and web switching Input diagnosis asks why audio/text is absent; web switching separates output and capture. Here recording has already started and an event selects a source branch . Do not apply short-speech conditions to notes or infer an uninterrupted web call from writer retargeting. Capture path and event matrix Path/event Current branch Continuation conditions Result still needing review Short speech: engine configuration change Rebuild input tap/graph and attempt restart Same active record, still recording, existing engine/pipeline and unchanged input format Failure/interruption and text completeness; not delivery Short speech: changed input format Fail closed rather than reuse an unsafe converter No format-coercion bypass Retained result/error, not lossless continuation Short speech: restart failure Mark interrupted and stop engine No success inference Actual state; no repeated recording that duplicates content Short speech: repeated configuration notification Conditional debounce avoids repeated recovery Same record, running engine, unchanged format/route within grace period Not ignoring genuine device changes Short speech: interruption began/media services lost/reset Corresponding observer fails capture and stops Actual event/current recording state No always-resume-after-call promise Short speech: handled route notification oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory interrupt Other reasons filtered, but an engine event can also occur Filtered does not establish valid input/unaffected capture Notes: engine configuration change Stop tap, try writer retargeting, reinstall tap/start Same active recording/engine with successful retarget/start Failure can report retention up to that point; inspect audio/joins Notes: call/media-service reset Corresponding interruption-message path Check actual saved state No continuous-background, arbitrary-duration or no-loss guarantee Short-speech format equality checks sample rate, channel count, common format and interleaving. The debounce’s current default grace is two seconds, an internal conditional window, not reconnection latency, a UI wait time or recovery SLA. Waiting two seconds does not prove a headset recovered. Manual review after a change Stop business operations in a safe stationary setting and identify short speech versus notes. Record non-sensitive event categories, such as a call/headset switch, visible before/after states and whether text exists. Do not collect unique route/device identifiers, actual audio or customer text for public reproduction. Inspect saved/transcription/error state rather than jumping from reconnected to complete recording. Review quantities, negations and joins near interruption, retaining unknowns. If text was already handed off, original target/one-handoff rules remain: audio recovery is not resend permission. This page does not ask users to disable system protection, alter sample rates, clear records or forcibly restart services. No automatic interruption-generation script is supplied. When safe reproduction is impossible, give the existing maintenance process a minimal error description. FAQ Can short speech and recording notes share one recovery conclusion? No. Their pipelines, format handling and failures differ. Identify the recording entry point and actual version before applying a branch. Can a changed short-speech input forcibly reuse the old converter? The source fails closed instead of unsafe reuse. No bypass is supplied, and failing closed is not lossless continuation. Does waiting two seconds guarantee Bluetooth recovery? No. Two seconds is a debounce constant conditional on identity, engine, format and route, not a Bluetooth performance result. Does writer retargeting guarantee every headset switches seamlessly? No. Retarget/restart can fail; inspect actual retention and joins. This work supplies no device/firmware/scenario recovery acceptance matrix. Can recovered audio automatically resend the earlier draft? No. Capture and handoff are separate states. Prior insertion/refusal/uncertainty keeps original guards and markers. Does a report require full route UIDs or real recordings? Do not collect them for public feedback. Start with version, model, event category and synthetic-content outcomes; private material stays within existing authorized procedures. Reading and source Input diagnosis · Web output/capture transition · Passage review · Fallback permission · Start · Privacy Evidence: short-speech events/format/debounce , note retarget/interruption . A source matrix is not browser-visual or device-audio acceptance.

### 客户跟进证据归档前：最小披露、私有引用与副本范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/followup-evidence-minimization/

客户跟进证据归档前：最小披露、私有引用与副本范围核对 证据足够不等于资料越多越好，先核可保留与可披露的范围 团队若把已有客户跟进任务导出为Radar JSON，应继续按来源权限使用；一呼不是CRM、客户采集器或外贸数据归档平台。这里专门检查归档材料中的不必要正文、身份与链接参数，把私有原始依据和对外合成说明分开。它不是自动脱敏工具、合规认证或一键删除副本功能。 与认领、证据审计和二次核实的分工 责任认领清单核谁确认、资料该存哪里；事后审计核完成主张是否有依据；证据二次核实核单个异常主张真假。此处的任务是 在已有获准证据准备保存或分享时，只保留必要内容并标明私有范围 ，不再决定谁负责或裁定业务真相。 归档/披露前最小材料表 材料 先问的问题 合成/最小化做法 不可据此保证 任务标题与next 是否含客户姓名、订单或内部指令？ 公开说明用无真实含义的样例，不照抄正文 App自动识别并移除敏感内容 evidence URL 参数、路径或片段是否暴露身份/令牌？ 私有引用留在原授权范围；公开样例用example.invalid HTTPS候选已脱敏、内容可信或可公开 来源/任务标识 是否确有必要暴露内部UUID/保护标记？ 使用人工样例代号，不外传实际标记 假名化即匿名或解除访问权限要求 原始音频/转写 是否必须为该归档目的保留？ 优先引用获准最小范围，别为公开演示上传录音 本地存储天然无备份/副本 回执/回复历史 是否含私人事项与原请求信息？ 有权复核者在原流程读必要部分 读取权限等于全文导出/公开授权 截图与日志 是否显示账号、源地址、客户正文或设备信息？ 公开回证仅用合成内容与非敏感结果 官网或App自动遮挡截图内容 文档/剪贴板/附件 是否扩大复制、同步或可访问范围？ 核实际目的地规则和必要副本 删除一份即可撤回全部资料 保存期限与访问 团队已有规则和获准角色是什么？ 引用实际规则，未知就停 统一保留时长、保证删除或合规通过 一个只含合成信息的公开说明 来源：样例项目sample，不是真实客户/订单。 核对范围：字段形态与可见状态，不提供原始业务正文。 证据链接：https://example.invalid/evidence/sample 归档位置：按已有授权规则确认，未创建新共享位置。 尚未确认：私有原记录的保留/访问范围，由原流程处理。 该链接是保留域名，不提供真实可访问证据，也不应被写进生产台账冒充原始记录。公开合成说明和私有真实依据作用不同；不能删掉所有来源信息后又声称公开说明足以证明真实客户事项。 从已获准材料到最小归档包 先定义归档目的和有权阅读者，再逐项判断是否需要正文、音频、标识或仅一个受权限控制的原记录引用。没有权限时，记录未核而不是索取更多材料。不要为实现所谓“完整归档”新建账号、公开共享链接或批量导出私人任务。 原生Radar保留来源文字，并不会因 safeEvidenceURLs 筛出HTTPS就替你移除查询参数。笔记文字交接也不代表原音频或其他副本已删除。人工整理之后仍须核原笔记交接状态和目的地已有内容，不能用脱敏稿绕过一次交接或不确定停止。 FAQ 一呼是否能自动归档客户往来和跟进证据？ 本文不声明这种CRM能力。这里只解释团队自有获准任务数据的最小化检查，不采集客户、发信或自动建档。 HTTPS证据链接会被App自动脱敏吗？ 不能据此推断。当前解析检查链接形态，不保证移除参数、身份或业务路径；公开材料需人工按实际权限核查。 把客户名字改成角色A就一定匿名了吗？ 不一定。正文、时间、路径、订单和其他组合仍可能识别对象。本页不提供匿名化认证，公开示例应使用完全合成内容。 有权看Radar就有权导出全部历史吗？ 不能这样扩大权限。按原事项、服务与团队规则核必要范围，读取和批量导出/公开是不同操作。 归档后删手机记录是否意味着服务端副本也删除？ 不是。工作台、剪贴板、附件、账户同步和备份可能各留副本，需按实际目的地规则核对，不保证远端撤回。 最小化之后仍可声明真实业务已验收吗？ 只有真实且获准的依据支持相应范围时才可作有限结论；合成公开说明本身不是原记录、批准、送达或处理证明。 相关指南与依据 部门认领与归档 · 交接证据审计 · 异常证据二次核实 · 跨端字段呈现 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar原文字段与证据解析 、 README分享/历史/权限边界 。

### Before archiving follow-up evidence: minimal disclosure, private references and copies

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/followup-evidence-minimization/

Before archiving follow-up evidence: minimal disclosure, private references and copies Sufficient evidence is not maximum collection; check retention and disclosure scope first Teams exporting existing follow-up tasks to Radar JSON keep the source’s permissions. Yihu is not a CRM, customer collector or trade-data archive. This guide checks unnecessary text, identities and URL parameters in material being retained/shared, separating private originals from public synthetic examples. It is not an automatic redactor, compliance certification or delete-all-copies feature. Different from ownership, claim audit and verification Ownership checks responsibility/storage; evidence audit checks completion claims; second checks assess evidence for one anomaly claim. Here already authorized material is being prepared for retention/disclosure, so minimize content and mark private scope . It does not assign owners or adjudicate business truth. Minimal material before retention/disclosure Material First question Minimal/synthetic treatment Not guaranteed Task title/next Customer names, orders or internal instructions? Use meaningless synthetic examples publicly, not copied business text Automatic sensitive-content detection/removal evidence URL Identity/tokens in query, path or fragment? Private references remain authorized; public examples use example.invalid HTTPS candidates are redacted, trustworthy or public Source/item identity Is an internal UUID/protected marker necessary? Use editorial sample labels, not actual markers Pseudonyms guarantee anonymity or waive permission Original audio/text Necessary for this retention purpose? Prefer authorized minimal scope; no recordings for public demos Local storage has no backup/copies Receipts/history Private items or original-request information? Authorized reviewers inspect only necessary source material Read access permits complete export/publication Screenshots/logs Accounts, feeds, customer text or device identity visible? Synthetic content and non-sensitive outcomes publicly Automatic screenshot masking Documents/clipboard/attachments Expanded copying, syncing or access? Check actual destination rules and necessary copies One deletion recalls everything Retention/access Actual policy and authorized roles? Cite existing policy; stop if unknown One retention period, guaranteed deletion or compliance A fully synthetic public explanation Source: Sample project, not a real customer/order. Scope: Field shape and visible state, without original business text. Evidence example: https://example.invalid/evidence/sample Archive: Confirm existing authorized rules; no new share destination created. Unknown: Private-source retention/access remains with the original process. The reserved-domain example supplies no real evidence and should not be placed in a live ledger as an original record. Public synthetic explanations and private authentic evidence serve different purposes. Removing all provenance does not make a public example proof of a real customer item. From authorized material to a minimal package Define retention purpose and authorized readers before deciding whether text, audio, identifiers or a controlled original reference is necessary. Mark unavailable evidence unreviewed rather than demanding more data. Do not provision accounts, public shares or bulk private-task exports under a complete-archive label. Native Radar retains source text; safeEvidenceURLs selecting HTTPS does not strip queries. Text handoff does not delete original audio or other copies. After editing, still inspect note reservation/destination state. A redacted draft cannot bypass one-handoff or uncertain-stop guards. FAQ Does Yihu automatically archive customer correspondence and evidence? No CRM capability is asserted. This is minimization guidance for your authorized task data, without customer collection, email or automatic record creation. Are HTTPS evidence links automatically redacted? Do not infer that. Parsing checks shape, not removal of parameters, identity or business paths. Review public material manually under actual permissions. Does replacing a name with role A guarantee anonymity? No. Text, time, paths, orders and combinations can remain identifying. No anonymization certification is supplied; use fully synthetic public examples. Does Radar visibility permit exporting all history? No. Check original-item, service and team scope. Reading, bulk export and publication are different operations. Does deleting phone records delete remote copies after archiving? No. Workbenches, clipboard, attachments, account sync and backups can retain separate copies. Check actual policies without a remote-recall guarantee. Does minimization establish acceptance of the real business event? Only actual authorized evidence supports a limited conclusion. A synthetic public explanation is not the original, approval, delivery or handling record. Guides and evidence Ownership/archive planning · Handoff evidence audit · Second-check claims · Cross-device presentation · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar source fields/link parsing , README sharing/history/permissions .

### 多轮语音追问前：指代、工作台页面与Agent上下文核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/follow-up-context-preflight/

多轮语音追问前：指代、工作台页面与Agent上下文核对 网页还在原处不等于Agent记住上一轮，追问先消除指代歧义 一呼把原生语音转成文字并按目标守卫尝试交给兼容网页草稿，不提供通用Agent后端或跨工作台对话记忆。真正的会话上下文由实际网页/服务决定。“上一条”“这个”“继续”在换页、换工作台或历史未核时可能没有明确对象；追问前应先确认所指材料、当前会话与目标输入框，而不是让App推测意图。 与首次接入、改字或重复交接的分工 首次评估判断条件齐备，人工修订检查文本副本；这里专门核对 下一轮文字是否有明确前文和获准目标 。它不建议为了找回上下文自动重发上一段，也不把已经显示在网页的内容当作服务已读取或已执行的证明。 追问上下文预检表 检查项 先确认的材料 合成例子 不应推断 所指对象 上一条究竟是哪段文字/哪个样例 合成句A，不是真实订单 “它”天然指向正确业务对象 工作台 当前获准HTTPS来源 只在已有自有工作台核对 浏览器可达等于服务端身份与写权限 页面/会话 当前页面与实际服务会话 是否仍为已核样例草稿会话 原生导航恢复等于模型记忆恢复 目标输入框 原页面里可编辑、未发送的草稿 先聚焦兼容输入框 可以写入任意编辑器或终端 历史范围 服务是否实际提供所需前文 可见历史仍需核内容和范围 看得见上文就已送入Agent上下文 文字意图 整理、提案与执行请求分开 只改样例措辞，不发送 追问语气等于批准执行 原交接结果 先前是否已填入、暂存或不确定 已有草稿只检查 无回执就允许把上文再交一遍 目标变化 录音/打开笔记时捕获页面与当前状态 换页后重新核对原守卫 打开记录后换源会自动改绑目标 去歧义的合成改写 有歧义：继续，把它改成两项。 更明确的草稿：仅核对本地合成句A中的示例清单措辞；条目数量未确认，不发送、不执行。 仍需确认：当前工作台/会话是否就是获准的样例目的地。 改写只是用户表达建议，不提供模型正确理解保证，也不触发Agent或服务。不要把真实客户信息或完整私人会话复制到公开示例来补上下文。 页面绑定与服务上下文不能互相替代 原生草稿交付有来源、页面、请求和宿主拒绝等守卫；录音笔记显式填入也使用打开记录时捕获的工作台/页面。它们限制文字能去哪里，不决定Agent是否纳入历史、如何解释代词或是否持久保存会话。不能因为守卫通过就称为“上下文理解正确”。 工作台之间的WebKit交互状态恢复只属于已实现的导航范围，不复制跨来源身份，不创建统一对话数据库。若前文来源、原交接或会话状态未知，先保留文字并停止，不通过换页面、复制旧轮或清标记补送来猜测正确上下文。 FAQ 一呼会自动记住所有工作台里的上一轮语音吗？ 本文不声明这种跨工作台记忆。App是浏览器壳和语音草稿增强，真正Agent会话由各服务管理。 页面历史恢复是否意味着模型上下文恢复？ 不是同一事实。导航/滚动等网页交互状态与后端模型使用的历史范围不同，需要实际服务证据。 “继续”或“上一条”可以不说明对象吗？ 不宜在对象不明时这样做。先核所指材料与会话，必要时在获准范围写清合成引用，不让读者推断真实目标。 需要追问可以自动重发上一轮来补上下文吗？ 不能因此盲目重发。原内容可能已交接或结果不确定，应先核目标已有内容并遵守原请求/一次交接边界。 打开笔记后切换页面，显式填入会自动跟随吗？ 不应这样假定。显式笔记交接绑定打开记录时捕获的目标，并在交接前检查；目标变化需按现有守卫处理，不绕过。 模型看起来理解了追问就可以执行全部操作吗？ 不可以。文字理解、用户明确意图和服务端授权是不同层级；原确认、写权限与回执不能省略。 相关指南与源码 语音草稿路径 · 网页输出/采集切换 · 原文与笔记目标 · 人工摘要引用映射 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 草稿目标守卫 、 笔记捕获目标与交接检查 、 README服务边界 。

### Before a voice follow-up: references, workbench page and Agent context

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/follow-up-context-preflight/

Before a voice follow-up: references, workbench page and Agent context The page staying open does not prove Agent memory; resolve references before following up Yihu transcribes native speech and attempts guarded delivery to compatible drafts. It supplies no universal Agent backend or cross-workbench conversation memory. Actual context belongs to the site/service. Previous, it and continue can become ambiguous after page/workbench changes or unverified history. Identify the referenced material, current conversation and composer first, not an app-inferred intent. Different from setup, correction and repeat delivery Readiness checks prerequisites; correction checks text copies. Here the next utterance needs an explicit antecedent and authorized target . Do not automatically resend the previous passage to restore context, or treat visible page text as proof the service read/executed it. Follow-up context preflight Check Material to establish Synthetic example Do not infer Referent Which previous phrase/item is meant Synthetic phrase A, not a real order It points to the correct business object automatically Workbench Current authorized HTTPS source Existing own workbench only Reachability is server identity/write permission Page/conversation Current page and actual service session Is this the reviewed sample-draft session? Navigation restoration is model memory restoration Composer Editable unsent field on the original page Focus the compatible draft first Arbitrary editor/terminal insertion is permitted History scope Service actually provides the required context Visible history still needs scope/content review Visible history necessarily reached the Agent context Intended operation Organization, proposal and execution differ Edit sample wording only; do not send Follow-up tone grants execution authority Prior handoff Inserted/staged/uncertain state Inspect an existing draft Missing receipt permits another delivery of prior text Changed destination Captured and current page/state Recheck guards after navigation A source switch automatically retargets an opened note A less ambiguous synthetic draft Ambiguous: Continue; change it to two items. More explicit: Review only the wording of local synthetic phrase A. Item count is unconfirmed; do not send or execute. Still check: The current workbench/conversation is the authorized sample destination. This is wording guidance, not guaranteed model interpretation or an Agent/service call. Do not copy a private conversation/customer data into a public example to add context. Destination binding is not backend context Native draft delivery has source/page/request/host-refusal guards. Explicit note insertion uses the workbench/page captured when notes opened. These constrain where text may go; they do not determine which history a model receives, how pronouns are interpreted or whether a service persists conversations. A passed target guard does not establish correct understanding. Implemented WebKit interaction restoration concerns navigation scope, not cross-origin identity copying or a unified conversation database. With unknown source, prior result or conversation, retain text and stop. Do not guess context by changing pages, repeating old rounds or clearing markers. FAQ Does Yihu remember all prior speech across workbenches? No such cross-workbench memory is asserted. It is a browser shell with voice drafts; the actual Agent conversation belongs to each service. Does restored page history establish restored model context? No. Navigation/scroll state and the history supplied to a backend model are different facts requiring actual service evidence. Can continue or previous omit the referenced object? Avoid that when the object is unclear. Check material/conversation and state a synthetic reference within authorized scope rather than asking a reader to infer a real target. Can a follow-up automatically resend the prior round to restore context? No blind resend follows. It may already be delivered or uncertain; inspect destination content and retain original request/one-handoff boundaries. Does explicit note insertion follow page changes after opening notes? Do not assume so. The note target is captured on opening and checked before insertion. Follow existing guards without retargeting by bypass. Does apparent understanding authorize every requested operation? No. Interpretation, explicit user intent and server authority differ. Original confirmation, write permission and receipts remain necessary. Reading and source Voice-draft choices · Web output/capture transition · Originals and note targets · Manual summary provenance · Start · Privacy Evidence: draft-target guards , note target capture/checks , README service limits .

### 商机任务Radar的人工摘要怎样溯源？逐句引用与范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-summary-claim-provenance/

商机任务Radar的人工摘要怎样溯源？逐句引用与范围核对 摘要更短，证据范围不能被写大；每句话都要能回到来源 如果团队把已有询盘/跟进任务提供为PM Radar JSON，可以人工编写简短说明，但一呼不由本文新增商机摘要引擎。逐句溯源先确定来源和范围，再说明哪句话来自哪些字段、哪里仍未知。不能把“源标等待验收”缩写成“已经验收”，也不能因为有引用链接就把提案写成批准或外部真实性结论。 与二次核实和批次比较的分工 证据二查判断一个异常主张的依据是否充分，批次比较判断两份导出是否可比；这里核对 从多字段压缩成一句摘要时，是否丢失限定、归因和范围 。人工句号编号、来源代号与引用表都只是编辑材料，不是App自动生成的引用ID或审计功能。 摘要句子到源字段映射表 摘要要表达的内容 应回查的源字段/依据 可以保留的归因 不应改写成 哪个项目/事项 project、已有id及已核来源 来源中的样例事项 同名标题必定是同一客户/订单 事项标题 title原文及上下文 原文称需要核对 标题语气证明事件真实或紧急 当前状态 status是否明确提供 来源标为“等你验收” 已验收、已批准或已完成 建议下一步 next里的条件、否定与提案 原文建议先核对 已获执行授权或已安排发送 优先级 priority及来源解释 来源提供P0/P1或未提供 具体损失、承诺时限或未提供时视为不重要 来源时间 date_str与读取失败/缓存情况 截至该来源读取范围的记录 当前实时事实或手机刷新即最新 证据引用 evidence及既有获准原记录 此处有可回查引用，内容需核 HTTPS等于可信/无隐私/已批准 未知与总结 哪些字段缺失、哪些主张无映射 保留待核或删除无依据摘要句 为让摘要完整而补造细节 一份合成的逐句映射 人工来源代号S-A：样例事项，status=等你验收；next=建议下次核对，尚未批准；priority未提供。 拟写句1：样例事项已经验收并获准执行。 映射结果：status不支持“已经”，next明确尚未批准；句1不采用。 可支持改写：来源标样例事项为等待验收；下一步为未批准的核对建议，优先级未知。 S-A和句1是人工示意，不是实际任务标识、JSON字段或已跑过的自动检测结果。公开示例不含真实客户正文或私有证据地址，也不调用模型。若外部获准工具协助压缩文字，仍需同样逐句核对，不能由模型表达流畅程度代替证据。 归因、范围和引用位置 建议先保存原句与来源位置，再写带归因的短句，例如“来源标为……”而不是未经核实的全局断言。明确是 tasks 全集合、 decisions 子集、当前筛选还是Watch摘要；只有子集材料不能给全台账下结论。 私有原记录应在原获准范围核对，不为公开摘要复制完整任务或带参数链接。字段存在只说明来源提供了值，不证明记录权威、内容真实或账号拥有写权。找不到映射的句子应保持未核/不采用，而不是补造链接来装饰摘要。 FAQ 一呼会自动生成商机摘要和引用吗？ 本文不声明或新增这种引擎。现有实现读取自有任务JSON与摘要载体，这里的写句、编号和映射是人工建议。 “等你验收”可以缩写成“验收完成”吗？ 不可以。等待与完成语义相反，压缩文字必须保留状态与归因，不能把子集标签改成批准结论。 标题里有客户称呼能直接推断同一客户记录吗？ 不应这样关联。先核来源与稳定事项身份，不凭名字或相似标题推定客户/订单一致，公开说明也不复制私人信息。 每句都加HTTPS链接是否足够溯源？ 不够。还要核引用支持的具体主张、权限、版本与范围；链接形态本身不验证真实性或批准状态。 没有priority或时间信息时，摘要可以省略未知吗？ 不能让省略制造已核假象。若相关结论依赖缺失信息，应明确未知或不作该结论，不默认补当前时间或低优先级。 摘要通过人工核对后能自动发给客户吗？ 本页不提供自动发送或写权限。核对文字、批准交接与客户沟通是不同操作，仍按原授权与目的地规则处理。 相关指南与依据 证据二次核实 · 批次比较 · 格式改版兼容 · 客户证据最小化 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar字段与证据解析 、 README集合与回复边界 。

<td>为让摘要完整而补造细节</td>
</tr>

### Trace a manual opportunity-task summary: sentence-to-field provenance

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-summary-claim-provenance/

Trace a manual opportunity-task summary: sentence-to-field provenance Shorter wording must not expand evidence; trace each sentence to its source Teams supplying existing inquiry/follow-up tasks as PM Radar JSON may write manual summaries; this article adds no opportunity-summary engine. Establish source/scope, then map sentences to fields and retain unknowns. Waiting for acceptance cannot become accepted, and a link cannot turn a proposal into approval or an independently verified external fact. Different from second checks and batch comparison Second checks assess evidence for one anomaly claim; batch comparison establishes comparability of exports. Here compressing several fields into a sentence must preserve conditions, attribution and scope . Sentence numbers, source labels and citation tables are editorial aids, not app-generated reference IDs or an audit feature. Sentence-to-field provenance table Summary content Source field/evidence Supported attribution Do not rewrite as Project/item identity project, existing id and reviewed source Sample item in this source Same title proves the same customer/order Item title Original title/context Source says review is needed Wording proves an actual urgent event Current state Explicit status if supplied Source labels waiting for acceptance Accepted, approved or complete Proposed next step Conditions, negations and proposals in next Source suggests review first Execution authorized or sending scheduled Priority priority and source explanation Supplied P0/P1 or unknown Specific loss/deadline or unknown means unimportant Source time date_str plus read/cache state Within that source-read scope A current live fact or refresh tap means fresh Evidence reference evidence and authorized original record A reference exists; content needs review HTTPS means true, non-private or approved Unknowns/conclusion Absent fields and unmapped claims Pending review or remove unsupported sentence Invented details to complete a summary A synthetic sentence map Editorial source S-A: Sample item; status=waiting for acceptance; next=suggest review next time, not approved; priority absent. Candidate sentence 1: The sample was accepted and execution authorized. Mapping: Status does not support accepted; next explicitly lacks approval. Reject sentence 1. Supported rewrite: Source marks the sample pending acceptance; next is an unapproved review suggestion, priority unknown. S-A and sentence 1 are manual examples, not real task IDs, JSON fields or executed detector output. No real customer text/private evidence address or model call is involved. An authorized external summarizer still requires the same review; fluent prose is not evidence. Attribution, scope and reference locations Retain original wording/location before writing attributed text such as source labels rather than a global assertion. Identify whether material is full tasks , a decisions subset, current filters or a Watch summary. Subset evidence cannot establish a whole-ledger conclusion. Review private originals within existing permissions rather than copying full tasks or parameterized links into public summaries. A supplied field establishes a source value, not authority, truth or write permission. Unmapped sentences remain unreviewed or unused; do not fabricate decorative references. FAQ Does Yihu automatically generate opportunity summaries/citations? No engine is asserted or added. Existing source reads task JSON and summary carriers; sentence writing, numbering and mapping here are manual guidance. Can waiting for acceptance be shortened to accepted? No. Waiting and completion are opposite states. Preserve status/attribution without turning a subset label into approval. Can a customer-like title establish the same customer record? Not by title similarity. Verify source/stable item identity, and do not copy personal information into a public example. Is an HTTPS citation per sentence enough? No. Review which claim the reference supports, permission, version and scope. Link shape alone validates neither truth nor approval. Can missing priority/time simply disappear from a summary? Do not let omission imply verification. Mark unknown or omit conclusions that depend on absent evidence, without invented current time/low priority. Can a reviewed summary automatically be sent to a customer? No automated sending/write authority is supplied. Text review, handoff approval and customer communication are different operations under original permissions. Reading and evidence Second-check evidence · Batch comparison · Format compatibility · Follow-up minimization · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar fields/link parsing , README collection/reply limits .

### 车停稳或展会录音前：高噪场景外设拾音条件核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/vehicle-exhibition-microphone-preflight/

车停稳或展会录音前：高噪场景外设拾音条件核对 先决定能否安全且获准采集，再检查外设，不用噪声场景证明性能 需要移动办公记录时，应停车到安全位置或离开展会通道/设备危险区，并确认录音范围获准；不得在驾驶或需要注意周边时操作手机。蓝牙、车载或有线外设的名称只说明连接线索，不证明实际输入、模型可用或噪声识别达标。一呼的近场音频配置是源码策略，本页没有高噪实测、型号推荐保证或新外设选择功能。 与已有指南的分工 静止场景指南给出通用文字交接流程；蓝牙排障用于已经失败的采集；恢复矩阵用于录音开始后的系统事件。本页检查的是 开始前外设各自承担输入还是输出、是否有安全与权限条件值得采集 ，不要求通过反复切换设备制造问题。 录音前外设与环境检查表 场景/外设 开始前确认 可用的非敏感依据 停止条件/不能承诺 停车位置 已停稳、不妨碍交通且符合适用规则 仅记录是否有安全静止条件 行驶或需关注环境时不操作，不承诺免提驾驶 展会位置 允许录音，避开无关人员与通道 获准的合成句和限定采集范围 未获准不录，不采集顾客/胸牌/私密洽谈 手机内置输入 实际系统输入与麦克风授权 当前权限/路由可见状态 不从手机在旁边推断正在用内置麦克风 蓝牙耳机 输入与输出角色分别核 型号/系统版本和实际路由，不含唯一标识 已配对不等于耳机麦克风启用或型号兼容 车载蓝牙 当前连接由哪个系统/会话使用 实际可见路由与当前音频操作 车载播放成功不证明App采集或锁屏可用 有线/USB/转接外设 系统是否实际提供输入与兼容格式 设备类型与可见状态 本页不认证任意转接器或要求购买新设备 扬声器/其他播放 是否会影响合成采集或泄露资料 结束自己开启的不必要播放 voiceChat不构成零回声/噪声处理成绩 模型/目标 模型已校验、空白草稿获准且不自动执行 当前版本与目标条件 有外设不替代模型、服务、权限或确认 只在条件齐备时作一次合成检查 先明确想保留的是本地笔记还是自有工作台草稿，不把设备测试送到真实订单或客户沟通里。使用“整理示例物品清单，只留草稿，不发送”这类无真实任务语句；检查录音、转写和目标时仍要把阶段分开。本页不运行测试，不请求权限，也不会连接外设。 遇到环境不适合或输入不明，保留未通过项并停止，不把音量调高、靠近他人谈话或连续重录作为默认解决方案。如果已经开始后换设备或来电，改看相应音频恢复矩阵，不能沿用“开始前已检查”当作录音完整证明。 记录条件，不制作假的性能结论 可用的记录是“在获准静止位置、这次实际路由仍未确认，因此未开始”，而不是“车载蓝牙已支持高噪通话”。型号、固件、距离、背景声音、输入路由和模型都会影响实际结果；源码设置不能替代固定设备与环境的证据。 不承诺风噪抑制、信噪比、距离、准确率、耗电或锁屏持续性。设备选择也不产生群组语音频道、实时调度或紧急通信保证。若需求是安全相关联络，应使用团队已有经验证的通信方式，不靠本静态指南。 FAQ 车载蓝牙连接后可以边开车边操作一呼吗？ 不应按本页这样做。先在安全位置停车并遵守适用规则，不让手机操作或耳机隔绝必要环境声影响安全。 展会上能用真实顾客谈话作识别样例吗？ 不应为公开测试采集真实顾客、胸牌或私人洽谈。先核录音授权与范围，只用获准合成材料。 车载系统能播声音就说明它在采集吗？ 不能。输出和输入不同，当前系统与App会话仍需核路由；本页不提供自动选麦或占用探针。 有线或USB麦克风一定比蓝牙更适合吗？ 不能给脱离实际设备/系统/环境的保证。核实际输入与格式，本文没有外设性能榜、认证清单或购买要求。 近场voiceChat配置是否证明高噪识别可靠？ 不证明。它是请求系统音频处理的策略，不是噪声级别、型号组合、准确率或续航测试结果。 前检通过后换耳机，还能直接引用原结论吗？ 不能。路由和格式可能变化，开始前条件不证明后续恢复；看实际状态并按对应路径核保存/中断与目标。 相关指南与源码 静止场景流程 · 输入排障 · 音频切换恢复矩阵 · 人工文本修订 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 近场配置与采集路径 、 README设备/模型/服务限制 。

### Before recording in a parked vehicle or exhibition: accessory input checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/vehicle-exhibition-microphone-preflight/

Before recording in a parked vehicle or exhibition: accessory input checks Establish safe authorized capture first, then inspect accessories; noise is not a benchmark For mobile notes, park safely or leave exhibition aisles/hazardous equipment areas and confirm recording permission. Do not operate the phone while driving or needing environmental attention. A Bluetooth/car/wired device name establishes neither the actual input, prepared model nor reliable noisy recognition. Near-field configuration is a source policy; no high-noise test, guaranteed model recommendation or new accessory selector is supplied. Different from earlier guides Stationary preflight covers the overall text workflow; input diagnosis addresses failed capture; the recovery matrix addresses events after recording begins. Here before starting, identify each accessory’s input/output role and whether safety/permission allow capture at all . Do not manufacture failures by repeatedly switching devices. Environment and accessory preflight Context/accessory Confirm before starting Non-sensitive evidence Stop condition/no guarantee Parked location Stationary, not obstructing traffic, applicable rules followed Whether safe stationary conditions exist No phone operation while driving; no hands-free-driving promise Exhibition position Recording permitted, away from bystanders/aisles Authorized synthetic phrase and bounded scope No unauthorized customers, badges or private discussions Phone input Actual system microphone and permission Current visible permission/route state A nearby phone does not prove built-in input is active Bluetooth headset Input/output roles checked separately Model/system version and actual route, not unique IDs Paired does not certify microphone use or compatibility Vehicle Bluetooth Which system/session currently uses the connection Actual route and audio operation Successful car playback is not app capture/lock-screen acceptance Wired/USB/adapter System supplies an input and compatible format Device type/visible state No arbitrary-adapter certification or purchase requirement Speakers/other playback Interference with capture or disclosure risk Stop unnecessary playback you started voiceChat is not zero-echo/noise-performance evidence Model/target Verified available model, authorized non-executing blank draft Actual version and target readiness Accessories do not replace models, services, permission or confirmation One synthetic check only when prerequisites are ready Decide between a local note and a workbench draft before testing. Do not send equipment tests to real orders/customer conversations. Use “Prepare a sample equipment checklist; keep a draft without sending,” then distinguish capture, recognition and destination results. This page runs no test, requests no permission and connects no accessory. Stop with unresolved conditions if the environment/input is unsuitable. Higher volume, approaching other people’s conversations and repeated recording are not default fixes. After a device change or call during capture, use the corresponding recovery matrix rather than treating preflight as proof of complete recording. Record conditions, not invented performance A useful finding is “authorized stationary location, actual input still unconfirmed, capture not started,” not “car Bluetooth supports reliable noisy calls.” Device, firmware, distance, background sound, route and model can affect outcomes. Source settings are not fixed-device/environment evidence. No wind suppression, signal-to-noise ratio, distance, accuracy, battery or lock-screen continuity is promised. Selecting equipment supplies no group channel, real-time dispatch or emergency-delivery guarantee. Safety-related communication needs established validated channels, not this static page. FAQ Does car Bluetooth permit operating Yihu while driving? Not on this guide. Park safely and follow applicable rules. Phone operation or audio isolation must not compromise environmental awareness. Can real exhibition customer conversations be recognition samples? Do not collect real customers, badges or private discussions for public tests. Confirm permission/scope and use authorized synthetic material. Does successful car playback prove microphone capture? No. Output and input differ. Inspect the actual system/app route; this guide provides no automatic microphone selector or occupancy probe. Is wired/USB always better than Bluetooth? No detached-device/environment guarantee is appropriate. Check the actual input/format. There is no performance ranking, certification list or purchase requirement here. Does near-field voiceChat prove reliable high-noise recognition? No. It requests system processing, not a measured noise level, device combination, accuracy or endurance result. Can preflight conclusions survive a later headset change unchanged? Do not assume that. Routes/formats can change. Initial readiness does not establish later recovery; inspect actual retention/interruption and destination state. Reading and source Stationary workflow · Input diagnosis · Recovery source matrix · Manual correction · Start · Privacy Evidence: near-field/capture source , README device/model/service limits .

### 中英混说与术语保留前检：语言提示、常用词顺序和原文核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multilingual-terms-preflight/

中英混说与术语保留前检：语言提示、常用词顺序和原文核对 词表是识别背景提示，不是保证保留原词或自动翻译的字典 一呼现有语言选项为自动、中文、英文，自动选项界面含中英混说说明；常用词作为识别背景上下文使用。语言提示、解析后的词表和最终识别文字仍是不同层级。输入了术语不等于每个词都被模型纳入或正确保留，本页不提供翻译服务、多语言准确率或专名识别保证。 与人工纠错、纪要核对的区别 人工修订处理已经得到的文字；这里在采集前检查 实际语言提示、词表如何解析和哪些原词必须人工回查 。它不重写音频排障，也不把词表内容当作Agent指令、账号身份或审批授权。 多语言术语前检表 检查项 当前源码/界面边界 合成检查例子 不能推断 语言选项 automatic/chinese/english，自动提示不强制固定语言 是否按实际版本选项核对 自动支持所有语言或自动翻译 术语开关 是否识别时参考与保存词表分开 关闭参考不等于删除已存词 有保存就必定参与这次识别 分隔符 换行、英文/中文逗号、顿号和分号等按源码拆项 Sample-A与Sample-B各占一项 逗号属于术语原文时仍被完整保留 空白/重复 去首尾空白、丢空项，大小写去重保留首项顺序 Sample与sample只保留先出现者 有Unicode全面归一化或自动术语合并 数量 最多80个通过解析的术语 超出时不把剩余项算已采用 80项都会完整送进每次模型上下文 长度 单项最多40个Swift Character，过长项丢弃而非截断 长术语先核实际字符数 40字符等于40个UTF-8字节 优先顺序 前面的有效项更优先，实际保留受预算影响 把真正需要的合成词放前面 越长录音仍能带上全部术语 最终文字 仍需核拼写、缩写、数字与否定 保留原词引用，不把建议写成批准 词表可代替原文/真机准确率验收 解析器不以普通空格拆成多个术语，但这不等于模型把整句当成一个不可变词。不要把长提示或操作指令塞进词表来要求执行；它是识别上下文，不是业务命令通道。 合成术语清单的核对 输入示意： Sample-A sample-a 样例代号B，API 人工预期：首个Sample-A保留，后面大小写重复项不另计；样例代号B与API分别成项。 仍未知：具体识别会采用多少上下文，以及输出是否保留拼写。 这个例子不修改App设置，也不执行实际识别。公开例子不用客户姓名、内部产品编码、工作台令牌或真实任务正文。若需要维护团队词汇，应在已有获准范围核对，不为本页新建共享词库或外部授权。 原词与后续简报的边界 语音识别、人工翻译与摘要写作是不同处理。若下游简报把某个英文缩写展开、改成中文或合并别名，应保留修改依据和未知项，不能把编辑决定说成模型原词输出。多人/多端使用同一标签也不证明App会跨设备同步词表。 正式采用前仍需实际版本、兼容模型、权限与安全场景。本文不提供自动术语对齐、跨语言实体消歧或“所有专名必对”的能力，也不通过调整参数绕过模型校验和目标守卫。 FAQ 自动选项能保证任何语言和口音都正确吗？ 不能。当前选项与提示范围不等于任意语言/口音准确率；需实际模型与设备证据，本文未运行识别测试。 超过40字符的术语会被截成前40个吗？ 不是。当前解析直接丢弃不符合长度条件的项，不应把截短后的字串当作源码自动采用结果。 解析出80项是否说明识别时全用上？ 不说明。顺序和识别上下文预算影响采用范围；数量上限不是每次全部纳入保证。 关闭术语参考会删掉词表吗？ 按现有界面说明，两者分开，关闭参考保留词表；实际是否参考需核当前设置与版本，不从存储存在推断启用。 常用词会自动翻译成另一种语言吗？ 本文不提供翻译保证。术语作为识别背景，输出、人工改写和翻译要分别核对并保留来源。 术语包含“发送/执行”是否给Agent授权？ 不会。词表文字不是服务端权限、用户确认或业务命令许可，原交接守卫与回执边界不变。 相关指南与源码 人工文本修订 · 单录音原词核对 · 摘要逐句溯源 · 跨时区时间检查 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 语言选项与术语解析 、 设置界面说明 、 识别上下文前缀 。

### Before mixed-language dictation: language hints, term order and original wording

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multilingual-terms-preflight/

Before mixed-language dictation: language hints, term order and original wording A term list is recognition context, not a guaranteed preserve-or-translate dictionary Existing language choices are automatic, Chinese and English; the automatic label mentions mixed Chinese/English. Terms provide recognition background. A language hint, parsed list and final text are different layers. Entering a term does not prove every item reached the model or was preserved correctly. No translation service, universal multilingual accuracy or proper-name guarantee is supplied. Different from correction and minutes review Correction deals with already recognized text. Here before capture, inspect the actual hint, list parsing and original terms requiring later review . This is not another audio diagnosis. Vocabulary is neither an Agent instruction channel, identity nor approval. Language and vocabulary preflight Check Existing boundary Synthetic inspection Not established Language choice automatic/chinese/english; automatic supplies no fixed language hint Actual version/selection Every language supported or automatic translation Term toggle Referencing terms and retaining them are separate Disabling use does not delete stored terms Stored implies used in this recognition Separators Newlines and listed Latin/Chinese commas, enumeration marks/semicolons split terms Sample-A and Sample-B as separate items A comma inside a name remains unsplit Whitespace/duplicates Trim ends, drop blanks, case-insensitive deduplication, first-item order Sample/sample keeps the first Universal Unicode normalization or entity merging Count Up to 80 accepted terms Overflow is not counted as adopted All 80 always reach recognition context Length Up to 40 Swift Characters per item; overlong items are dropped, not truncated Inspect actual character count 40 characters means 40 UTF-8 bytes Order Earlier valid terms have priority, within context budget Put necessary synthetic terms first Longer audio preserves every term Output Check spelling, abbreviations, quantities and negations Retain original references Vocabulary replaces source/device accuracy checks Ordinary spaces do not split terms in this parser, but that does not make an entire phrase immutable to the recognizer. Do not put long operational prompts into the vocabulary to request execution; it is recognition context, not business authority. One synthetic list Input illustration: Sample-A sample-a 样例代号B，API Editorial expectation: First Sample-A retained; its case duplicate is not another term. The Chinese sample label and API are separate items. Still unknown: How much context reaches recognition and whether spelling survives in output. This neither changes app settings nor runs recognition. Use no customer names, private product codes, service tokens or real tasks publicly. Team vocabulary belongs in existing authorized processes, without provisioning a shared service or third-party authorization here. Original words versus later briefs Recognition, editorial translation and summarization are different processing steps. Expanding an acronym, translating a phrase or merging aliases needs a reason and retained unknowns, not a claim the model produced that wording. Shared labels do not prove cross-device vocabulary synchronization. Actual version, compatible models, permission and a safe environment remain prerequisites. No automatic terminology alignment, cross-language entity resolution or every-name-correct feature is provided, and no parameter bypasses model/target guards. FAQ Does automatic guarantee every language and accent? No. Choices/labels are not arbitrary-language accuracy evidence. Check actual models/devices; this page runs no recognition benchmark. Are over-40-character terms truncated to 40? No. Current parsing drops items failing the length condition. Do not present a shortened string as an automatically adopted result. Does parsing 80 entries mean recognition uses them all? No. Order and context budgets affect the adopted scope. An upper bound is not an all-items guarantee. Does disabling term use delete the list? Existing UI distinguishes the two and retains terms. Check actual setting/version rather than inferring enablement from storage. Does vocabulary automatically translate into another language? No translation guarantee follows. Terms are background; output, editing and translation need separate source review. Does send/execute in vocabulary authorize an Agent? No. Term text is not server permission, user confirmation or operation authority. Handoff/receipt guards remain. Reading and source Manual correction · Original-word passage review · Summary provenance · Timezone/time checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: language choices/term parser , settings explanation , recognition context prefixes .

### 跨时区简报时间怎样核对？来源日期、Unix任务时间与载体时间分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/timezone-timestamp-review/

跨时区简报时间怎样核对？来源日期、Unix任务时间与载体时间分账 先问这个时间描述哪件事，再比较时区、单位与先后 一呼当前Radar把 date_str 按固定 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 、UTC+08:00解析，来源最后成功读取时间不能用手机请求、缓存命中或文件修改时间替换。任务 timestamp 是另外的可选Unix时间字段；Watch的 sourceDate 与 capturedAt 又有各自含义。跨时区核对应先分事件与契约，不把所有“时间”都当同一种数字。 与缓存排障、批次比较的分工 缓存指南定位旧数据和读取失败，批次比较核两份数据是否可比；这里专门检查 不同口径的日期时间如何被错误比较 。本页不实现自动时区转换、时钟修正、预约调度或跨时区同步，也不写回真实来源时间。 时间字段口径表 时间/位置 当前含义或契约 应核对什么 不能替代什么 date_str 来源最后成功读取；固定UTC+08格式 完整字符串、来源与实际读取状态 手机点刷新或导出文件保存时间 任务timestamp 可选Double，Unix任务更新时间 来源提供的单位、缺失/null与排序范围 整份源读取时间、批准/处理时间 手机请求时间 发起读取的本地事件 是否成功拿到新源，而非仅缓存 来源已更新或任务已变更 Watch sourceDate 手机摘要对应来源时间 来源范围、失败与裁剪信息 手表封包或独立刷新时间 Watch capturedAt 摘要封包时间 与sourceDate分别看待 最新业务状态或最新源读取 文件/编辑时间 保存、复制、整理文档的事件 是否只是副本或人工编辑 原业务事件或来源身份 Unix秒与毫秒 不同数值单位，不可混用 按生产者/消费者契约核单位 仅凭位数猜测后自动改值 其他时区呈现 对同一时刻的人工显示 明确偏移、跨日与适用规则 把本地时区直接写回date_str Watch日期是该载体的Date编码契约，不能把随手看到的底层序列化数字直接与任务Unix字段相减。必须先核双方格式/单位；本页不提供通用时间字段识别器。 两个固定历史示例 示例A：2026-10-18 09:00（按当前date_str契约为UTC+08） 同一时刻的UTC显示：2026-10-18 01:00 UTC 示例B：2026-10-18 00:30（UTC+08） 同一时刻的UTC显示：2026-10-17 16:30 UTC，日期跨到前一天 这是明确偏移下的人工示意，不是真实来源或当前新鲜数据。不要因为文中给出UTC显示，就把 Z 、偏移或ISO分隔符直接加回 date_str ；当前严格格式与回读校验不等于任意ISO8601接受器。 检查顺序 先给每个时间标明事件：源读取、任务更新、请求、封包还是文件编辑。再确认来源身份与范围，随后核格式、时区/偏移和单位。如果出现排序矛盾，先看缺失值、优先级与来源顺序规则，不把它自动解释成时钟错误或任务状态改变。 当前源码把超过24小时的来源标旧，超前超过5分钟提示时钟问题；它们是来源时效判断，不是响应时间、刷新频率、服务SLA或业务逾期判定。未知日期应保持未知/失败，不能填“现在”让警告消失。任何修正应回原来源维护流程，不绕过解析或写授权。 FAQ 手机在另一个时区，date_str会改按手机时区解析吗？ 当前模型使用固定UTC+08解析，不应按手机所在地反推。实际显示与来源语义仍须分开核对。 给date_str加Z或+08:00会更标准吗？ 不能因此假定当前消费者接受。它有固定格式与严格回读检查，改源格式属于兼容性变更，需另核目标版本。 13位数字可以自动除1000当Unix秒吗？ 不应靠位数自动修源。先核生产者契约与实际字段，错误单位可能无效或表示完全不同时间；本页不提供自动强转。 刚刷新或刚封包为什么还显示旧来源？ 请求/封包与源成功读取不同，缓存可继续显示旧值；不能把新请求时间冒充来源更新。 24小时和5分钟是刷新SLA吗？ 不是。它们是当前来源旧值/未来时钟判断阈值，不承诺服务按某周期更新或任务必须何时处理。 时间缺失时填当前时间能帮助比较吗？ 会伪造含义，不应这样做。保留未知及缺口，回来源确认；否则会把旧数据或编辑副本误当新事实。 相关指南与源码 JSON类型与空值 · 批次比较 · 跨端呈现 · 改版兼容 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 来源日期解析、时效与排序 、 Watch日期模型 。

### Review brief timestamps across timezones: source, task and carrier clocks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/timezone-timestamp-review/

Review brief timestamps across timezones: source, task and carrier clocks Identify the event before comparing timezone, units and ordering Current Radar parses date_str using fixed yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in UTC+08:00. Last successful source read cannot be replaced with a phone request, cache hit or file modification. Optional task timestamp is a separate Unix-time field; Watch sourceDate and capturedAt also differ. Establish event/contract first instead of treating all times as equivalent numbers. Different from cache diagnosis and batch comparison Cache review locates old data/read failures; batch review establishes comparable exports. Here different time meanings can be compared incorrectly . No automatic timezone converter, clock repair, scheduling or cross-zone sync is added, and no live source time is rewritten. Time meanings and units Time/location Current meaning/contract Check Does not replace date_str Last successful source read, fixed UTC+08 format Exact string, source and successful read state Refresh tap or exported-file save time Task timestamp Optional Double, Unix task-update time Producer units, absence/null and ordering scope Whole-source read, approval or handling time Phone request Local event starting a read New successful source response versus cache Source update or task modification Watch sourceDate Source represented by the phone summary Scope, failures and truncation Watch packaging or independent refresh Watch capturedAt Summary packaging time Inspect separately from sourceDate New business state or successful source read File/editorial time Save/copy/edit event Whether only a copy/document changed Original business event or source identity Unix seconds/milliseconds Different units, not interchangeable Producer/consumer contract Automatic conversion based on digit count Other-zone presentation Another display of one instant Explicit offset, date boundary and applicable rules Writing local-zone text back as date_str Watch dates use that carrier’s Date encoding contract. Do not subtract arbitrary serialized values directly from task Unix fields without verifying format/units. This page supplies no universal timestamp detector. Two fixed historical illustrations A: 2026-10-18 09:00 under date_str's UTC+08 contract Same instant in UTC: 2026-10-18 01:00 UTC B: 2026-10-18 00:30 at UTC+08 Same instant in UTC: 2026-10-17 16:30 UTC, on the preceding date These are explicit-offset illustrations, not real/current source data. A UTC display does not authorize appending Z , offsets or ISO separators to date_str . Its strict round-trip format is not arbitrary ISO8601 acceptance. Review sequence Label the event first: source read, task update, request, packaging or editing. Confirm identity/scope, then format, timezone/offset and unit. If ordering conflicts, inspect absent timestamps, priorities and source-order rules before assuming clock failure or changed task state. Current source marks source age over 24 hours stale and flags time more than five minutes ahead. These are freshness signals, not response latency, refresh frequency, service SLA or a business deadline. Keep unknown/failed times rather than filling now to hide a warning. Corrections belong to the original maintenance process without bypassing parsing/write authority. FAQ Does another phone timezone change date_str parsing? The current model fixes UTC+08 rather than inferring from device location. Keep displayed time and source meaning separate. Is adding Z or +08:00 automatically more compatible? No. The consumer has an exact format/round-trip check. A source-format change needs actual-version compatibility review. Can a 13-digit value automatically be divided by 1000? Do not repair by digit count. Confirm producer contract/field first. Wrong units can be invalid or mean another instant; no automatic coercion is offered. Why is source time old after refresh or packaging? Request/packaging events differ from successful source reads. Cache can retain an old source time; do not substitute now. Are 24 hours and five minutes refresh SLAs? No. They are current stale/future-source thresholds, not promised update schedules or task-handling deadlines. Can missing time be filled with now to help comparison? That fabricates meaning. Keep the gap and confirm at the source instead of presenting old data/edited copies as new facts. Reading and source JSON types/nulls · Batch comparison · Cross-device presentation · Format compatibility · Start · Privacy Evidence: source-date parsing/freshness/sorting , Watch date model .

### 文本、截图与附件怎样核脱敏范围？载体差异和归档矩阵

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/carrier-redaction-archive-matrix/

文本、截图与附件怎样核脱敏范围？载体差异和归档矩阵 先确认载体与处理路径：去元数据不是去画面里的敏感文字 归档或分享前，文本、截图、照片和其他文件须分别核查。一呼明确相机/照片图片暂存路径有有界JPEG处理并不复制源元数据，但这不是自动遮挡像素内容、OCR脱敏、所有附件清洗或归档服务。上一轮最小披露指南决定保留哪些材料；这里进一步判断 所选载体的哪一层仍可能保有敏感信息 。 按载体区分的检查矩阵 载体/层 已核实现或人工边界 仍要核的内容 不应声称 纯文本/转写 原文与人工修订分别处理 名称、账号、编号、正文和上下文组合 App自动识别或遮挡敏感词 JSON/链接文字 Radar按源字段读取，链接筛选仅部分形态 路径、查询、片段和任务/来源标识 HTTPS或JSON有效就已经脱敏 截图像素 截图里的文字/头像/二维码仍属于画面 可见客户内容、账号、令牌或可识别细节 去文件元数据就去掉画面文字 明确图片暂存路径 对选定相机/照片输入作JPEG处理，不复制源GPS等元数据 最终图像像素、方向、实际内容与目的地 所有分享文件走同一处理或输出已匿名 图片文件准入 编码输入最多32 MiB、3200万像素 实际输入类型和拒绝状态 尺寸门槛代表隐私/安全认证 相机位图/输出 相机位图另有128 MiB边界；输出边长最多2048 本轮处理是否成功与最终可见内容 降采样是可靠遮挡、性能或保密保证 其他附件 按实际类型和既有工具规则核对 文档正文、批注、修订、隐藏内容或元数据 图片处理器会清理任意PDF/文档/音频 副本/归档位置 原件、修订件、托盘、工作台和同步账户可能不同 已有权限、必要副本与实际保留规则 删本地文件就撤回远端或备份 这些是源码准入/处理边界，不是所有设备已验收的隐私结果。 CollieDiagnosticImage 只说明其明确输入和输出路径，不能扩展成对整个系统分享收件箱里所有文件的统一保证。 合成材料的三层核查 样例载体：一张写有“样例账号A”的合成截图。 层1：检查文件元数据是否属于已核图片处理路径。 层2：检查输出像素里“样例账号A”是否仍可读；降采样不证明它消失。 层3：检查旧截图、附件和目的地是否已有其他版本，归档范围是否获准。 结论：没有足够证据前，不标为已匿名或已撤回所有副本。 这里不提供图片或真实账号，也不执行相机、OCR或脱敏处理。若需要手工遮挡，应在已有获准工具里处理并再次检查最终输出；不从编辑步骤的存在推断遮挡成功，更不把旧版副本忘记计入范围。 归档前先核路径，再核内容 先问文件来自哪种输入：明确照片/相机暂存、系统分享的其他文件，还是文字附件。再确认处理是否成功，保存后的实际内容是什么。只有经过对应路径的输出才可引用该路径的源码属性，不能用文件后缀相同替代证明。 之后核原件与处理稿的权限、目的地和必要副本。图片暂存不自动上传或发送；后续工作台交接可能先上传附件，未发送消息不代表没有远端副本。已尝试交接仍遵守原守卫，不用脱敏稿换名来规避一次标记或不确定状态。 本文不给统一保留期限、法律认证、不可恢复删除或匿名化保证。未知或不合格材料应停在原获准范围，由已有维护/信息处理流程确认，不为了演示公开私有数据。 FAQ 去GPS和源元数据是否把截图正文一起去掉？ 不会由此成立。像素里的文字、头像、二维码或表格仍可能可读，必须单独核最终画面。 所有分享到一呼的文件都会自动清元数据吗？ 不能这样说。这里引用的是明确图片暂存处理路径，不适用于任意文档、PDF、音频或其他文件输入。 2048边长输出能保证细节无法识别吗？ 不能。尺寸上限是有界处理，不是隐私遮挡或匿名化算法；文字与其他识别细节可能仍存在。 文件小于32 MiB就能称为已安全脱敏吗？ 不能。大小/像素准入与内容、权限、隐私是不同维度，还须核输入类型与实际处理结果。 换成修订附件会自动删除服务上的旧附件吗？ 本文不提供此功能。托盘、上传件、草稿和账户同步副本分别核，按实际服务规则处理，不承诺远端撤回。 人工矩阵全勾选就能宣称合法匿名和归档完成吗？ 不能。检查表不是法律或匿名化认证，仍需实际权限、内容和保留依据，且只能说明真正核过的范围。 相关指南与源码 跟进证据最小化 · 认领与归档规则 · 修订与副本 · 交接证据审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 明确图片输入、限额、编码与暂存 、 README图片与分享边界 。

### Text, screenshots and attachments: carrier-specific redaction/archive checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/carrier-redaction-archive-matrix/

Text, screenshots and attachments: carrier-specific redaction/archive checks Identify carrier and processing path: metadata removal is not pixel-text redaction Review text, screenshots, photos and other files separately before retention/sharing. Yihu’s explicit camera/photo staging path performs bounded JPEG processing without copying source metadata. This is not automatic pixel masking, OCR redaction, universal attachment cleaning or an archive service. Minimization decides what to retain; here which layer in a selected carrier may still disclose information needs review. Carrier-specific scope matrix Carrier/layer Existing implementation/manual boundary Still inspect Do not claim Text/transcript Originals and manual corrections differ Names, accounts, references, body and combinations Automatic sensitive-word detection/masking JSON/link text Source fields retained; link filtering checks shape only Paths, query, fragments and source/item identities Valid JSON/HTTPS establishes redaction Screenshot pixels Visible text/avatars/QR codes remain image content Customer material, accounts, tokens or identifying details Metadata removal deletes visible text Explicit image staging JPEG processing of selected camera/photo input without source GPS/metadata copying Final pixels, orientation, actual content and destination Every shared file uses this path or output is anonymous Encoded-image admission Up to 32 MiB and 32 million pixels Actual input type and refusal state Size limits certify privacy/security Camera bitmap/output Separate 128 MiB bitmap bound; output side up to 2048 Successful processing and final visible content Resizing is reliable masking or confidentiality/performance evidence Other attachments Actual type/tool policy applies Body, comments, revisions, hidden content and metadata The image helper cleans arbitrary PDFs/documents/audio Copies/archive Original, edited file, tray, workbench and sync may differ Existing permission, necessary copies and retention policy Local deletion recalls remote/backed-up copies These are source admission/processing limits, not device-certified privacy outcomes. CollieDiagnosticImage describes its explicit input/output path, not every file in the system share inbox. Three layers in a synthetic review Carrier: A synthetic screenshot displaying sample account A. Layer 1: Is the file in the reviewed image-processing path? Layer 2: Is sample account A still readable in output pixels? Resizing does not prove removal. Layer 3: Are old versions already in attachments/destinations, and is retention authorized? Conclusion: Do not claim anonymity or recall of every copy without evidence. No image, real account, camera, OCR or redaction operation is supplied. If masking is necessary, use an existing authorized tool and inspect the saved result. An editing step is not proof of successful masking, and older copies remain in scope. Path before content, then retention Identify explicit photo/camera staging versus other system-shared files or text attachments. Check success and actual saved content. Only output from the relevant path supports that path’s source properties; an identical filename suffix is insufficient. Then inspect permissions/destination/necessary copies of originals and edits. Staging does not upload/send automatically. Later workbench handoff can upload before sending, so unsent messages do not establish no remote copy. Prior attempts retain guards; a renamed redacted draft cannot bypass one-handoff/uncertainty. No universal retention period, legal certification, irreversible deletion or anonymity guarantee is provided. Keep unknown/unsuitable material within original permissions for the existing information-handling process, not public demos. FAQ Does removing GPS/source metadata remove screenshot text? No. Text, avatars, QR codes and tables can remain readable in pixels. Review the final image separately. Is every file shared to Yihu automatically stripped? No blanket claim follows. The cited path is explicit image staging, not arbitrary document/PDF/audio or other file input. Does a 2048-side output guarantee unidentifiable details? No. It is bounded processing, not a masking/anonymization algorithm. Text and other identifying detail can remain. Does under 32 MiB mean safely redacted? No. Admission size/pixels differ from content, permission and privacy. Check input type and actual result. Does a replacement attachment delete the older remote one? No such feature is supplied. Inspect tray/uploads/drafts/sync separately under actual service rules, without a recall guarantee. Does checking every box certify lawful anonymity or complete archiving? No. This is neither legal nor anonymization certification. Actual permissions, content and retention evidence remain necessary, limited to reviewed scope. Reading and source Evidence minimization · Ownership/archive rules · Corrections/copies · Handoff evidence review · Start · Privacy Evidence: explicit image inputs/limits/encoding/staging , README image/sharing limits .

### 笔记和Radar简报导出前：编码、换行、引号与分隔符核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/export-encoding-delimiter-preflight/

笔记和Radar简报导出前：编码、换行、引号与分隔符核对 先确认导出载体和消费者，不能把所有逗号都当作字段分隔 一呼较长笔记的现有暂存路径写UTF-8 Markdown；共享收件箱也有自己的内部JSON清单，而Radar读另一套快照模型。三者不能因“都是文字文件”而互换。编码、换行、引号转义、字符数和字段契约须分别核对；本文不提供CSV导出、转码器或自动修复真实文件功能。 与术语解析、JSON类型和改版评审的分工 术语前检解释词表按哪些符号拆项，JSON类型检查关注字段形态，改版评审关注契约变化。这里核的是 已经选定载体中的文字怎样序列化与被读取 ，不是改变术语含义、模型设置或来源字段。 编码与分隔检查表 对象 已核实现/语义 应核对的边界 不应推断 笔记短文字 当前按transcript的Swift Character计数决定文字/附件路径 3000门槛不是UTF-8字节或录音时长 汉字、组合字符都按单字节计算 较长笔记附件 现有路径写Markdown，encoding为utf8 文件正文、标题、换行与实际消费者 任意文件都是同编码，或有CSV/通用转码支持 收件箱manifest JSONEncoder编码内部共享批次 内部清单不是Radar快照契约 改名.json就能导入Radar 源Radar JSON 按实际消费者JSONDecoder与模型读取 语法、类型、大小、日期和身份分别核 本文宣称所有输入只接受一种编码或自动纠错 逗号/分号 在JSON字符串内可以只是数据 引号内外语义，不能套词表拆项规则 逗号必然代表新的任务或字段 换行/引号 JSON字符串须遵守转义语法 \n、双引号和反斜线的实际内容 把字面反斜线n和换行混为同一字节序列 Unicode文字 字符、UTF-8字节与语言语义不同 先核实际编码与保留原文 看起来相同就证明字节完全相同 文件名/副本 扩展名、保存时间和正文契约分开 目的地与已有交接状态 换后缀/文件名可以绕过一次交接或权限 一个JSON字符串语法片段 下例只示意字符串， 不是完整Radar快照 ，缺少真实导入所需的其他模型字段，也不是App生成的样例输出。 { "title" : "Sample, A" , "next" : "Line1 \n Line2" } 解析后逗号仍属于title，转义换行属于next内容。若想保留字面上的反斜线和n，序列化方式又不同；不要用简单的“按逗号切开”处理JSON。词表解析会拆某些标点，不意味着导出正文也适用该规则。 合成文本“样例A”由三个简单字符组成，UTF-8为七字节；这个例子说明计数不同，不提供通用字符计数器，更不能把JavaScript字符串长度直接当Swift Character门槛。 导出前后的保留检查 先用不含真实数据的样例确认目标工具按什么类型读取，再核原文与已读回内容，不为修复显示异常重写真实来源。不要在不了解编码/消费者时直接删字节、去掉引号或把错误字段补为当前时间。 字符显示正常只证明可见结果，不证明来源身份、模型校验或送达；文件写出也只是本地/暂存阶段。笔记原有交接标记、目标许可与不确定停止边界不变，修订编码或改文件名不授予重发权。 FAQ 一呼长笔记导出就是CSV吗？ 不是。引用的现有路径写UTF-8 Markdown，并通过已有收件箱暂存；本文不新增CSV导出或字段转换。 收件箱manifest.json可以当Radar任务源吗？ 不能。内部批次清单和Radar快照有不同模型，扩展名相同不等于契约相同。 JSON里的逗号都能按词表规则拆吗？ 不能。引号内可能是数据，JSON有自己的语法；词表分隔规则不属于JSON/CSV通用解析器。 3000字门槛是不是3000个UTF-8字节？ 不是。当前笔记门槛用Swift Character计数，不能与编码字节、Unicode标量或录音时长混用。 中文显示异常时可以随便重编码再交接吗？ 不要盲目修复。先核来源编码、目标契约和原结果，保留原文；改编码不抹去已尝试交接或重复风险。 语法片段能证明实际App导入通过吗？ 不能。这里只核字符串示意，不替代完整模型、实际版本解码、权限和设备验收。 相关指南与源码 术语分隔与长度 · JSON类型/空值 · 格式改版 · 笔记一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 笔记Markdown写出与门槛 、 内部共享清单 、 Radar模型 。

### Before exporting notes or Radar briefs: encoding, line breaks and delimiters

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/export-encoding-delimiter-preflight/

Before exporting notes or Radar briefs: encoding, line breaks and delimiters Identify carrier and consumer first; commas are not universally field separators The existing longer-note staging path writes UTF-8 Markdown. The share inbox also has an internal JSON manifest, while Radar consumes another snapshot model. Being text files does not make them interchangeable. Encoding, newlines, escaping, character counts and field contracts need separate review. No CSV exporter, transcoder or automatic repair of live files is added. Different from terms, types and format revisions Vocabulary preflight concerns term splitting, JSON validation concerns field shapes, and revision review concerns contract changes. Here text serialization/readback within a chosen carrier is the task, not changing term meaning, model settings or source fields. Encoding and delimiter checks Object Existing implementation/meaning Check Do not infer Short note text Transcript Swift Character count selects text/attachment path 3000 is not bytes or audio duration CJK/combined characters each use one byte Longer note attachment Existing path writes Markdown with utf8 encoding Body, heading, newlines and actual consumer Every file has identical encoding or CSV/transcoding support Inbox manifest JSONEncoder writes an internal shared batch Not the Radar snapshot contract Renaming .json makes it Radar-compatible Radar source JSON Actual JSONDecoder and model contract Syntax, types, size, dates and identities separately This guide restricts every decoder input to one encoding or repairs it Comma/semicolon Can be data inside JSON strings Quoted/unquoted semantics, not vocabulary splitting Every comma creates a task/field Newline/quotes JSON strings need valid escaping \n, quotes and backslashes as actual content Literal backslash-n and newline have identical bytes Unicode Characters, UTF-8 bytes and meaning differ Actual encoding and retained original Similar display proves identical bytes Filename/copies Suffix/save time differ from body contract Destination and prior handoff state Rename/extension changes bypass reservation/permission A JSON string syntax fragment This demonstrates strings only: not a complete Radar snapshot , missing other required model fields and not an example app-generated export. { "title" : "Sample, A" , "next" : "Line1 \n Line2" } After parsing, the comma remains title data and the escaped newline belongs to next. Preserving literal backslash/n needs a different serialization. Do not split JSON by commas. Vocabulary punctuation splitting does not define exported-body parsing. The synthetic text 样例A has three simple characters and seven UTF-8 bytes. This illustrates different counts, not a universal counter; JavaScript string length must not substitute for Swift Character limits. Retain evidence before and after export Use non-sensitive fixtures to identify how the destination reads the carrier, then compare original/readback without rewriting real source data to hide display errors. Do not remove bytes/quotes or fill now without knowing the encoding/consumer contract. Correct display does not establish source identity, model validation or delivery. Writing a file is a local/staging step only. Original note reservations, destination permission and uncertain-stop states remain. Re-encoding/renaming does not authorize resending. FAQ Are long-note exports CSV? No. The cited path writes UTF-8 Markdown through existing inbox staging. No CSV exporter or field converter is added. Can manifest.json be used as a Radar source? No. The internal share-batch manifest and Radar snapshot have different models. A shared suffix is not a shared contract. Can every JSON comma use vocabulary splitting rules? No. Inside quotes it can be data. JSON has its own grammar; vocabulary splitting is not a general JSON/CSV parser. Is the 3000 threshold 3000 UTF-8 bytes? No. It counts Swift Characters, not encoded bytes, Unicode scalars or recording duration. Can unreadable CJK simply be re-encoded and handed off again? Do not repair blindly. Verify original encoding, destination contract and prior result. Re-encoding does not erase an attempt or duplicate risk. Does the fragment establish app import acceptance? No. It demonstrates strings, not a complete model, actual-version decoding, permission or device acceptance. Reading and source Term splitting/limits · JSON types/nulls · Format revision · One note handoff · Start · Privacy Evidence: Markdown writing/threshold , internal share manifest , Radar model .

### 外设麦克风可用前：权限、16k单声道采样契约与停止边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/microphone-permission-sample-contract/

外设麦克风可用前：权限、16k单声道采样契约与停止边界 已授权不等于格式可用，内部16k采样也不是任意硬件必定兼容 一呼原生采集入口有自己的麦克风请求与启动时授权检查；识别接口使用有界16 kHz单声道PCM。系统外设实际输入与内部处理契约仍须分开核，转换/启动可能失败。本文不提供降低采样率绕过检查的按钮，不把授权通过、蓝牙配对或模型已下载当作完整采集成功。 与输入排障和录后恢复的分工 输入排障定位已有故障，恢复矩阵解释录音中的事件。本页在准备接入外设时，检查 哪些前提必须同时满足，哪些“降级”不能用来绕过源码条件 。它不请求系统权限，不改音频配置，也不执行录音。 权限与采样契约表 层级 已核契约 核对动作 不可用时不应做什么 原生麦克风授权 请求与start时授权检查分别存在 看实际系统授权与App提示 不绕过拒绝，不把过去授权当永久有效 网页采集 实际网页/系统权限另有边界 区分网页请求和原生录音入口 不把网页能播放或登录当原生授权 外设输入 当前系统路由与输入格式 核实际输入，不只看配对名称 不保证所有耳机/转接器自动兼容 内部音频 识别接口有界16 kHz单声道PCM 核现有管线是否成功准备/转换 不把原始字节任意当成有效PCM 格式变化 短语音比较采样率、通道、commonFormat与交错状态 按实际路径处理不一致 不强制复用不安全的旧转换器 识别设置 当前模型采样/解码设置有固定范围 按实际版本可用选项核对 不捏造8k降级、任意温度或beam调节能力 模型/资源 兼容模型下载校验、存储和权限是不同条件 缺哪层就保留缺口 不因输入有声跳过模型校验 最终文字/交接 partial与final结果、目标守卫各有意义 只按已有最终结果与交接资格处理 不拿未完成partial或格式失败当可送达结果 16 kHz是内部处理契约，不是外设型号认证、音质等级、转写准确率或带宽SLA。系统可能提供不同输入格式，必须由既有实现成功处理；本页不提供通用转换器，也不承诺所有输入都能转入。 合成接入记录 已有：系统麦克风授权状态已核。 未知：当前外设输入格式是否能进入现有采集管线。 模型：按实际版本单独确认，不由权限推断。 决定：未确认格式前不开始业务录音；不改采样率或绕过守卫。 如果实际入口报告权限/格式/启动错误，保留最小非敏感错误类别和版本信息，停止受影响步骤。不要为公开复现录客户谈话、提交设备唯一标识或反复切换系统设置。 不把“降级”变成隐性权限扩张 缺可用外设时，不自动选择另一个输入并开始录音；缺模型时，不自行改走未批准云识别；网页失败时，不把原生文字传给新服务。是否使用另一目标或方法必须沿已有用户选择和授权流程，不能由“为了兼容”推定许可。 若已经有录音或交接尝试，仍保留对应状态与一次标记；权限恢复或换设备不证明原结果未发生。按录后恢复和不确定停止边界处理，不自动重录重发。 FAQ 系统显示已授权是否足够开始任意外设录音？ 不够。路由、格式、管线、模型和安全环境仍需核，授权本身不证明有可用音频或识别结果。 网页可以用麦克风，原生就自动继承吗？ 不能这样推断。网页、系统与原生入口各有检查，播放/登录/网页许可不能代替原生授权与目标守卫。 能调成8k来绕过16k管线失败吗？ 本文不声明这样的用户开关。应遵循实际实现的固定采样/转换契约，不用降低参数名义绕过不一致检查。 硬件不是16k就一定不能用或一定能自动转换吗？ 两种绝对说法都不成立。需要既有管线在实际版本成功处理，不能只看一个数值下结论；本页无全格式矩阵。 看到partial文字就能当最终交付吗？ 不能。接口中的partial是可替换的中间文字，只有返回的最终结果进入原有可交付边界，仍需目标与许可检查。 本地失败是否默认允许用云端转写或另一个麦克风？ 不默认允许。替代输入、服务或目标可能改变数据与权限范围，需独立获准；本页不新增自动回退。 相关指南与源码 输入排障 · 录后恢复矩阵 · 降级许可 · 外设开始前检查 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 权限与格式检查 、 采集/识别接口与partial边界 、 当前设置说明 。

### Before using an external mic: permission, 16 kHz mono contract and stop rules

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/microphone-permission-sample-contract/

Before using an external mic: permission, 16 kHz mono contract and stop rules Permission is not format readiness, and internal 16 kHz is not hardware certification Native capture has its own microphone request and authorization check at start. The recognition interface uses bounded 16 kHz mono PCM. Actual system input and the internal contract remain distinct; conversion/start can fail. No user downgrade-sampling switch is provided here, and permission, pairing or downloaded models do not establish complete capture success. Different from input diagnosis and in-progress recovery Diagnosis locates a failure; recovery describes events during recording. Here before adopting an accessory, identify prerequisites and reject unsafe compatibility shortcuts . This page requests no permission, changes no audio configuration and records nothing. Permission and sample-contract checks Layer Existing contract Check Do not bypass failure by Native permission Separate request and start-time authorization check Actual system state/app messages Ignoring refusal or treating prior consent as permanent Page capture Separate site/system conditions Distinguish web capture from native entry point Treating playback/login as native authorization Accessory input Actual route/input format Inspect input, not just paired name Assuming every headset/adapter works Internal audio Bounded 16 kHz mono PCM recognition input Existing pipeline successfully prepared/converted Treating arbitrary raw bytes as valid PCM Changed format Short speech compares rate, channels, commonFormat and interleaving Follow actual-path mismatch handling Forcing an unsafe converter to remain in use Recognition settings Actual model sampling/decoder option scope Real version’s available settings Invented 8 kHz fallback or arbitrary temperature/beam control Model/resources Verified compatible model, storage and permission differ Preserve the missing prerequisite Audio exists, therefore model verification can be skipped Final text/handoff Partial/final results and destination guards differ Existing final-result/eligibility boundaries Delivering unfinished partials or format failures 16 kHz is an internal contract, not device certification, sound-quality ranking, accuracy or bandwidth SLA. The system can supply a different input format which the implementation must successfully handle. No universal converter/all-input guarantee is offered. A synthetic readiness record Known: Actual system microphone permission checked. Unknown: Can this accessory format enter the existing capture pipeline? Model: Confirm separately for the actual app version. Decision: No business recording until format readiness is known; no sample-rate/guard bypass. On permission/format/start errors, keep a minimal non-sensitive category and version, then stop the affected step. Do not publicly reproduce with customer conversations, unique device IDs or repeated system-setting changes. Compatibility is not implicit authority expansion Missing accessory readiness does not authorize starting capture on another input. Missing local models does not authorize an unapproved cloud recognizer. Web failure does not authorize sharing text with a new service. Alternative input/service/destination choices require the existing user-choice/authorization process, not an inferred compatibility exception. Prior capture/handoff attempts keep their state and one-handoff markers. Restored permission or another device does not prove the earlier action did not occur. Preserve in-progress recovery/uncertain-stop boundaries without automatic rerecording/resending. FAQ Is system permission enough for any accessory recording? No. Route, format, pipeline, model and safe environment remain separate. Authorization does not establish audio or recognized text. Does a page's microphone access transfer to native capture? Do not infer that. Page/system/native entry points have checks; playback/login/page permission does not replace native authorization or target guards. Can I choose 8 kHz to bypass a 16 kHz pipeline failure? No such user switch is asserted. Follow actual fixed sampling/conversion contracts instead of bypassing mismatches as a downgrade. Does non-16-kHz hardware always fail or always convert? Neither absolute statement follows. Actual-version pipeline handling must succeed. One number is not a full format matrix. Can visible partial text be delivered as final? No. Interface partials are replaceable intermediate strings. Only the returned final enters original delivery boundaries, still subject to target/permission checks. Does local failure authorize cloud ASR or another microphone? Not by default. Alternatives can change data/permission scope and need separate authorization. This page adds no automatic fallback. Reading and source Input diagnosis · Recovery matrix · Fallback permission · Accessory preflight · Start · Privacy Evidence: permission/format checks , capture/recognition/partial interface , current settings explanation .

### 跨批次改版材料怎样归档？原始引用、消费者版本与评审链核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/batch-change-record-retention/

跨批次改版材料怎样归档？原始引用、消费者版本与评审链核对 归档的是可复核的对应关系，不用新写的摘要冒充原始批次 完成两批数据比较或格式评审后，团队仍需知道结论针对哪两份原材料、哪个消费者版本和什么确认范围。本文只指导在已有获准工具中人工记录这些关系，不声称一呼有完整快照版本库、迁移记录或不可篡改审计链。现有缓存与回复历史各有边界，不能被改称所有批次的永久档案。 与比较、审计和保留规则的分工 批次比较决定两份是否可比、字段怎么变；格式评审核兼容；交接审计核完成主张；这里专门核 已形成结论与被归档前后材料、消费者和确认依据是否对应 。它不重做业务判断、不创建新批准，也不为团队编造保留期限。 变更材料归档链表 人工记录项 需要对应的已有材料 缺失/混淆风险 处理边界 raw_batch_before 获准的旧批次原引用及范围 用事后摘要冒充原输入 原材料不可得就标缺口，不重建假原件 raw_batch_after 获准的新批次原引用及范围 文件名覆盖、来源或权限变化 先核同源/范围，不靠名称关联 producer_revision 若实际流程提供的生产者版本 写v2就推定存在协商协议 仅记录已知版本，未知不补造 consumer_revision 真正评审的App/模型版本依据 用未来或其他版本结果代替 绑定当前已核版本和范围 comparison_rule 集合、字段、时间和类型比较口径 混全任务/子集或秒/毫秒 规则写清；不要称为所有场景兼容 review_scope 哪些字段/内容已核及未核 只核几项却标全量通过 只保留实际范围与未知 decision_reference 原确认/批准与允许动作 归档说明被当作批准本身 文字说明不授予写权或执行许可 archive_access 既有位置、可读角色与保留规则 公开私有材料或留多余副本 按已有权限最小化，不自行建服务 上面的字段都是人工编辑标签，不是Radar导入格式或App归档API。若已有工具生成文件摘要，摘要值只能用于对应字节的完整性核对；它不能独自证明来源可信、内容真实或评审获批。本页没有内置计算/签署功能。 一份合成的变更材料记录 旧引用：样例批次A，原材料范围未核。 新引用：样例批次B，原材料范围未核。 消费者：仅能确认是待评审版本，不能引用其他版本结果。 评审结论：材料不足，不能给出兼容/增删结论。 归档说明：保留缺口及原引用线索，不制造补写原件、不执行迁移。 样例不含真实任务、账号或私有地址，不是运行后的迁移日志。缺旧批次时，不能用当前批次复制改日期来补齐“历史”；那会破坏结论与输入的关系。复制或整理日期同样不替代 date_str 的源读取含义。 复核前后材料与决定 先核访问权限，再读取最少必要原材料；检查评审规则是否仍对应相同集合与消费者。若中途改过字段或版本，应保留事实变化与重新评审范围，不能让后来文件覆盖早先证据却仍引用旧结论。 批准只支持其明确范围，归档包齐全也不触发自动回写、合并或发布。若结论涉及一次真实交接，继续沿原请求/回执检查；新材料版本不抹去旧操作的不确定性。文档、源数据和副本的保留/删除按实际授权流程处理，本页不提供恢复保证或法律认证。 FAQ 一呼会自动保存全部批次和版本变更历史吗？ 本页不声明这种能力。现有缓存/回复历史不是全量快照版本库，人工归档关系由已有获准工具维护。 旧文件丢失能复制新文件改日期当旧批次吗？ 不应这样做。应标明缺口，不能制造原始证据或用编辑时间替代来源读取时间。 两份文件hash一致就能证明都可信且已批准吗？ 不能。相同摘要至多支持相应字节身份，可信来源、业务真实性、审批与权限另需依据。 换了App版本可以直接沿用旧兼容结论吗？ 不能无条件沿用。核目标消费者与原评审范围，发生变化时由已有流程决定需要哪些重新验证。 材料都归档了就可以执行所有变更吗？ 不可以。归档、评审通过与具体操作批准不同；写权限、手机确认与回执等原门不因资料齐全而取消。 本表能规定统一保留或保证可恢复吗？ 不能。按实际团队规则、目的地与权限核保留/删除，本文不新增备份、恢复或合规服务。 相关指南与依据 两批数据比较 · 格式兼容评审 · 交接完成审计 · 跨时区时间 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 来源缓存边界 、 README回复历史与授权 。人工字段与归档关系是本文建议，不冒充原生功能。

</tr>

</tr>

### Retain batch-change review evidence: originals, consumer version and decision scope

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/batch-change-record-retention/

Retain batch-change review evidence: originals, consumer version and decision scope Retain a reviewable relationship, not a new summary pretending to be an original batch After comparing exports or formats, a team still needs to identify the original materials, consumer version and confirmed scope behind its conclusion. Record these relationships in existing authorized tools. Yihu supplies no complete snapshot version store, migration ledger or immutable audit chain here. Existing cache/reply history has its own limits, not permanent archives of every batch. Different from comparison, claim review and retention policy Batch review checks comparability/values; format review checks compatibility; handoff review checks completion claims. Here an existing conclusion must match its archived before/after material, consumer and confirmation evidence . It does not redo the business decision, create approval or prescribe retention periods. Change-material retention mapping Editorial record Existing material referenced Missing/confused risk Boundary raw_batch_before Authorized original older batch/scope Retrospective summary presented as input Mark unavailable, not recreate a false original raw_batch_after Authorized newer batch/scope Overwritten filename or changed source/permission Verify scope/identity, not matching names alone producer_revision Version actually supplied by the workflow v2 text assumed to negotiate a protocol Record known facts; unknown stays unknown consumer_revision App/model version actually reviewed Future/other consumer results substituted Bind to reviewed version/scope comparison_rule Collection, fields, time and type rules Ledger/subset or seconds/milliseconds mixed State rules, not universal compatibility review_scope Reviewed/unreviewed fields and content Few checks labeled full acceptance Retain actual scope and gaps decision_reference Original confirmation/approved action Archive prose treated as approval itself Notes grant no writes or execution archive_access Existing location, readers and retention policy Private disclosure or unnecessary copies Existing minimum permissions, no new service provisioning These are editorial labels, not Radar imports or an app archive API. If an existing tool supplies a digest, it supports byte-integrity checks only. It does not independently establish trusted origin, truth or approval. No hashing/signing feature is implemented here. A synthetic change-material record Before: Sample batch A, original scope unreviewed. After: Sample batch B, original scope unreviewed. Consumer: Intended review version only; no substitution of another version's results. Conclusion: Insufficient material for compatibility/add/remove claims. Retention note: Preserve gaps/references; fabricate no original and perform no migration. This is neither real data/credentials/private URLs nor an executed migration log. Do not copy a current batch and change its date to reconstruct missing history. That breaks the conclusion-input relationship. Copy/edit time does not replace source-read date_str either. Review materials against decisions Check access first, then inspect minimal originals and whether rules still concern the same collection/consumer. If fields/versions changed during review, preserve the change and revised scope; do not overwrite evidence while continuing to cite an earlier conclusion. Approval supports its explicit scope, not automatic writeback, merging or deployment when a package is complete. Real handoffs retain original request/receipt checks; a new material revision does not erase uncertain prior operations. Actual policies govern documents/data/copies, without recovery guarantees or legal certification here. FAQ Does Yihu retain every batch/version change automatically? No such feature is asserted. Existing cache/history is not a full snapshot store. Authorized tools maintain the suggested manual relationships. Can a missing old file be recreated by changing the new file's date? Do not fabricate originals that way. Mark the gap; editing time cannot replace source reading or recreate evidence. Do matching hashes prove trusted and approved contents? No. They support corresponding byte identity at most. Origin, business truth, approval and permission need separate evidence. Can a new app version reuse an old compatibility conclusion? Not unconditionally. Compare the intended consumer and scope; use the existing process to decide necessary revalidation. Does archiving all material authorize every change? No. Retention, review and operation approval differ. Write permission, phone confirmation and receipts remain. Does this prescribe one retention period or guaranteed recovery? No. Actual team/destination policies and permissions govern retention/deletion. No backup, restore or compliance service is added. Reading and evidence Batch comparison · Format compatibility · Handoff claims · Timezone checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: source/cache scope , README reply history/authority . Editorial fields/relationships are suggestions, not native features.

### 空字段与默认显示怎样核？别把“待补”占位写回笔记或Radar源

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/empty-field-display-defaults/

空字段与默认显示怎样核？别把“待补”占位写回笔记或Radar源 “待补”可能只是界面说明，不是来源已经提供的业务值 一呼的任务卡片会在部分字段为空时显示“任务状态未提供”“优先级待补”“下一步待补”等提示。这些显示分支不表示源码把原字段改成默认业务状态、优先级或下一步。校验时先区分原值与渲染结果，不能为了让界面完整而把未知回填成已确认事实；本文不提供默认值修复器或自动补全源数据。 与JSON类型校验的区别 JSON指南核缺失、null和类型；这里进一步核 通过读取后的占位、兜底排序与权限条件有没有被误当源内容 。它不重讲完整数据契约，不自动修改字段，也不把空字符串一律等同所有空白字符。 空字段、占位与默认处理表 位置 当前消费者行为/边界 人工核查 不能回填/推断 必填身份/标题 decode另核非空project/title等条件 原字段是否存在、类型与非空条件 自动“未命名任务”就可替代有效源 status显示 任务卡片空白状态可显示未提供 显示说明与源status分开 未提供等于待办、完成或已批准 priority显示 nil/空串可显示优先级待补 真正源值与显示标签 把待补写成P2或自动默认优先级 next显示 任务卡片可对去首尾空白后的空串显示待补 原文、具体控件与已知缺口 自动生成执行动作或负责人 session/evidence等 部分缺项显示待补/未提供 源中是否真的有同样字样 占位证明负责会话/证据已存在 排序兜底 未知优先级有比较规则 排序结果不是源字段赋值 排在后面就代表来源设了低优先级 reply_supported 明确true才满足该能力条件 未知和显式false语义分开 按钮不可用就把原值统一写false 空笔记原文 handOff入口拒绝空transcript 原文与界面提示分开 用提示文字冒充转写或自动消除缺口 不同控件是否去首尾空白按各处实现判断，并不统一；不要从一个卡片分支推广成所有字段的清洗规则。界面显示相近也不证明来源层相同。 占位与真实字符串的合成例子 材料A：evidence为null，卡片用“待补”说明缺口。 材料B：evidence为字面字符串“待补”，来源真的写了这个文本。 核查：两者都不足以证明业务证据已提供，但来源值不同。 处理：保留区别，不把占位截图当原始字段，不自动改写真实数据。 这个例子不是完整Radar快照，也不调用实际解码。若要确认字段，应在已有权限范围核原材料；本页不新增原始数据查看器或让私有来源公开。 不用默认值扩大结论 人工整理时可以把“未知”作为说明，但须标明这是编辑标签，不是源字段已更新。来源身份、必填校验与回复能力失败时，不通过填当前时间、空数组或常见优先级来绕过实际条件。 “暂无文字”不等于会议没有发生，“没有匹配任务”不等于任务全部完成，“待补”也不等于后台会自动补齐。只记录实际材料与未知，不因占位或排序产生新业务判断、动作授权或重发资格。 FAQ 界面显示优先级待补，源里就保存了“待补”吗？ 不一定。可能只是显示分支，需要核原字段；不能把截图标签当源数据值。 缺标题可以补个未命名让快照通过吗？ 不应擅自造值。当前消费者有非空身份/标题等要求，应回真实来源维护流程，不用默认名冒充有效原件。 空串、空白字符和缺失在所有位置都相同吗？ 不是。具体解析/控件的条件可能不同，本页不提供统一清洗或把所有空白自动归一的保证。 按钮不可用是否证明reply_supported显式为false？ 不能。未知能力、其他权限/来源条件也会影响可用性。原值和界面结论应分账，不自动回写false。 按默认顺序排后面就能填低优先级吗？ 不能。兜底比较规则不是修改来源优先级，更不是业务紧急程度结论。 空笔记能把“暂无文字”当转写交接吗？ 不应这样做。提示不是原文，既有入口与一次交接守卫不因填占位而取消；真实内容缺口须保留。 相关指南与源码 JSON类型与空值 · 摘要句子溯源 · 跨端显示范围 · 笔记一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 任务卡片占位 、 解码与排序 、 笔记空原文守卫 。
