### Empty fields and display defaults: placeholders must not become source values

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/empty-field-display-defaults/

Empty fields and display defaults: placeholders must not become source values A missing-value label may be UI explanation, not supplied business data Some task-card branches display status not provided, priority pending or next step pending when fields are empty. These branches do not mean source fields were assigned a default business state, priority or action. Separate raw values from rendering. Do not fill unknowns with confirmed facts to complete a screen. No default-value fixer or source autocompletion is added. Different from JSON type validation JSON guidance checks missing/null/types. Here rendering, fallback ordering and capability conditions can be mistaken for source contents . This is not another full schema guide, field editor or blanket equivalence between empty strings and all whitespace. Empty values, placeholders and fallbacks Location Existing consumer behavior/boundary Review Do not fill/infer Required identity/title Decode checks nonempty project/title and other conditions Presence, type and nonempty rules Untitled automatically replaces valid source data status rendering Blank task-card state can display not provided Label versus raw status Missing means planned, done or approved priority rendering nil/empty can display pending priority Actual value versus label Replace with P2/default business priority next rendering Task card can show pending after trimming empty text Original, specific control and known gap Invent action or owner session/evidence Some missing values display pending/not provided Whether the source supplied those words literally Label establishes an owner session or evidence Sort fallback Unknown priorities have ordering rules Order is not a field assignment Low position means source assigned low urgency reply_supported Explicit true required for this capability condition Unknown differs from explicit false Disabled UI means rewrite all missing values as false Empty note transcript handOff rejects an empty transcript Original versus UI message Pass a placeholder as transcription or silently remove gaps Trimming depends on each implementation/control; it is not uniform. Do not generalize one card’s condition into universal cleansing. Similar displays do not establish identical raw values. Synthetic placeholder versus literal text A: evidence is null; the card displays a pending label. B: evidence is literally the pending-label string supplied by the source. Review: Neither establishes actual business evidence, but source values differ. Decision: Preserve the distinction; a placeholder screenshot is not the original field. Rewrite no live data. This is not a complete snapshot or actual decoder run. Inspect originals only with existing authorization; no raw-data viewer or public private-source access is added. Defaults must not expand conclusions An editor can label unknowns but must not claim source updates. Identity/required-field/capability failures cannot be bypassed by filling now, empty arrays or familiar priorities. No text does not prove no meeting occurred. No matching tasks does not prove all tasks completed. A pending label does not promise automatic completion. Retain actual facts/unknowns without deriving business status, authority or resend eligibility from placeholders/order. FAQ Does priority pending mean the source saved that string? Not necessarily. Inspect the original field rather than treating screenshot labels as raw values. Can an untitled default make a missing title valid? Do not fabricate values. The consumer has nonempty identity/title conditions; use the real source-maintenance process. Are empty, whitespace and missing identical everywhere? No. Parser/control conditions differ. No universal normalization or cleansing guarantee is supplied. Does disabled UI prove reply_supported is explicitly false? No. Unknown capability and other permission/source conditions affect availability. Preserve raw value versus UI outcome without writing false. Can fallback ordering justify filling low priority? No. Ordering does not modify source priority or establish business urgency. Can no-text placeholder text be handed off as transcription? Do not do so. Messages are not originals; entry/one-handoff guards remain. Preserve the actual content gap. Reading and source JSON types/nulls · Summary provenance · Cross-device display · One note handoff · Start · Privacy Evidence: task-card placeholders , decode/sorting , empty-transcript guard .

### 后台切回前台后先核什么？短语音请求失效、转写恢复与目标重检

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/foreground-audio-rebind-preflight/

后台切回前台后先核什么？短语音请求失效、转写恢复与目标重检 回到前台是状态事件，不是录音、音频重绑或交接成功回执 一呼当前前台回调会进入短语音准备检查，并恢复既有笔记转写；离开活动状态会走相应取消/暂停逻辑。权限弹窗造成的 inactive 与真正 background 不能混为一谈。本页的“重绑前检”是人工重新核状态、路由和目标，不是App承诺所有音频会话自动无缝续上。 与录后音频恢复和格式前检的分工 音频恢复矩阵核路由/引擎通知，权限采样指南核授权和输入格式；这里核 生命周期切换后旧请求是否仍有效、回来后哪些工作可能继续 。它不要求改系统设置、不执行录音，也不新增后台常驻推理或强制重绑开关。 前台返回检查表 事件/状态 当前实现边界 返回前台时核什么 不可推断 准备中权限弹窗 非background且正在请求权限的preparing有特例 仍有效的请求、实际许可与当前相位 每次inactive都已取消，或每次回来都全新录音 真正background 短语音会使可取消请求失效，包括迟到许可结果 旧请求不能被当作新授权会话 迟到granted自动恢复被取消那次录音 普通离开活动状态 短语音走原取消路径，受可取消状态约束 已取消、已完成、仍有待核内容分别看 取消能撤回此前已写入或服务端动作 applicationDidBecomeActive 检查准备状态并可预热模型 UI实际阶段与是否存在有效准备请求 回调本身证明已采集或已识别 笔记转写暂停/恢复 shell离开活动态暂停转写，活动态恢复 待处理文字、错误与实际笔记状态 模型后台持续推理，或所有录音不中断 输入/音频管线 系统路由可能与离开前不同 按权限/格式与恢复指南核现状 所有外设会话已自动无缝重绑 页面/草稿目标 仍有现有插入和目标守卫 当前工作台、页面、草稿与许可 回到同一外观就自动恢复Agent记忆或可重发 既有交接结果 保留一次标记与不确定停止边界 目标内容、已尝试状态和回执 切前台清空旧副作用或允许盲重试 短语音请求在取消路径通过更新会话标识、清理待处理任务等失效；不等于抹除已发生的结果。长笔记的转写恢复与实时音频采集不是同一状态机，不能把一个回调推广成所有录音路径的锁屏连续性保证。 返回后的合成核查 离开前：短语音正在等待权限，尚无最终结果。 中间：实际进入background，旧请求失效。 回来后：即使系统显示granted，也先核当前状态，不把迟到许可接到旧请求。 下一步：沿现有入口作明确用户选择；核目标与旧内容，不自动重录或重发。 这不是实际系统弹窗或设备回归结果。另一个只产生inactive的权限弹窗分支可能保留准备请求；必须识别事件，不能凭“画面回来”判断到底走过哪条路径。 不以重绑名义跳过已有条件 当前路由、格式、模型和目标仍按既有条件核。不为了让旧录音看似继续而任意复用转换器、忽略错误或改走云服务；也不通过替换草稿/文件名消除一次标记。 若界面与内容不确定，停在原范围核现有证据。本页未做锁屏、来电、外设或系统版本矩阵测试，不给零丢失、无延迟或后台续录保证。 FAQ inactive一定等于真正进入后台吗？ 不是。权限弹窗等可能使场景inactive，准备中请求许可存在特例；应按实际事件和相位区分。 后台后迟到的granted会复活旧请求吗？ 当前短语音逻辑使真正后台的可取消请求失效，不能把迟到许可当作恢复旧次录音的依据。 resumeTranscription是否等于麦克风继续采集？ 不是。笔记转写、音频采集与目标交接是不同状态，本页不把方法名当所有路径连续录音保证。 回调进入active是否证明模型已经识别成功？ 不证明。准备检查/预热与实际最终文字不同，要核真实状态与错误，不从回调推断结果。 这里有强制无缝重绑或锁屏续录开关吗？ 没有新增。本文只是重新核状态与绑定条件，不承诺所有外设和系统版本无缝恢复。 切前台能清空旧交接，让我放心重试吗？ 不能。旧尝试和可能副作用仍需核对，一次标记与不确定停止规则不因生命周期变化取消。 相关指南与源码 录后恢复矩阵 · 权限与采样契约 · 追问目标与上下文 · 交接完成审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 短语音生命周期与取消 、 shell前后台转写分支 、 原目标守卫 。

### Returning to foreground: request invalidation, transcription resume and target review

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/foreground-audio-rebind-preflight/

Returning to foreground: request invalidation, transcription resume and target review Foreground is a state event, not capture, audio-rebind or delivery confirmation The current foreground callback enters short-speech readiness checks and resumes existing note transcription. Leaving the active state follows cancellation/pause logic. A permission dialog’s inactive differs from true background . Rebind preflight here means manual state/route/target review, not a promise that every audio session seamlessly resumes. Different from audio recovery and format preflight Recovery concerns route/engine notifications; permission/sample review concerns authorization and format. Here after lifecycle changes, which request remains valid and which work can continue is the task. No setting change, recording, background inference daemon or forced-rebind switch is supplied. Foreground-return checks Event/state Current implementation boundary Review on return Does not establish Preparing permission dialog Exception when not background, preparing and requesting permission Valid request, actual consent and phase Every inactive cancels, or every return is a new recording True background Invalidates cancellable short-speech requests, including late permission responses Old request is not a newly authorized session Late granted revives the canceled capture Other inactive transition Original short-speech cancellation, subject to cancellable state Canceled, complete and unresolved content separately Cancellation recalls prior insertion/server effects applicationDidBecomeActive Readiness check and possible idle model warm-up Actual UI phase and valid pending preparation Callback establishes capture/recognition success Note transcription pause/resume Shell pauses outside active, resumes when active Pending text, errors and actual note state Background model inference or uninterrupted audio everywhere Audio input/pipeline System route may have changed Current permission/format/recovery conditions Every accessory session seamlessly rebound Page/draft target Existing insertion/target guards remain Workbench, page, draft and authority Same-looking view restores Agent memory or resend eligibility Existing handoff One-handoff and uncertain-stop boundaries remain Target content, attempted state and receipts Foreground clears prior effects or permits blind retry Cancellation invalidates short-speech work through session identity/task cleanup; it does not erase effects already committed. Note transcription and live capture are different state machines. One callback cannot establish lock-screen continuity for all paths. Synthetic return review Before: Short speech awaiting permission, no final result. Transition: True background invalidates the old request. Return: Even with system granted, inspect current state; do not attach late consent to old work. Next: Explicit choice through the existing entry point; check target/prior content, no automatic rerecord/resend. This is not a real permission dialog or device regression result. A dialog causing inactive only can preserve pending preparation. Identify the event rather than assuming a returned screen reveals the path. Rebinding cannot bypass conditions Current route, format, model and destination retain existing checks. Do not force old converters, ignore failures or adopt a cloud service to make old recording appear continuous. Renaming/replacing drafts does not erase reservations. When state/content is uncertain, stop within original scope and inspect evidence. No lock-screen/call/accessory/OS matrix was tested, and no zero-loss, latency or background-continuity guarantee is supplied. FAQ Does inactive always mean true background? No. Permission dialogs can cause inactive; preparing permission requests have an exception. Identify actual event and phase. Can late granted after background revive an old request? Current short-speech logic invalidates cancellable work on true background. Late permission is not evidence the canceled capture resumes. Does resumeTranscription mean microphone capture continues? No. Transcription, audio capture and handoff differ. A method name does not guarantee continuous recording across every path. Does active prove model recognition completed? No. Readiness/warm-up is not returned final text. Inspect actual state and errors rather than inferring results from callbacks. Is there a forced seamless-rebind or lock-screen recording switch? None is added. This is state/binding preflight, not universal device/OS recovery evidence. Does foreground clear handoff history so retry is safe? No. Prior attempts/effects still need review. Lifecycle transitions do not cancel one-handoff/uncertainty rules. ### 多角色审批与签收交接清单：内容通过、手机确认和接收反馈不能代签

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multi-role-approval-receipt-checklist/

多角色审批与签收交接清单：内容通过、手机确认和接收反馈不能代签 多人参与不等于权限可以串联：每个确认只证明自己的明确范围 语音笔记或Radar简报可能经过录文人、审核人、操作人和接收方，但一个角色“看过/同意”不能替代另一个角色的权限、手机确认或接收反馈。一呼是工作台壳与来源呈现，不是多角色审批/电子签名引擎。本页提供人工清单，不自动建立组织角色、委托关系或服务端权限。 与认领、完成审计的区别 认领指南核谁负责材料，交接审计核动作是否有完成证据；这里核 不同角色的确认是否被越权代用、确认的内容版本与动作范围是否一致 。它不把责任表变成执行授权，也不靠转述制造签收。 多角色确认边界表 人工角色/确认 只能说明的范围 仍须独立核对 不能替代 录文核对人 某版原词/修订范围已核 原文、未知和是否遗漏 内容审批、接收方同意或实际发送 内容审核人 明确版本与字段符合其审核范围 是否包含附件、目标和条件 服务端写权限或手机端操作确认 审批决定人 已有流程下允许的具体动作 身份依据、有效范围和变更后是否仍适用 任意后续动作、自动委托或代签 笔记交接操作人 既有预览/暂存/交接入口的实际选择 原文和一次标记、目标与结果 收件方读完或业务处理完成 Radar回复手机确认人 原生回复流程中当前目标与确认 源新鲜度、能力、eligible/epoch等原守卫 来源审批流、他人权限或服务端完成 接收方反馈 真实反馈所明确说明的内容 原请求/回复与引用关系 无引用的转述、自动已读或全部处理 归档维护人 既有权限下保存哪些材料 最小化、可读范围与保留规则 批准原动作或追认未授权操作 尚未确认的角色 未知仍未知 在原获准渠道取得明确依据 因其他人通过而自动勾选全部 这些是编辑角色，不是App中的组织权限设置。笔记暂存和Radar原生回复是不同入口，不能把其中一种确认机制推广成所有路径都一样，也不能据此声明有密码学签名或法定签收。 合成确认记录 内容版本：样例稿A，含一份合成附件说明。 内容审核：角色A只核正文；附件和目标未核。 操作许可：未知；不由“正文通过”推定。 接收确认：未知；不由“已暂存”推定。 下一步：保留各自缺口，不代他人勾选，不发送或补造回执。 人工可记录 approval_reference、content_scope、actor_role、recipient_confirmation 和 remaining_unknowns，但它们只是清单标签，不是导入JSON、授权参数或原生审批API。公开样例不用真实姓名、联系方式、私有任务或服务令牌。 看清反馈关联，不制造已读/已处理 当前来源回复历史只按明确引用关联后续update与先前reply，不能从“有一条历史”“有人提到任务”推断某个人已读、同意或处理完毕。即使关联存在，也要看反馈实际内容与范围，不把它当通用签收证书。 版本或目的地变更可能超出原确认范围，应回已有流程核，而不是复制旧“同意”给新材料。一次交接标记、目标守卫与不确定停止继续有效；多一个角色签字样文字不消除旧副作用或开新服务权限。 FAQ 一呼内置多级审批与组织角色分配吗？ 本文不声明这类功能。角色和清单是人工建议，不创建审批流、账户权限或委托关系。 内容审核通过是否默认允许实际发送？ 不默认。版本、附件、目的地、具体操作许可和原有守卫仍需核，内容通过不代替执行授权。 另一角色说“替我签了”就能代手机确认吗？ 不能据转述绕过原确认/身份/能力检查。是否有合法委托须由已有流程提供依据，本页不建立代签能力。 历史里出现反馈就代表接收方已读并处理吗？ 不能。先核明确引用与实际内容，来源关联也不是自动已读、处理或所有角色签收证明。 改正文或附件后能沿用旧审批吗？ 只能按原明确范围判断，不自动沿用；变更超出范围时回原流程核，不能为方便复制批准。 这份表勾满就构成电子签名或法律签收吗？ 不构成本文保证。没有新签署/认证机制，清单不替代实际身份、权限、服务回执或适用规则。 相关指南与源码 认领与归档 · 交接完成审计 · 降级许可 · 变更材料归档 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 原生回复确认守卫 、 历史明确引用关联 、 笔记交接 。

### Multi-role handoff: content approval, phone confirmation and recipient feedback differ

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multi-role-approval-receipt-checklist/

Multi-role handoff: content approval, phone confirmation and recipient feedback differ Multiple participants do not combine into authority; each confirmation has its own scope A note/brief can involve a transcriber, reviewer, operator and recipient. One person’s seen/approved does not replace another’s permission, phone confirmation or feedback. Yihu is a workbench shell/source presentation, not a multi-role approval or electronic-signature engine. This manual checklist creates no organization roles, delegation or server permissions. Different from ownership and completion review Ownership concerns responsibility; handoff review concerns completed-action evidence. Here one role’s confirmation must not substitute for another’s, and version/action scopes must match . A responsibility table is not authority, and reported speech is not a fabricated receipt. Role-specific confirmation checklist Editorial role/confirmation Establishes only Still review Does not replace Transcript reviewer Reviewed original/corrections for a stated version Gaps, originals and omissions Approval, recipient consent or actual sending Content reviewer Specified fields/version within review scope Attachment, destination and conditions Server writes or phone operation confirmation Approving decision-maker Particular action allowed by existing process Identity evidence, scope and revision applicability All future actions, delegation or proxy signatures Note handoff operator Actual choice at existing preview/staging/handoff entry Text, reservation, target and result Recipient reading or business completion Radar phone confirmer Current target/confirmation in native reply flow Fresh source, capability, eligible/epoch and original guards Workflow approval, another identity or server completion Recipient feedback Exactly what authentic feedback states Original request/reply and explicit references Unlinked hearsay, automatic read status or full handling Archive maintainer Materials retained within existing permission Minimization, readers and retention rules Approving or retroactively authorizing the action Unconfirmed role Unknown remains unknown Explicit evidence in original authorized channel Checking every role because someone else approved These are editorial roles, not organization-permission settings. Note staging and native Radar reply are different entry points; one confirmation mechanism is not universal, cryptographic signing or legal receipt. Synthetic confirmation record Content: Sample draft A, with a synthetic attachment description. Review: Role A checked body only; attachment/destination unchecked. Operation authority: Unknown, not inferred from approved prose. Recipient confirmation: Unknown, not inferred from staged. Next: Keep separate gaps; no proxy boxes, sending or fabricated receipts. Manual approval_reference, content_scope, actor_role, recipient_confirmation and remaining_unknowns are checklist labels, not JSON imports, authorization parameters or a native approval API. Public examples use no real names, contact details, private tasks or tokens. Feedback association is not read/handled status Source reply history links later updates to replies through explicit references. A history entry or mention alone does not establish a person’s reading, consent or completion. Even a valid association needs actual feedback/scope review, not a universal receipt certificate. Version/destination changes can exceed prior confirmation. Recheck through the existing process instead of copying approved to new material. Reservations, target guards and uncertain-stop rules remain; another signature-like string does not erase effects or provision permissions. FAQ Does Yihu include multi-level approval/organization role assignment? No such feature is asserted. These are editorial roles/checklists, not provisioned workflows, permissions or delegation. Does content approval authorize sending by default? No. Version, attachments, destination, actual operation authority and guards remain separate from prose approval. Can someone saying sign for me replace phone confirmation? Do not bypass identity/capability/confirmation from hearsay. Existing processes must establish any delegation; no proxy feature is added. Does feedback history prove recipient read and handled everything? No. Verify explicit references and actual contents. Association is not automatic reading, completion or every role’s receipt. Can old approval carry over after text/attachment changes? Only explicit scope can answer. Recheck out-of-scope changes rather than copying prior approval for convenience. Does checking every box create electronic signing/legal receipt? No guarantee follows. No signing/certification mechanism is added; real identity, permissions, receipts and applicable rules remain. Reading and source Ownership/archive · Completion review · Fallback authority · Change-material retention · Start · Privacy Evidence: native reply confirmation guards , explicit history association , note handoff .

### 批量分享前怎样逐条核？混合文字、链接与附件的阶段边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/share-batch-item-preflight/

批量分享前怎样逐条核？混合文字、链接与附件的阶段边界 批次是暂存容器，不是每条已校验或全有全无发送的证明 一呼共享托盘可以暂存多个批次及文字、链接、文件，条目总数只是数量。现有填入逻辑先处理文件，成功后更新/移除相应暂存项，再填入非文件文字；遇错可以停在某个阶段。因此逐条核内容、类型、权限和目标，不能把一次“填入”说成所有条目业务通过、事务提交或消息批量发送。 与多笔记review和完成审计的区别 多笔记指南核原文/修订与顺序，完成审计核最终主张；这里核 混合批次内各条目的类型和已经到达的阶段是否一致 。本文不执行分享，不新增批量发送/审批、逐条扫描器或全局回滚服务。 批次中的单条核查表 单条/阶段 现有边界 应逐条核什么 不能用什么替代 批次总数 itemCount累计暂存条目 数量之外的原文、类型与必要性 有N条就表示N条都已验证 文字条目 非文件文字最终按换行连接后填入 原意、顺序、来源与指令边界 连接后还有完整结构化单条语义 链接条目 仍要核实际目标和暴露范围 来源、路径/查询与获准目的地 链接可点就证明可信/已脱敏 文件条目 页面自有上传控件另处理 每份附件内容、类型与已有副本 文字审核通过等于附件也通过 文件先行成功 对应暂存项更新/移除，再处理文字 文件可能已在目标服务侧 后续文字失败就等于文件没上传 多文件入口限制 页面可返回一次仅支持一个文件等结果 实际控件限制与保留条目 所有网页都支持任意批量文件 文字填入失败 可在已有阶段后停止并提示 目标内容与剩余托盘状态 盲目重放整批就没有重复风险 所有暂存项放置后 批次离开托盘不等于发送 草稿、附件和服务实际状态 全有全无事务、业务批准或接收回执 这是现有逐批处理的源码描述，不是所有网站行为都已验收。托盘没有“逐条已经业务审核”的自动证据，界面计数也不能替代对每份材料的人工授权范围核对。 合成批次分阶段记录 条目A：合成文字，目标和内容已核。 条目B：合成附件，内容尚未核。 批次决定：不能因A通过就整体视为可分享；先停下核B。 若已发生文件阶段：先看目标与剩余托盘，不假定失败已撤回全部副作用。 这不是实际上传日志，不调用网页或客户数据。若工具把多个文本拼接成一段，不要把段落分隔当作原始任务ID或服务端批处理协议；原始单条对应关系仍须在既有权限范围保留。 不把单条缺口变成批量重试 先核每条再决定是否采用，不以总数或某条通过替代整体范围。一次仅一文件、缺控件或类型不支持，应按实际入口处理，不猜测隐藏上传能力。 若已经尝试，先检查可能上传的文件、已填文字与还在托盘中的材料；本地剩余数不证明远端没有副本。笔记一次交接与目标守卫继续有效，修订、拆分或换名字都不自动取消旧标记或授予重发权。 FAQ 显示六条是不是六条都核完且可发送？ 不是。计数不包含内容、权限和目标核验，也不是消息发送或业务批准回执。 一次填入整批是否全有全无？ 不能这样说。文件先行、文字后填，出错时可能已有阶段发生，没有新增事务回滚保证。 正文通过能代替附件逐份核查吗？ 不能。每个文件的内容、类型、敏感层与目的地要独立核，不能按正文批准范围自动扩展。 页面只支持一文件时会自动变成任意批量模式吗？ 不会由本文提供。现有路径会提示按实际限制处理，不新增通用批量上传入口。 后续填文字失败是否表示先前文件也没上传？ 不表示。先核目标与托盘状态，不能把局部失败等同所有步骤从未发生。 托盘清空是否说明接收方已读或任务处理完？ 不说明。放置、发送、接收、业务处理不同，需各自真实证据，不能从托盘状态补造结论。 相关指南与源码 多笔记review · 载体脱敏范围 · 交接完成审计 · 多角色确认 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 托盘条目计数与文件先行流程 、 暂存批次模型 。

### Review every item before sharing a mixed batch of text, links and attachments

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/share-batch-item-preflight/

Review every item before sharing a mixed batch of text, links and attachments A batch is a staging container, not per-item validation or atomic delivery The share tray can retain multiple batches containing text, links and files. Its total is a count. Existing placement handles files first, updates/removes their staged items after attachment, then inserts non-file text. Errors can stop at a stage. Review each item’s content, type, authority and destination instead of calling one placement business acceptance, a transaction or bulk message sending. Different from multi-note review and completion auditing Multi-note review concerns originals/edits/order; completion auditing concerns final claims. Here mixed items may have reached different stages . No sharing is performed and no bulk sender, approver, per-item scanner or global rollback service is added. Per-item and stage checks Item/stage Existing boundary Inspect individually Does not establish Total itemCount sums staged items Original, type and necessity beyond the count N items means N validated Text Non-file text joined with newlines before insertion Meaning, order, source and instruction boundaries Structured item semantics survive joining Link Actual target/disclosure scope still matters Source, path/query and authorized destination Clickable means trusted/redacted File Page-owned upload control is separate Every attachment’s content, type and copies Approved prose approves attachments Files attached first Staged file entries updated/removed before text A remote copy may exist Later text failure means no file uploaded Multi-file limit Page can report one file at a time Actual control limits/remaining items Every page supports arbitrary bulk files Text insertion failure Can stop after an earlier stage Destination content and remaining tray Replaying everything is duplicate-free Batch leaves tray Placement is not sending Draft, attachments and actual service state Atomic transaction, business approval or receipt This is source-described sequential handling, not acceptance of every website. Neither tray count nor presence provides automatic content/permission review for each item. Synthetic staged review A: Synthetic text, content/destination reviewed. B: Synthetic attachment, content unreviewed. Decision: A passing does not approve the batch; stop and review B. If file handling already occurred: Inspect destination/remaining tray; failure did not necessarily recall everything. This is not an upload log and uses no page/customer data. Joined paragraphs are not original task IDs or a server bulk protocol. Preserve original item relationships within existing permissions. Gaps do not authorize replaying a batch Review every item before adoption. One-file limits, missing controls or unsupported types require actual-entry handling, not guessed hidden upload support. After an attempt, inspect possible uploads, inserted text and remaining items. Local counts do not prove no remote copy exists. Note reservations and target guards remain; edits, splits or renamed files do not erase markers or authorize resending. FAQ Does six items mean six reviewed and ready to send? No. Count does not establish content, permission, destination, sending or business approval. Is one placement atomic for the whole batch? No such claim follows. Files precede text and earlier stages can occur before an error. No transaction rollback is added. Does prose approval replace reviewing every attachment? No. Each file’s contents, type, sensitive layers and destination need independent review. Does a one-file page automatically gain bulk support? No. Follow actual page restrictions. No universal bulk upload interface is added. Does failed text insertion mean earlier files were never uploaded? No. Inspect target/tray state; a local failure does not undo every prior stage. Does an empty tray mean the recipient read or handled the task? No. Placement, sending, receipt and business handling differ and require their own evidence. Reading and source Multi-note review · Carrier redaction scope · Completion audit · Multi-role confirmation · Start · Privacy Evidence: tray counts/files-first flow , staged batch model .

### 低电量或锁屏后先核什么？保存段、待转写与重录范围

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/interruption-recapture-preflight/

低电量或锁屏后先核什么？保存段、待转写与重录范围 先核已有材料与缺口，再决定是否重录或重新比较 锁屏不等于长笔记一定丢失：现有界面说明锁屏后继续录音，转写在一呼打开时进行；长录音写盘，来电/重置/写入失败有对应中断处理。但这不是所有低电量、关机、存储和外设情形的零丢失保证。先核保存内容、待转写与真实缺口，不能默认从头重录或让模型补造没录到的话。 与前台返回和音频恢复的区别 前台指南核旧请求与生命周期，恢复矩阵核路由/引擎事件；这里在中断后决定 是否有真实内容缺口、重录应限于何处 。本文不调整电源、不清理文件、不执行录音或恢复。 核查项 现有边界 人工核对 不能推断 长笔记锁屏 界面说明可继续录音，前台转写 实际笔记状态与可用内容 所有电量/系统条件都不中断 短语音后台 与长笔记不同，沿原取消条件 旧请求与结果是否仍有效 把长录音说明套给短语音 尚未看到文字 转写与采集分开 已保存音频和待处理状态 没有转写就没有录到 写盘材料 长录音保留此前已写部分 实际文件可用性与缺口 掉电后任何未写缓冲都能恢复 来电/服务重置 有中断与此前保存提示 已保存范围和错误 提示等于全程连续或所有文件已验收 低电量/写入失败 不在本文承诺自动降级 电源、存储和既有材料 自动节电补录或云恢复 重新录制 新的采集仍需权限和安全条件 只覆盖确认的缺口并人工核版本 重复全段就自动合并去重 后续交接 一次标记与目标守卫继续 旧尝试/副作用与真实回执 重录清空旧状态 合成缺口记录 已有：样例段A实际可用；未知：段B是否保存；待转写：不能仅凭无文字判断。决定：先核B，不直接宣布全失，也不拼接虚构过渡语。 这里没有实际录音或低电量实测。若需要重录，明确这是新版本，不覆盖原材料来伪装连续记录；原始顺序与人工说明分别保留。对于未知或已尝试交接的结果，先停止并核对，不重复发送。 FAQ 锁屏是否意味着必须从头重录？ 不是。现有长笔记有锁屏继续录音说明，先核保存/待转写状态；不能推广到所有采集路径。 低电量模式能保证自动降采样保全吗？ 本文不声明这种功能或保证。按实际状态与错误核，不能把电量情形当已做兼容性测试。 没有转写文字是否证明音频没保存？ 不能。转写与保存分开，前台处理状态和可用材料需独立核。 中断提示保存到此前是否代表零丢失？ 不代表所有缓冲或所有条件可恢复；核实际可用范围，保留未知。 可以让模型补上缺失会议原话吗？ 不能把生成内容当原录音。保留缺口，若有新录制应明确新版本与依据。 重录后能自动去重并重发吗？ 没有新增自动合并/去重或重发权限；原交接标记与不确定停止仍有效。 相关指南与源码 前台状态 · 音频恢复 · 片段核对 · 一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 锁屏与转写界面说明 · 写盘与中断 · 笔记状态与交接

<td>后续交接</td>
<td>一次标记与目标守卫继续</td>

<td>重录清空旧状态</td>

### Low power or screen lock: inspect saved segments before rerecording

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/interruption-recapture-preflight/

Low power or screen lock: inspect saved segments before rerecording Check saved material before deciding to record or compare again Screen lock does not establish lost long notes. Existing UI says recording continues while locked and transcription runs with Yihu open. Long capture writes to disk and handles calls, resets and write errors. This is not zero-loss evidence for every power, shutdown, storage or accessory condition. Inspect saved material, pending transcription and actual gaps before rerecording; never fabricate missing words. Different from foreground and route recovery Foreground review checks lifecycle requests; route recovery checks engine events. Here whether a content gap exists and what a new capture should cover is the decision. No power setting, file cleanup, recording or recovery is performed. Check Existing boundary Review Not established Locked long notes UI describes recording continuation, foreground transcription Actual note/content state Uninterrupted under every battery/OS condition Short speech Different cancellation path Prior request/result validity Long-note guarantees apply universally No visible text Transcription differs from capture Saved audio/pending work No transcript means no capture Written material Long capture retains prior writes Usable file and actual gap All unwritten buffers survive power loss Call/service reset Interruption/saved-so-far notices Saved scope and errors Continuous audio or every file certified Low power/write error No automatic downgrade promised here Power/storage/material state Automatic power-saving recapture/cloud restore New capture Permission/safe conditions still apply Confirmed gap and manually labeled version Automatic merging/deduplication Later handoff Original reservations/guards remain Prior effects and receipts Rerecording resets old attempts Synthetic gap note Known: sample segment A is usable. Unknown: whether B was saved. Pending transcription: lack of text cannot decide. Decision: inspect B before declaring complete loss or generating invented transition words. No recording or low-power benchmark ran. Label recapture as a new version, not overwrite originals to imply continuity. Retain order/editorial notes separately. Uncertain prior handoffs require review, not repeated delivery. FAQ Does locking mean rerecord everything? No. Long-note UI describes continued capture; inspect actual saved/pending state without generalizing to every path. Does low-power mode automatically downsample safely? No such feature/guarantee is asserted. Actual state/errors need review; no battery compatibility test is claimed. Does no transcript mean no saved audio? No. Saving and transcription differ; inspect material and foreground processing separately. Does saved-so-far guarantee zero loss? No. It does not establish all-buffer/every-condition recovery. Review actual usable scope. Can a model fill missing meeting quotations? Generated text is not recorded speech. Keep gaps and label any new recording/version. Can recapture automatically deduplicate and resend? No merging/deduplication/resend authority is added. Reservations and uncertainty rules remain. Reading and source Foreground state · Audio recovery · Segment review · One handoff · Start · Privacy Lock/transcription UI · Disk writes/interruptions · Note state/handoff

</tr>

<td>Low power/write error</td>
<td>No automatic downgrade promised here</td>
<td>Power/storage/material state</td>
<td>Automatic power-saving recapture/cloud restore</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>New capture</td>
<td>Permission/safe conditions still apply</td>
<td>Confirmed gap and manually labeled version</td>
<td>Automatic merging/deduplication</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Later handoff</td>
<td>Original reservations/guards remain</td>
<td>Prior effects and receipts</td>
<td>Rerecording resets old attempts</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### 历史归档怎样检索比对？来源分页、正文省略与未命中边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/history-retrieval-manual-comparison/

历史归档怎样检索比对？来源分页、正文省略与未命中边界 先核已有材料与缺口，再决定是否重录或重新比较 一呼来源回复历史不是本地全量归档搜索引擎。当前历史按目标只读加载，每页至多5项，界面最多加载100条；较长正文可标text_omitted并指向原条目。外部归档的检索由已有获准工具承担。未找到匹配项，不等于原操作、材料或反馈从未存在。 与变更材料归档的分工 变更归档指南核结论对应哪份前后材料；这里核 检索覆盖了哪些位置与内容、命中项怎样人工比对 。不新建搜索索引、归档数据库、备份恢复或全文检索API。 核查项 现有边界 人工核对 不能推断 来源历史 目标与当前源检查后加载 身份、目标与权限 全组织所有任务都在同一个搜索结果 分页 每页至多5项，有游标规则 已加载数、总数与剩余页 第一页就是全部历史 界面上限 最多加载100条 未加载范围与原条目 上限外就不存在记录 正文省略 text_omitted可显示原文较长 回获准原条目核全文 空展示代表原始正文为空 批次/版本 翻页核总量/目标版本等一致性 变化时重新按原入口核 任意时刻的页可拼成稳定全集 外部归档 现有工具与权限另核 搜索位置、日期/版本/别名范围 App有跨账户全量索引 人工比对 按原引用、版本和实际文字 同名不同项、条件与未知 文字相似就代表同一批准或已执行 未命中 可能受权限/省略/加载/范围影响 保留检索范围与缺口 证明从未发生或可安全重试 合成检索记录 位置：样例目标的已加载历史；覆盖：首5条；未核：剩余页与正文省略项；结果：未见匹配，只能报告本范围未命中。 检索词、位置、版本和已核范围可以作为人工标签保留，不是App自动出具的检索证书。不要为了查全文公开私有归档或扩张第三方权限。比对不得把相似文字当签收、把新读取时间当原事件发生时间，或据未命中重新执行不确定操作。 FAQ 历史最多100条是否表示源最多只有100条？ 不是。是界面加载边界，源总量与剩余范围应分开看，未加载不等于不存在。 每页5条是否包含所有任务？ 不是。它是目标历史分页，不是全局任务检索或全量归档快照。 text_omitted的空文字能当原始空正文吗？ 不能。它表示内容省略，需在获准原条目核全文。 能把不同版本的页随意拼起来比对吗？ 不能。现有翻页有一致性校验，手工跨版本材料也应标范围，不冒稳定全集。 搜索未命中能证明之前没发送吗？ 不能。先核检索范围与旧操作证据，不能用未命中绕过一次标记或不确定停止。 一呼提供本地归档全文搜索和恢复吗？ 本文不新增这种能力。外部归档按既有获准工具核，来源历史仍是只读回显。 相关指南与源码 变更材料归档 · 完成证据审计 · 时间口径 · 确认范围 · 开始 · 隐私 历史加载上限与省略提示 · 历史分页与一致性模型

### Retrieve and compare history: pagination, omitted text and no-match boundaries

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/history-retrieval-manual-comparison/

Retrieve and compare history: pagination, omitted text and no-match boundaries Check saved material before deciding to record or compare again Source reply history is not a local full-archive search engine. Current target history loads read-only in pages of at most five; UI loads at most 100 entries. Longer text can be text_omitted with a pointer to the original. Existing authorized tools handle external archives. No match does not establish that an operation, material or feedback never existed. Different from change-material retention Retention maps conclusions to originals. Here retrieval coverage and manual comparison of matches matter. No index, archive database, restore service or full-text API is created. Check Existing boundary Review Not established Source history Target/current-source checks before loading Identity, target and access Global organization/task search Pages Up to five with cursor rules Loaded/total and remaining pages First page is complete UI cap At most 100 loaded Unloaded scope/original entries Nothing exists beyond cap Omitted text text_omitted can indicate longer original Authorized original full text Empty display means empty original Version consistency Paging checks totals/target version Recheck changes through original entry point Arbitrary-time pages form a stable whole External archive Separate authorized tools Locations/date/version/alias coverage App has cross-account global indexing Manual comparison Original references/version/actual text Same names, conditions and unknowns Similar prose means same approval/execution No match Access/omission/loading/scope can limit results Record coverage and gaps Never occurred or safe to retry Synthetic retrieval record Location: loaded history for one sample target. Coverage: first five entries. Unknown: remaining pages/omitted text. Result: no match within this scope only. Query/location/version/coverage are editorial labels, not app-issued search certificates. Do not publish private archives or expand third-party access to find full text. Similar words are not receipts, retrieval time is not event time, and no match cannot justify retrying uncertain operations. FAQ Does a 100-entry cap mean only 100 exist at the source? No. UI loading differs from source total/unloaded scope. Unloaded is not absent. Does a five-entry page include every task? No. It is target history pagination, not global task search or a complete archive. Can empty text with text_omitted be treated as an empty original? No. Content was omitted; inspect the authorized original. Can pages from different versions be freely combined? No. Existing paging checks consistency. Mark cross-version manual material instead of claiming a stable whole. Does no match prove nothing was sent? No. Check coverage/prior evidence; no match bypasses neither reservations nor uncertainty. Does Yihu supply archive full-text search and restore? No such capability is added. External archives use existing authorized tools; source history remains read-only. Reading and source Change-material retention · Completion evidence · Time meanings · Confirmation scope · Start · Privacy Loading cap/omission UI · Pagination/consistency model

### 通知负载源码能证明什么？事件模型不等于推送已上线

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/notification-payload-model-preflight/

通知负载源码能证明什么？事件模型不等于推送已上线 只验出事件形状，不等于验过端到端通知或动作授权 当前源码的CollieRadarNotificationEvent解析yihuRadar负载，约束version、subscriptionId与eventKey。它表示不透明事件意图，不是任意URL或写命令。仅看到这个模型，不能宣布订阅/推送/点击导航已完整接入或线上送达；本页不新建推送基础设施。 与来源兼容和手机确认的区别 这里核 源码里一个输入模型能够支持多大结论 ，而不是请求系统通知权限、测试APNs或批准业务动作。注释要求本地注册订阅与新鲜私有源读取后再导航；这些要求仍要在实际调用链另找证据，不能由结构体自动证明。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 外层负载 读取yihuRadar字典 实际调用者与入口是否接入 所有通知都走此模型 键集合 精确version/subscriptionId/eventKey 额外键也不自动视为兼容 任意扩展字段都接受 version 整数1，并排除布尔类型 类型与版本分别核 true可代替版本1 subscriptionId 需可解析UUID 实际订阅是否本地已注册另核 UUID形状正确就证明有订阅 eventKey 64个小写十六进制字符 形状不代替来源关联 证明密码学签名或真实事件 后续导航 注释要求注册与新鲜源读取 实际实现/测试证据和权限 模型解析成功就已打开任务 写入/执行 模型不是写命令 原确认/写权与回执 点击即同意或自动执行 线上验收 本页只核固定源码 部署、权限、设备与送达另验 推送已上线或延迟保证 合成审查结论 已知：固定源码有事件形状检查。未证：实际注册、投递、点击解析调用与目标导航。结论：只报模型检查，不把未证调用链补成已完成。 不要为验证模型而注册第三方服务、填真实设备token或公开私有源。即使未来端到端测试通过，事件意图也不自动授权写操作或证明业务完成。 FAQ 结构体存在是否说明推送已部署？ 不是。模型、调用链、部署和真机送达是不同证据层级。 version为true可当1吗？ 当前模型明确排除布尔，不能以数值外观代替类型要求。 eventKey像hash是否等于签名？ 不是。64个小写十六进制是形状条件，不独立证明签名、真实性或授权。 有效UUID就代表实际订阅吗？ 不代表。注册关系与身份仍须实际调用链核对。 点通知是否同意执行？ 不能这样推断。不透明事件不是写命令，原权限和确认门继续。 本文是否运行APNs或真机？ 没有。只核固定源码，不宣称设备送达、导航或线上延迟验收。 相关指南与源码 契约兼容 · 确认范围 · 目标与上下文 · 开始 · 隐私 事件模型与注释 · 源码发布与产品边界

### What a notification payload model proves: shape is not deployed push

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/notification-payload-model-preflight/

What a notification payload model proves: shape is not deployed push Parsing an event shape is not end-to-end notification acceptance or authority CollieRadarNotificationEvent parses a yihuRadar payload with version, subscriptionId and eventKey constraints. It represents an opaque intent, not an arbitrary URL/write command. A model alone does not establish subscription wiring, push delivery or click navigation. No push service is provisioned here. Different from source compatibility and phone confirmation Review how far evidence from one input model can support a claim , not system permission, APNs testing or business approval. Comments require local registration and a fresh private-source read before navigation. Those requirements need independent call-chain evidence; a struct does not implement/prove them by itself. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Envelope Reads yihuRadar dictionary Actual caller/entry wiring Every notification uses this model Exact keys version/subscriptionId/eventKey only Extra keys are not automatically compatible Arbitrary extensions accepted version Integer 1, explicitly excludes boolean Type/version separately true replaces 1 subscriptionId Parseable UUID Actual local registration separately UUID shape proves subscription eventKey 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters Source/event association Cryptographic signature or authentic event Navigation Comments require registration/fresh read Actual implementation/tests/access Parsing means task opened Writes/execution Not a write command Original confirmation/write access/receipt Click equals consent or execution Production Fixed-source review only Deployment/device/delivery separately Push live or latency guaranteed Synthetic review result Known: the fixed source checks event shape. Unproved: registration, delivery, click parser invocation and navigation. Report model review only, not a completed integration. Do not register services, enter device tokens or expose private sources to inspect a model. Even future delivery acceptance would not turn an event intent into write authority or business completion. FAQ Does a struct prove deployed push? No. Model, wiring, deployment and device delivery are separate evidence layers. Can true replace version 1? The model explicitly excludes booleans; numeric appearance is insufficient. Is a hash-looking eventKey a signature? No. A 64-lowercase-hex shape independently proves neither signature, authenticity nor authority. Does valid UUID prove registration? No. Registration/identity need actual call-chain review. Does notification tapping approve execution? No. An opaque event is not a write command. Original permission/confirmation remain. Were APNs/devices tested here? No. Fixed source only, without delivery/navigation/latency acceptance. Reading and source Contract compatibility · Confirmation scope · Target/context · Start · Privacy Event model/comments · Source/product scope

### PCM格式准入怎样核？采样范围、声道与转换失败不等于设备认证

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/pcm-format-admission-review/

PCM格式准入怎样核？采样范围、声道与转换失败不等于设备认证 格式在范围内只是准入前提，不是所有外设都能转换的保证 现有ColliePCMStreamConverter要求有限且在8000至192000 Hz的输入采样率、1至8声道、Float32非交错格式，再尝试建立输出16k单声道转换器。满足这些检查仍可能无法创建/转换。本页审查具体输入准入，不提供用户改采样率开关、设备认证或通用音频导入器。 与权限和录中恢复的区别 权限指南核前提是否齐全，恢复矩阵核路由事件；这里核 一个原生PCM格式为什么进不了转换器或后续块检查 。没有调用系统录音或生成格式覆盖实测。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 采样率 有限且8000…192000 Hz 实际格式值与创建结果 范围内所有设备已验证 声道数 1…8 真实声道描述 自动识别说话人或多轨分离 数据格式 pcmFormatFloat32 不是只看扩展名/编码标签 任意整数PCM或压缩文件可直接送入 交错状态 要求非交错 实际缓冲布局 可以只改声明重解释字节 输出 16k单声道 既有转换器成功返回 用户可用8k降级绕过 连续输入块 核isStandard/采样率/声道/格式 是否匹配原sourceFormat 旧转换器永远可复用 PCMChunk 复制有效非空块跨队列 块与缓冲生命周期 复制等于隐私认证或录文准确 失败结果 unsupportedFormat/conversionFailed等 区分格式与处理失败 自动补音、云转换或已交付 合成格式核查 输入：采样率在范围内，但不是Float32非交错。结论：仍不满足该转换器条件；不以“采样率看起来正常”宣布兼容。即使所有条件通过，也需实际创建与转换结果。 参数是实现准入，不是音质/识别率承诺。不要改头信息伪装格式、任意复用转换器或跳过目标/模型条件；错误分类也不是对录音原内容真实性的判断。 FAQ 48000 Hz在范围就必定可用吗？ 不必定。其他格式条件、转换器创建与实际转换仍须成功。 1至8声道是不是多人分离能力？ 不是。它是输入准入，输出契约为单声道，不提供说话人分离。 改成Float32标签能修实际字节吗？ 不能。声明与真实布局须一致，不可用改标签绕过格式检查。 声道相同是否可以复用旧转换器？ 不能只看声道，采样率、标准格式等一致性也要核。 这是硬件型号认证表吗？ 不是。未做设备矩阵、噪声或准确率测试。 失败后会自动去云端或补音吗？ 本文不提供回退/补音。保留错误与缺口，沿原获准流程处理。 相关指南与源码 权限与内部采样 · 路由恢复 · 中断缺口 · 开始 · 隐私 格式/块准入与转换器 · 原生采集入口

### PCM format admission: rates, channels and conversion are not device certification

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/pcm-format-admission-review/

PCM format admission: rates, channels and conversion are not device certification Within range is an admission prerequisite, not an all-accessory conversion guarantee ColliePCMStreamConverter requires finite 8000–192000 Hz input, 1–8 channels and non-interleaved Float32 before attempting a 16 kHz mono output converter. Creation/conversion can still fail. This reviews exact admission, not a user rate control, hardware certification or universal audio importer. Different from permission and route recovery Permission checks prerequisites; recovery checks route events. Here why a native PCM format/block fails converter admission matters. No capture or format-coverage benchmark ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Rate Finite 8000…192000 Hz Actual value/creation result Every device in range tested Channels 1…8 Actual channel descriptor Speaker identification or track separation Common format pcmFormatFloat32 Actual data, not suffix/label Any integer PCM/compressed file directly accepted Interleaving Non-interleaved required Actual buffer layout Relabeling reinterprets bytes safely Output 16 kHz mono Existing conversion succeeds User 8 kHz bypass Successive blocks isStandard/rate/channels/format checks Original sourceFormat match Old converter always reusable PCMChunk Copies valid nonempty blocks across queues Block/buffer lifetime Privacy certification or recognition accuracy Failure unsupportedFormat/conversionFailed etc. Format versus processing errors Invented audio, cloud conversion or delivery Synthetic format review Input rate is in range but data is not non-interleaved Float32. Result: still fails this converter’s prerequisites. A normal-looking rate is insufficient. Even passing all conditions needs successful creation/conversion. Parameters are admission rules, not quality/accuracy promises. Do not falsify headers, force converters or skip destination/model guards. Error categories do not authenticate spoken content. FAQ Is 48000 Hz guaranteed usable? No. Other conditions and actual creation/conversion must succeed. Does 1–8 channels mean speaker separation? No. It is input admission; output is mono, not diarization. Can a Float32 label repair actual bytes? No. Description/layout must match; labels cannot bypass checks. Do matching channels justify reusing a converter? Not alone. Rate, standard-format and other conditions also matter. Is this hardware certification? No device/noise/accuracy matrix was tested. Does failure trigger cloud conversion or generated fill? No fallback/fill is added. Keep errors/gaps within the original authorized process. Reading and source Permission/sample contract · Route recovery · Interruption gaps · Start · Privacy Format/block/converter admission · Native capture entry

### 回复归档怎样对应请求？request_id、目标版本与待核回执分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/reply-request-receipt-mapping/

回复归档怎样对应请求？request_id、目标版本与待核回执分账 同一文字不代表同一次请求，recorded也不代表已执行 原生Radar回复在submit前持久保存含requestID的待核记录，避免不确定写入变成新回复；网络结果不明时先check。recorded会显示已记录、待处理，授权确认的提示更明确说明尚未执行。归档要对应实际请求与目标，不把文字相似、时间接近或HTTP阶段当业务完成。 与最终主张审计、角色清单的区别 这里核 请求身份与待核记录/回执怎样对应 ，不是重新审批正文或给所有服务保证exactly-once。本文不提交请求、不清理本地记录、不提供后台幂等服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 request_id 请求用UUID关联 同次操作和原记录 同文自动等于同ID 目标id/version/epoch 按当前目标与来源守卫 确认时版本和来源 只凭标题/URL外观认定同目标 持久待核 先保存submitted再发送 保存是否成功、原请求身份 这是永久归档或备份服务 传输不确定 保留pending并先查回 超时与业务拒绝分开 超时说明从未写入 check recorded 走已记录路径 原请求与真实返回 业务已执行/所有角色处理完 check absent 重新prepare并保留同requestID 遵循原入口与确认 用户可随意删标记制造新ID 明确拒绝 只有对应分支清理后可能新ID 实际错误类别与清理结果 把所有错误都当安全重试 人工归档 请求、版本、范围与回执对应 只留获准必要信息 App新建操作日志库或所有后端恰好一次 合成请求核对 记录A：请求甲，结果待核；记录B：文字相同但请求身份未知。结论：不能合并成一次成功，也不能因B没记录就重发A。先沿原查回流程核。 内部待核记录不是供手工编辑的归档接口；源码有备份排除和文件保护等范围，不构成永久保留/恢复保证。人工档案不能改变请求ID、来源epoch或授权范围来绕过不确定停止。 FAQ 同文就是同一个请求吗？ 不是。应以真实请求身份和目标/来源关系核，不能仅凭文本去重。 超时能生成新ID直接再发吗？ 不应。原路径保留待核并先check，不能把传输不确定当已拒绝。 recorded是否证明执行完成？ 不是。源码提示是已记录待处理；授权确认也明确尚未执行。 查回absent是否一定换新ID？ 当前该路径保留同requestID并重新prepare，不能自造新的重复写入。 本地待核文件就是永久备份吗？ 不是。它为不确定恢复服务，文件保护/备份排除不等于归档与恢复SLA。 这里保证任何服务exactly-once吗？ 不保证。核的是当前客户端及协议路径，不能扩展到任意后端。 相关指南与源码 完成主张 · 角色确认 · 材料归档 · 开始 · 隐私 持久待核/submit/check/recorded · 目标与历史模型

### Map reply evidence to request identity, target version and pending receipts

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/reply-request-receipt-mapping/

Map reply evidence to request identity, target version and pending receipts Identical text is not request identity, and recorded is not executed Native Radar replies persist a pending record with requestID before submit so uncertain writes do not silently become new replies. Unclear network outcomes require check. Recorded means retained/pending handling; authorization-confirmed notices explicitly say not executed. Map evidence to actual request/target rather than similar text, nearby times or transport stages. Different from completion claims and role approval Review request identity against pending state/receipts , not content approval or universal exactly-once delivery. No request is sent, local record cleared or backend idempotency service implemented. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established request_id UUID request association Same operation/original record Same text means same ID Target id/version/epoch Current-target/source guards Confirmed version/source Title/URL appearance identifies target Persisted pending Save submitted state before sending Successful save/original identity Permanent archive/backup service Uncertain transport Keep pending and check Timeout versus explicit rejection Timeout means never written check recorded Recorded path Original request/actual response Business execution/every role done check absent Prepare again, retain same requestID Original entry/confirmation Delete markers to manufacture another ID Explicit rejection Selected branches may clear then renew ID Actual error/cleanup result Every failure safely retryable Editorial retention Request/version/scope/receipt mapping Authorized necessary data only New log database or every backend exactly-once Synthetic mapping review A: request alpha, unresolved. B: same text, unknown request identity. Do not combine into one success or resend A because B lacks a receipt. Follow original check flow. Pending records are not hand-edited archive APIs. Source backup exclusion/file protection does not establish permanent retention/recovery. Editorial archives cannot alter request IDs, source epoch or authority to bypass uncertainty. FAQ Does identical prose identify one request? No. Use actual request/target/source relationships, not text-only deduplication. Can timeout justify a new ID and immediate resend? No. Original handling preserves pending and checks first; uncertain transport is not rejection. Does recorded prove execution? No. It means retained/pending handling; authorization confirmation explicitly remains unexecuted. Does absent always create a new ID? This path keeps the same requestID and prepares again instead of manufacturing another write. Is pending storage a permanent backup? No. It supports uncertain-result recovery; file protection/exclusion is not archival or restore SLA. Is exactly-once guaranteed for arbitrary services? No. Current client/protocol review does not establish every backend’s behavior. Reading and source Completion claims · Role confirmation · Material retention · Start · Privacy Persist/submit/check/recorded · Target/history models

### 证据文本为什么没变可点链接？分隔、HTTPS与去重准入核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/evidence-link-admission-preflight/

证据文本为什么没变可点链接？分隔、HTTPS与去重准入核对 能点只代表通过当前形态筛选，不代表证据可信或已脱敏 Radar保留evidence文字，再从中筛选可点URL。当前解析按空白/换行与列出的分隔符拆项，去边界标点，只接纳HTTPS、非空host、无内嵌用户名密码及有效端口，再按absoluteString去重。它不是完整Markdown解析器、安全扫描或业务证据认证。 与引用溯源、异常证据二查的区别 溯源指南核句子依据、二查核真实性；这里先解释 为什么一段证据文字可能没有生成链接、哪些URL形态被接纳 。源码分隔符为分号、逗号、中文逗号/分号和竖线等；本页不访问示例链接、不改源数据。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 空值/空串 返回空链接列表 真实evidence与显示占位 任务没有任何证据 分词 空白/换行及指定标点 逗号可能切开合法URL文本 自动理解所有引用语法 边界标点 去两端括号/引号等 候选串实际结果 完整解析标签式Markdown scheme/host HTTPS且host非空 协议和实际目的地 安全域名白名单或权限已核 内嵌凭据 user/password必须为空 不在URL放真实凭据 路径/查询里的敏感信息也自动消失 端口 显式端口限1…65535 形态与目标访问权限分开 所有端口服务已验证 去重 按absoluteString首次保留 不同拼法与实际引用关系 语义同址全面归一 结果 只输出可点候选 正文、证据质量与目的地 无风险/真实/已读或已处理 合成链接核查 单独的 https://example.com/review可作为形态示意，不表示真实项目证据；带标签的Markdown链接不保证按完整语法展开。遇到未提取项，先核原文和分词，不删除证据或补造安全结论。 链接里的路径、查询和片段仍可能泄露信息，即使没有user/password。访问前遵守已有权限与目的地范围，不把解析器名称中的safe当恶意内容扫描或所有网络访问安全保证。 FAQ 没有可点链接是否表示没有证据？ 不表示。原文可能不是符合该分词/URL规则的链接，须核原材料。 Markdown标签链接一定提取吗？ 不保证。这里不是完整Markdown解析器，不应假定所有嵌套标记都支持。 HTTPS就证明可信和获准访问吗？ 不是。这里只核形态；来源真伪、内容、身份与访问权限另核。 无用户名密码是否已经脱敏？ 不等于。路径/查询/片段仍可能含敏感信息，需人工核范围。 去重会把所有等价地址合为一条吗？ 不声明语义归一，只按absoluteString去重。 本页是否打开过示例URL？ 没有，未作网站安全或业务证据验收。 相关指南与源码 证据二查 · 句子溯源 · 载体敏感层 · 开始 · 隐私 parseSafeEvidenceURLs · 链接展示

### Why evidence text has no clickable link: tokenization, HTTPS and URL admission

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/evidence-link-admission-preflight/

Why evidence text has no clickable link: tokenization, HTTPS and URL admission Clickable means admitted shape, not trusted, redacted evidence Radar retains evidence text and extracts clickable URLs. Parsing splits whitespace/newlines and listed delimiters, trims edge punctuation, requires HTTPS/nonempty host/no embedded user-password/valid port, then deduplicates by absoluteString. This is not full Markdown parsing, security scanning or business-evidence certification. Different from provenance and evidence truth checks Provenance maps claims; second checks assess truth. Here why text does not produce a link and which URL shapes are admitted matters. Delimiters include Latin/Chinese comma/semicolon and vertical bar. No example URL is fetched or source rewritten. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Null/empty Empty URL list Original evidence versus placeholder No business evidence exists Tokenization Whitespace/newlines/listed punctuation Comma can split valid URL text All reference syntax understood Edge punctuation Trims brackets/quotes etc. Actual candidate Full labeled Markdown parsing Scheme/host HTTPS, nonempty host Protocol/destination Safe-domain allowlist or authority Embedded credentials No user/password Keep credentials out of URLs Paths/queries automatically redacted Port Explicit 1…65535 Shape versus access permission Every endpoint tested Deduplication First absoluteString retained Spellings/reference relationships Universal semantic normalization Result Clickable candidates only Body/evidence quality/destination Harmless, true, read or handled Synthetic URL review Standalone https://example.com/review illustrates shape, not real project evidence. Labeled Markdown need not expand through a full grammar. Inspect original/tokenization rather than deleting evidence or inventing safety conclusions. Paths, queries and fragments can disclose information despite no user/password. Existing access/destination permission applies; safe in a method name is neither a malware scan nor universal network safety. FAQ Does no link mean no evidence? No. Text may not meet tokenization/URL rules. Inspect originals. Are labeled Markdown links always extracted? No guarantee. This is not a full Markdown parser supporting all nesting. Does HTTPS prove trust and access permission? No. Shape differs from origin, content, identity and authority. Is no embedded user/password equivalent to redaction? No. Paths/query/fragments can remain sensitive. Are all equivalent URLs merged? No semantic-normalization guarantee; deduplication uses absoluteString. Were example URLs opened? No. No site-security or business-evidence acceptance was performed. ### 录音处理跟不上输入怎样核？短语音队列、预览快照与最终结果

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/capture-buffer-pressure-checklist/

录音处理跟不上输入怎样核？短语音队列、预览快照与最终结果 bufferOverflow是失败边界，不应把部分预览当完整录音 短语音PCM管线用串行队列和有界源帧预算；等待帧超过max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096)会记录bufferOverflow并停止接纳，最终走失败。snapshot不等待队列排空，只是当前输出快照。不能凭预览已有文字/音量，宣布完整采集和交付成功。 与PCM准入和路由恢复的区别 格式准入核输入形状，路由恢复核系统事件；这里核 处理压力下的队列、停止、快照和最终结果含义 。只限该短语音管线，不把其预算推广为长笔记限制或设备性能测试。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 队列预算 max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096)源帧 等待量与实际错误 固定半秒端到端延迟SLA 合成算例 48000 Hz对应24000等待源帧 这是帧预算，不是字节 整个App总RAM精确上限 溢出 bufferOverflow失败、停止接纳 实际错误和未完成状态 静默丢块后仍完整成功 snapshot 不为预览排空队列 当前输出与最终输出分开 预览包含所有已入队音频 正常requestStop 停止接纳，处理队列并flush尾部 返回的最终结果或失败 按停按钮立即证明全部完成 时长边界 入参有限且至多30秒 正常到限停止与durationExceeded分开 所有到30秒都报错或长笔记也30秒 cancel 清待处理/输出并重置 取消与已提交副作用分开 还有隐形备份可完整恢复 后续交接 仍依final与原守卫 结果/目标/旧尝试 调参数或重录自动授予重发 合成压力结论 预览存在，但最终返回bufferOverflow。结论：不能把预览当完整最终结果；标明失败与缺口。排查不应任意放大队列、跳过格式/模型条件或据此宣称特定设备算力不足。 源码预算不证明实时性能、噪声或识别准确率；正在转换的块、输出和其他内存也不是只由等待帧数代表。本页没有压测、录音或修改管线。 FAQ 半秒源帧预算就是半秒延迟吗？ 不是。它是等待帧准入量，不能等同端到端延迟或所有系统调度。 24000帧是不是24000字节？ 不是。帧、声道、采样数据布局与总内存不同，不能直接混算。 预览有文字能忽略溢出吗？ 不能。最终失败不因部分预览存在而变成完整成功。 snapshot会等所有输入处理完吗？ 当前实现不为预览排空队列，须与最终停止结果区分。 30秒上限适用于所有长笔记吗？ 不适用。这里是短语音管线，长录音写盘路径不同。 本文是否新增自动调队列或云回退？ 没有。只核源码失败边界，不提供调参/回退/零丢失保证。 相关指南与源码 PCM格式准入 · 路由恢复 · 重录缺口 · 开始 · 隐私 队列预算/snapshot/停止与失败 · 短语音时长入口

### Capture cannot keep up: short-speech queues, previews and final results

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/capture-buffer-pressure-checklist/

Capture cannot keep up: short-speech queues, previews and final results bufferOverflow is a failure boundary; partial previews are not complete recording The short-speech PCM pipeline uses a serial queue and bounded waiting source frames. Exceeding max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096) records bufferOverflow, stops admission and ultimately fails. snapshot does not drain the queue; it captures current output only. Visible previews/levels do not prove complete capture or delivery. Different from format and route review Format admission checks shape; route recovery checks system events. Here queue, stop, snapshot and final meanings under pressure matter. This scope is short speech, not long-note limits or hardware performance testing. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Budget max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096) source frames Waiting amount/error Fixed half-second end-to-end SLA Synthetic arithmetic 48000 Hz → 24000 waiting frames Frames, not bytes Exact whole-app RAM cap Overflow bufferOverflow failure, admission stops Actual error/incomplete state Silent drops still count as full success snapshot Does not drain for preview Current versus final output Every queued block included Normal requestStop Stop admission, process queue/flush tail Returned final/error Stop tap proves instant completion Duration Finite parameter up to 30 seconds Normal limit stop versus durationExceeded Every 30-second capture errors or long notes share limit cancel Clears pending/output and resets Cancellation versus committed effects Hidden complete recovery backup Handoff Final/original guards still apply Result/target/prior attempt Tuning or recapture grants resend Synthetic pressure result A preview exists, but final reports bufferOverflow. Do not present the preview as complete. Retain failure/gap evidence without arbitrarily growing queues, bypassing model/format checks or diagnosing hardware capability from one result. Source budgets are not runtime/noise/accuracy evidence. Processing blocks, output and other allocations are not represented by waiting frames alone. No stress test, recording or pipeline modification ran. FAQ Does half-second frame budget mean half-second latency? No. Waiting admission differs from end-to-end latency/scheduling. Are 24000 frames 24000 bytes? No. Frames, channels/layout and total memory differ. Can visible text justify ignoring overflow? No. Partial preview does not turn final failure into completeness. Does snapshot wait for every block? Not for preview. Distinguish current output from final stop results. Do all long notes have a 30-second limit? No. This is short speech; long-note disk recording differs. Is automatic queue tuning/cloud fallback added? No. This reviews source failure boundaries, not tuning/fallback/zero-loss guarantees. Reading and source Format admission · Route recovery · Recapture gaps · Start · Privacy Budget/snapshot/stop/failure · Short-speech duration entry

### 音频、笔记元数据与转写归档怎样对应？进度不等于逐字真实性

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-audio-text-evidence-mapping/

音频、笔记元数据与转写归档怎样对应？进度不等于逐字真实性 文字、音频与元数据是不同材料，交接文字不代表音频也已分享 现有笔记按同一id管理audio.caf与note.json，转写从transcribedFrames继续并累积transcript。处理到done不等于每个词都已核对；emptyTranscript分支可以推进帧进度却不增加文字。交给工作台的路径分享转写文字，不含录音文件。本页是人工材料对应清单，不新增音文对齐或原件归档服务。 与片段审校和版本材料归档的区别 片段审校核听到什么，变更归档核评审前后材料；这里核 本地音频、元数据、处理进度和对外交接文字是否被误当同一份证据 。不访问沙盒、不导出实际文件、不建立新索引或备份。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 note id 同一笔记材料定位关系 实际原件与版本 同名文件就同一记录 audio.caf 本地采集文件 实际可读范围/状态 显示文字证明音频完整 note.json 元数据/状态/转写等 原始状态与人工副本 不可篡改审计证书 transcribedFrames 16k帧处理位置 处理覆盖与原内容另核 字级时间对齐或逐词准确率 emptyTranscript 可跳过文字但仍推进位置 实际内容是否需回查 原音频一定无业务内容 done 这次转写流程完成 原文、未知和错误范围 真实性/语义完整自动验收 文字交接 短文本或长Markdown 实际交出的文字与附件 默认分享audio.caf或所有原件 本地保留 源码尝试排除笔记备份 实际权限、保留规则/其他副本 永久备份、灾后恢复或一键原件归档 合成材料对应 笔记甲的元数据为done，正文只有一段文字；不能仅凭done宣布整段音频逐词已核，也不能因托盘有Markdown就标记音频已移交。先核真正材料与范围。 人工可保留原引用、实际文字版本、已核内容与未知，但不要把内部字段当可手改的导入/恢复API。修改副本不改变真实源材料，处理进度不是内容真实性证明；一次交接标记也不因另建档案取消。 FAQ 100%或done是否证明每词正确？ 不是。它反映处理流程，不代替听核、语义与原文验收。 emptyTranscript是否一定说明原音频只有静音？ 不能由该分支独立证明。实现可略过文字并推进进度，真实内容另核。 transcribedFrames是每个词的时间戳吗？ 不是。它是16k帧处理位置，不提供字级强制对齐功能。 交接长Markdown是否连音频一起上传？ 引用路径交接文字，不含录音文件；不能从文字附件推原件分享。 note.json是不可篡改证据吗？ 本文不声明签名或不可篡改机制，元数据与可信/真实性不同。 本地有音频是否等于永久备份？ 不是。源码尝试排除备份且不提供本页新增的恢复保证，按实际保留规则核。 相关指南与源码 片段审校 · 文字附件格式 · 材料归档链 · 逐项分享范围 · 开始 · 隐私 元数据与一次标记 · 音频/帧进度/文字交接 · 仅分享文字说明

### Map audio, note metadata and transcript evidence: progress is not verbatim truth

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-audio-text-evidence-mapping/

Map audio, note metadata and transcript evidence: progress is not verbatim truth Audio, text and metadata differ; handing off text does not share the audio Notes relate audio.caf and note.json by one id. Transcription resumes at transcribedFrames and accumulates transcript. Done does not establish every word was reviewed; the emptyTranscript branch can advance frames without adding text. Workbench handoff shares transcription, not recording files. This is an editorial mapping checklist, not forced alignment or original-file archiving. Different from passage review and revision retention Passage review checks speech; revision retention maps reviewed versions. Here local audio, metadata, progress and handed-off text must not be mistaken for identical evidence . No sandbox access, file export, index or backup is performed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Note id Relates one note’s materials Actual originals/version Same filename means same record audio.caf Local captured file Readable scope/state Text display proves complete audio note.json Metadata/state/transcript etc. Original state versus editorial copy Tamper-proof audit certificate transcribedFrames 16 kHz frame processing position Processing scope versus contents Word alignment or accuracy emptyTranscript May advance position without text Whether actual content needs review Original contained no business speech done Transcription process finished Originals/unknowns/error scope Automatic truth/semantic completeness acceptance Text handoff Short text or long Markdown Actual delivered text/attachment audio.caf/all originals shared by default Local retention Source attempts backup exclusion Permissions/policy/other copies Permanent backup, disaster recovery or original archive button Synthetic mapping review Sample note is done with one text paragraph. That does not prove every audio word was reviewed; a staged Markdown file does not establish audio transfer. Inspect actual materials/scope. Keep authorized references/text versions/reviewed scope/gaps manually, without treating internal fields as editable import/restore APIs. Copies do not change originals, progress does not authenticate contents, and an archive does not erase handoff reservations. FAQ Does 100% or done certify every word? No. Processing state does not replace listening, meaning or original-content review. Does emptyTranscript prove only silence existed? Not independently. Processing can skip text and advance; actual content needs separate review. Is transcribedFrames a timestamp for each word? No. It is a 16 kHz frame position, not forced word alignment. Does long Markdown also upload the audio? The cited path hands off text, not recording files. Text attachments do not prove original transfer. Is note.json tamper-proof evidence? No signing/immutability mechanism is asserted. Metadata differs from trust/truth. Does local audio mean permanent backup? No. Source attempts backup exclusion; actual retention applies without a new restore guarantee. ### Radar源URL为什么被拒？路径、查询和证据链接的不同边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-feed-url-boundary-preflight/

Radar源URL为什么被拒？路径、查询和证据链接的不同边界 证据链接能点，不代表同一地址能作为Radar源 CollieRadarFeed.validate允许源URL带路径，但要求HTTPS、非空host、无内嵌用户名密码、无query和fragment，显式端口在1至65535。证据URL另用parseSafeEvidenceURLs，规则不能互换。通过源形态校验仍不证明认证、可达、成功读取或快照有效，本页不新增源服务或凭据配置。 与证据URL准入和离线排障的分工 证据指南核可点候选，离线指南核失败状态；这里先核 配置为数据源的地址本身是否符合消费者边界 。不发网络请求、不输入真实凭据、不把有效URL当私有来源身份认证。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 首尾空白 先去首尾空白再解析 原配置与实际返回URL 清洗所有内部字符 协议与host HTTPS且host非空 实际来源身份另核 可信域白名单或TLS实测 path 源可有路径 路径是否实际提供源 浏览器可信origin规则直接代用 内嵌凭据 user/password必须空 沿既有获准认证流程 把密码塞URL就能使用 query/fragment 必须都不存在 即使只是view=demo也不同 证据链接允许就源也允许 端口 显式1…65535 服务可达性与访问权限 所有端口和来源已测试 返回内容 形态校验不是JSON解码 真实模型/日期/大小/身份 任意网页地址都是快照源 失败处理 保持原守卫 错误类别和原来源配置 自动改HTTP/换服务/公开私有源 合成地址比较 https://example.com/radar.json只是带path的形态示意；加?view=demo或#part会触及当前源校验的query/fragment限制。示例未访问，不代表实际源存在。 不要为了通过校验删掉真实认证条件或改用未批准公开服务。形态、认证、读取和内容验收是四类证据；其中一项通过不补齐其余，也不产生回复写权。 FAQ HTTPS链接可点就能当源吗？ 不能。证据候选和源URL有不同消费者规则，尤其query/fragment。 源必须只有域名不能有path吗？ 不是。该校验允许path，但路径是否实际有效仍需获准读取证据。 无敏感内容的query也允许吗？ 当前校验要求query不存在，不能按内容无害自行放宽。 通过validate是否证明认证成功？ 不证明。没有发出请求，身份、权限与真实响应另核。 地址失败能改HTTP绕过吗？ 不应。按原错误和获准配置处理，不绕HTTPS边界。 本页是否创建或访问了示例源？ 没有，未注册服务、输入凭据或发网络请求。 相关指南与源码 证据链接准入 · 离线与来源失败 · JSON消费者条件 · 开始 · 隐私 CollieRadarFeed与证据URL校验 · 来源与工作台边界

### Why a Radar feed URL is rejected: paths, queries and evidence-link differences

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-feed-url-boundary-preflight/

Why a Radar feed URL is rejected: paths, queries and evidence-link differences A clickable evidence URL is not automatically a valid Radar feed CollieRadarFeed.validate permits a path but requires HTTPS, nonempty host, no embedded user/password, no query/fragment and an explicit port within 1–65535. Evidence uses separate parseSafeEvidenceURLs rules. Passing feed shape proves neither authentication, reachability, a successful read nor valid snapshot. No source service or credential setup is added. Different from evidence admission and offline diagnosis Evidence admission checks clickable candidates; offline review checks failures. Here whether a configured source address meets consumer boundaries comes first. No network request or real credentials are used, and shape is not private-source identity verification. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Edge whitespace Trim before parsing Original configuration/returned URL Every internal character cleansed Scheme/host HTTPS/nonempty host Actual source identity Trusted-domain allowlist or TLS test Path Allowed on feeds Actual source endpoint Browser-origin rules interchangeable Credentials No user/password Existing authorized auth process Passwords in URLs are supported Query/fragment Both absent Even view=demo differs Evidence allowance transfers to feeds Port Explicit 1…65535 Access/reachability Every port/source tested Response URL validation is not JSON decoding Model/date/size/identity Any web page is a snapshot Failure Original guards remain Category/original configuration Automatic HTTP/other service/private disclosure Synthetic address comparison https://example.com/radar.json illustrates a path only. Adding ?view=demo or #part meets current query/fragment rejection conditions. Nothing is fetched and no real source is established. Do not remove real authentication conditions or use an unapproved public service to pass a check. Shape, authentication, reading and content acceptance are separate; none silently supplies the others or write access. FAQ Can every clickable HTTPS link be a source? No. Consumers differ, especially query/fragment rules. Must a feed be a bare domain without path? No. A path is allowed; actual endpoint validity still needs authorized evidence. Is a harmless query allowed? The current validator requires no query, irrespective of assumed harmlessness. Does validate prove authentication? No request occurs there. Identity, permissions and response remain separate. Can failure be bypassed with HTTP? Do not bypass HTTPS; inspect actual errors/authorized configuration. Was the example source created or fetched? No service registration, credentials or network request occurred. Reading and source Evidence URL admission · Offline/source failures · JSON consumer conditions · Start · Privacy Feed/evidence URL validators · Source/workbench boundaries

### 近讲偏好不等于路由实测：HFP允许、会话模式与当前输入核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/near-field-policy-route-review/

近讲偏好不等于路由实测：HFP允许、会话模式与当前输入核对 allowBluetoothHFP是允许条件，不是外设已被选中或更准确的证明 现有短语音在start读取近讲偏好。启用策略采用playAndRecord、voiceChat及mixWithOthers/allowBluetoothHFP；关闭策略为record/default。输入图策略也随该偏好分支。它们是实现选择，不是当前硬件已成功启用、强制选择某支麦克风或实测准确率；本页不新增降噪/选麦服务。 与外设适用性和恢复矩阵的区别 外设前检核场景条件，恢复矩阵核录中事件；这里核 保存的偏好、启动配置、输入图和实际系统路由的证据层级 。不切换系统设置或录音，长笔记另有自己的采集路径。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 保存偏好 缺值时源码默认true 实际版本与入口 默认值等于系统已授权 启用会话 playAndRecord/voiceChat setCategory/setActive结果 所有设备都成功或无回声 HFP allowBluetoothHFP为允许 实际输入路由 强制选中已配对耳机麦克风 混音选项 mixWithOthers策略 实际输出/页面播放状态 网页TTS与采集无限同时可用 输入图 近讲策略启用voice processing等 实际图配置是否成功 固定高噪成绩或说话人识别 关闭策略 record/default原路径 对应入口与当前状态 所有外设自动兼容 启动快照 本次start读取偏好 本次会话和后续设置区别 改偏好就证明旧录音已重绑 其他采集 长笔记路径单独实现 实际入口与权限/格式 一套策略覆盖所有录音/网页 合成策略核查 已知：偏好启用；未知：实际HFP输入与图配置结果。结论：只能说启动策略允许，不报外设选择或高噪性能。若准备/启动失败，沿原错误处理，不强行复用不一致管线。 voiceChat或voice processing名称不是风噪、距离、延迟或准确率SLA。先核实际路由和安全环境，不让策略标签替代设备/系统验收，也不扩张服务和目标权限。 FAQ 偏好为true说明麦克风已授权吗？ 不说明。保存偏好与系统授权、启动结果是不同条件。 HFP允许是否强制选耳机麦克风？ 不是。必须核实际系统输入路由，不能只看配对或配置选项。 voiceChat是否保证骑行风噪可用？ 没有这种实测或SLA，本页也不建议驾驶/骑行中操作。 mixWithOthers是否保证所有网页朗读和采集同时工作？ 不能保证。实际页面/系统/输入输出边界仍需核。 长笔记也完全沿这套近讲策略吗？ 不能推广。引用的是短语音入口，长笔记采集单独核。 改设置等于旧会话已经重绑吗？ 不能由保存值推断。核本次启动、实际相位/路由与原守卫。 相关指南与源码 外设前检 · 路由恢复 · 权限与格式 · 开始 · 隐私 近讲会话/图策略与启动 · 既有设置入口 · 长笔记独立路径

### Near-field preference versus actual route: HFP allowance and capture policy

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/near-field-policy-route-review/

Near-field preference versus actual route: HFP allowance and capture policy allowBluetoothHFP is permission to use a route, not proof it was selected or more accurate Short-speech start reads the near-field preference. Enabled policy uses playAndRecord/voiceChat with mixWithOthers/allowBluetoothHFP; disabled policy uses record/default. Input graph policy branches too. These are implementation choices, not successful hardware activation, forced mic selection or measured accuracy. No noise-removal/mic-selection service is added. Different from accessory suitability and recovery Suitability checks environment; recovery checks capture events. Here stored preference, startup configuration, graph and actual route have separate evidence scopes . No setting or recording changes occur; long notes use another capture path. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Preference Default true when absent Actual version/entry Default means system authorization Enabled session playAndRecord/voiceChat Category/activation results Universal success or no echo HFP allowBluetoothHFP permits Actual input route Paired headset mic forced Mixing mixWithOthers policy Actual playback/output Unlimited web TTS/capture coexistence Input graph Voice-processing policy etc. Actual configuration success Noise benchmark or speaker identification Disabled record/default path Actual entry/state All accessories compatible Startup snapshot Preference read at start This capture versus later settings Saved changes prove old capture rebound Other capture Long notes separately implemented Actual entry/permission/format Every recording/page uses one policy Synthetic policy review Known: preference enabled. Unknown: selected HFP input and graph result. Report allowance only, not route selection or noise performance. Startup failures retain original handling rather than forcing mismatched pipelines. voiceChat/voice processing names are not wind, distance, latency or accuracy SLAs. Actual route/safe environment need review without replacing device/OS acceptance or expanding service/target authority. FAQ Does true mean microphone permission granted? No. Preference, system authorization and successful start differ. Does HFP allowance force headset input? No. Inspect the actual route, not pairing or options alone. Does voiceChat guarantee cycling wind performance? No benchmark/SLA is supplied; do not operate while driving/cycling. Does mixWithOthers guarantee all page playback/capture coexistence? No. Actual page/system/input/output boundaries still matter. Do long notes use this exact policy? Do not generalize short-speech configuration to the separate long-note path. Does editing preferences prove old capture rebound? No. Inspect startup, phase/route and original guards. Reading and source Accessory preflight · Route recovery · Permission/format · Start · Privacy Policy/graph/start · Existing settings · Separate long-note path

### 分段转写怎样拼接？低能量切点、ASCII空格与原词证据核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-segment-join-provenance/

分段转写怎样拼接？低能量切点、ASCII空格与原词证据核对 拼接规则能改变边界空格，但不证明句子、标点和语义已校正 CollieNoteSegmenter用16k采样、28秒窗口，在末8秒按1600帧步长寻找低能量位置，末尾/较短最终窗口另处理。join只在两侧都是ASCII字母或数字时加一个空格；其他边界直接拼接。它不是语义断句、自动补标点、说话人识别或字级对齐，本页不新增结构化纪要引擎。 与听核原话和导出编码的分工 听核检查识别内容，导出指南核序列化；这里核 分段/拼接算法本身给结果增加或保留了什么边界 ，以免把处理产物当未经编辑的逐字原件。未运行识别模型或音频测试。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 窗口 16k、最多28秒处理窗口 实际最后窗口与长度 每28秒必为完整一句 搜索区 末8秒低能量查找 声学切点而非语义 所有词都不会被切断 步长 1600帧约100ms 粒度与实际内容分开 每词100ms对齐 ASCII边界 两侧字母/数字时加空格 API与V2拼成API V2 空格一定来自原始口述 其他边界 直接拼接，不通用修辞 中文/标点/已有空格 自动语法纠错或段落分层 空/首段 按实现保留已有或下一段 实际原词和输出 自动补齐缺句 元数据进度 帧位置与文字不是同一度量 transcribedFrames与原音频 每段已人工审校 归档说明 原引用/实际处理稿/修订分开 新增空格或人工断句依据 自动生成原话真实性证书 合成拼接示意 API + V2得到API V2；样例 + 说明直接得到样例说明。这是简单边界规则示意，不是实际识别准确率。若人工补标点、断句或改别名，应标为编辑动作并保留依据，不能说成模型或源音频已经明确给出。 低能量不保证没有词，不用算法注释代替真实听核。用于后续简报时仍保持条件、否定与未知，不从拼接稿自动推导业务批准或已执行状态。 FAQ 28秒窗口是否就是自动语义分段？ 不是。声学窗口/切点不等于句子边界或说话人分离。 低能量切点能保证不切词吗？ 没有保证。该策略不替代真实音频与识别结果核对。 API V2中的空格必为原话吗？ 不必。join会在ASCII字母数字边界补空格，应区分处理规则与原始证据。 中文边界会自动补空格和标点吗？ 不由该join提供。其他边界直接拼接，不是通用中文排版或纠错器。 帧进度是否说明全部词已听核？ 不说明。处理位置、最终文字与人工验证分别看。 本页是否新增分段编辑或自动纪要？ 没有。只是按固定源码核拼接范围，不提供新界面/API或模型能力。 相关指南与源码 片段原词核对 · 导出文字格式 · 音文材料对应 · 开始 · 隐私 CollieNoteSegmenter与join · 处理帧元数据

### Segment joining: low-energy cuts, ASCII spaces and original-word evidence

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-segment-join-provenance/

Segment joining: low-energy cuts, ASCII spaces and original-word evidence Joining may add a boundary space; it does not certify grammar, punctuation or meaning CollieNoteSegmenter uses 16 kHz, 28-second windows and a low-energy search over the last eight seconds in 1600-frame steps, with final/short-window handling. join inserts one space only when both adjacent characters are ASCII letters/digits; other boundaries concatenate. It is not semantic splitting, punctuation repair, diarization or word alignment. No structured-minutes engine is added. Different from original-word and encoding review Listening reviews content; export review checks serialization. Here what segmentation/joining itself adds or preserves at boundaries matters, so processed text is not mistaken for an untouched verbatim original. No model/audio benchmark ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Window 16 kHz/up to 28 seconds Final window/actual length Each window is a whole sentence Search Last eight seconds, low energy Acoustic versus semantic cut Words never cut Step 1600 frames, about 100 ms Granularity versus content 100-ms word alignment ASCII boundary Letters/digits both sides add space API + V2 → API V2 Space necessarily came from speech Other boundaries Direct join, no rhetoric repair CJK/punctuation/existing spaces Grammar correction/paragraph hierarchy Empty/first piece Existing/next per implementation Original words/output Missing sentences generated Progress Frame position differs from text transcribedFrames/audio Every piece manually reviewed Retention Original/processed/edited text separated Added spaces/editorial reasons Automatic verbatim authenticity certificate Synthetic joining illustration API + V2 becomes API V2; 样例 + 说明 becomes 样例说明. These illustrate boundary rules, not recognition accuracy. Manual punctuation, splitting or alias edits must retain editorial status/evidence rather than claim the model/original explicitly supplied them. Low energy is not guaranteed word absence. Review actual audio/text. Later briefs still preserve conditions, negation and unknowns; joining does not establish business approval or execution. FAQ Are 28-second windows semantic segmentation? No. Acoustic windows/cuts differ from sentence boundaries or speaker separation. Do low-energy cuts guarantee no split words? No. Strategy does not replace actual audio/result review. Must the API V2 space come from speech? No. join can insert it at ASCII letter/digit boundaries. Distinguish processing from originals. Does CJK joining add spaces/punctuation? Not through this join. Other boundaries concatenate; it is not general typography/correction. Does frame progress establish all words heard/reviewed? No. Position, final text and manual acceptance differ. Is new segment editing or automatic minutes added? No. This reviews fixed implementation, not new UI/API/model capability. Reading and source Original-word review · Export format · Audio/text mapping · Start · Privacy Segmenter/join · Frame progress metadata
